tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa 'phrin las gter mdzod bzhugs/
༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa 'phrin las gter mdzod bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs

gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa 'phrin las gter mdzod bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa 'phrin las gter mdzod ces bya ba/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje khros pa'i sku/ /ma rung bdud dpung phye mar 'thag mdzad pa/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med zhabs pad la/ /gus pas btud nas sgrub thabs mdo tsam bri/ /rnal 'byor pa dam tshig dang ldan pa 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs kyi rim pa mtha' dag legs par mnos pa zhig gis/ bris sku mchod gtor sogs mtshan nyid tshang bar bshams la/ bdag nyid yi dam gyi rnal 'byor la gnas pas/ nang mchod byin rlabs yi dam gyi mngon rtogs ltar ram/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i gtor ma byin rlabs ltar byas la/ gnas khang mchod rdzas gtor ma rnams la gtor/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog/bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ mchod pa byin rlabs kyi sngags dang*/ rol mo byin dbab spyi dang mthun par bya/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum/ a las ka pā la dum bu gsum pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ dbus su na las mi'i sha /shar du go las ba lang gi sha /lhor ku las khyi'i sha /nub tu da las rta'i sha /byang du ha las glang po che'i sha rnams hūṃ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ rnams kyis mtshan pa/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su mu las dri chu/ shar du bi las dri chen/ lho ru ra las rak+ta/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ byang du ma las sha chen gyi dang ma rnams/ baṃ paṃ laṃ paṃ taṃ gyis mtshan pa de rnams kyi steng du oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/

de'i steng du a las zla ba hūṃ las rdo rje'am gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa hūṃ las 'od 'phros rlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song ba/ oṃ dang hūṃ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzags hūṃ gi 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te thim/ oṃ yig bzla ba rdo rje'am gri gug dang bcas pa lhung ste/ rdo rje'am gri gug gis lan gsum du dkrugs nas/ thams cad zhu ba gtor ma zag med kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang*/ mi bzad pa'i dur khrod chen po'i dbus su paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du kaṃ dkar po 'od du zhu bas/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po dkar po glang po che'i dbu la spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas sa'i snying po la phug lo ma dang bcas pa zhal du gsol ba/ g.yon ne'u le rin po che skyug pa 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ kha bshang ba spu'i khung bu rnams nas nor bu'i char 'bebs pa nyal stabs su gnas pa/ de'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje gri gug 'bar ba hūṃ mthing nag gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus te thim yongs su gyur pa las/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa skye 'gro'i re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba/ sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar rab tu gnag pa/ zhal gcig phyag drug pa dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gril ba khong nas 'khrugs shing rngam pa'i zhal drag tu bzhad pa/ sma ra dang*/ smin ma dang*/ dbu skra khams nag gyen du brdzes pa/

dpral bar sin+dhu ra'i thigs le byugs pa/ spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje gri gug dang*/ g.yon dang pos thod pa dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag gis gang ba thugs khar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag g.yas bar pas thod skam gyi phreng ba/ tha mas ḍa ma ru drag tu 'khrol ba/ g.yon gnyis pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ tha ma na rdo rje zhags pa nag po bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis srid gsum rnam par gnon pa'i shugs can mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bgegs kyi rgyal po gnon zhing brdzis pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs la dar ljang khu'i ske rags bcings pa/ klu chen po'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa ste/ sbrul sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing*/ dmar po'i snyan cha/ khra bo'i dpung brgyan/ dkar po'i mgul rgyan/ ser po'i lag gdub/ ljang khu'i do shal/ dkar po'i rkang gdub dang*/ ske rags can/ phyag zhabs thams cad la dril bu g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba dang ldan pa/ sbom thung lto ba rgyas shing yan lag hrags pa/ bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid mtha' yas pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis mdzes pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan can/ ha ha dang*/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa la sogs pa 'jigs pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs pas/ bdud dang dgra bgegs thams cad rlag par mdzad pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ tsan dan gyi sdong po la rgyab brten pa'o/ /de'i g.yon du khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma sku mdog nag mo rngam zhing khros pa phyag g.yas kyis bdud kyi khram shing nag po 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon nad kyi rkyal ba 'dzin pa/ chibs kyi snga long la sho rde'u dkar nag dang*/ byang dmar khres po/ phyi long la mtshon gyi gru gu ste sprul pa'i mtshon cha lnga dang bcas pa/

spyan gsum mche gtsigs khro gnyer bsdus pa/ dbu skra gyen du 'khyil zhing spyi bor rma bya'i mdongs kyis brgyan pa/ lte ba nas nyi ma dang*/ spyi gtsug nas zla ba 'char ba/ dre'u rta rkang gsum la chibs pa/ srin po'i ya mgal la sga'i snga ru byas shing*/ ma mgal la phyi ru byas pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing*/ ba glang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs dang*/ gos nag gsol ba/ rus pa'i rgyan dang*/ mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang*/ do shal/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul/ g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ me dpung dang rlung nag 'tshub mar 'tshub pa'i dbus na bzhugs shing 'khor sha za dang*/ ma mo mkha' 'gro 'bum sdes bskor ba'o/ /gtso bo'i mdun du k+ṣaṃ las gnod sbyin k+ṣe tra pā la sku mdog mthing nag kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs nas dgra la 'o dod 'bod pa/ shangs nas dus mtha'i rlung ldang ba/ phyag g.yas pas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar bas lha dang lha min thams cad skrag par byed pa/ g.yon thod khrag dgra bgegs kyi snying dang bcas pa gtso bo'i zhal du stob pa/ dom nag smyon pa la : phyibs [ chibs ] pa/ 'khor gnod sbyin gdug pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ g.yas su hūṃ las dbang phyug dzi na mi dra/ sku mdog dmar nag srin po khros pa'i gzugs can/ zhal nas dug dang khrag gi char 'bebs pa/ phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru drag tu 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub kyi rtse la me 'bar ba/ 'khor gza' dang srin po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ rgyab tu ṭaṃ las gshin rje ṭak+ki rā dza sku mdog nag po mi'i sha khrag la ches rngams pa/ phyag g.yas rgyu ma'i zhags pa dgra la 'phen zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub gnod byed la sdigs pa gshin rje'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ gsum ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan zhing*/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ g.yon du hūṃ las bdud mgon chen po trak+shad sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa/

phyag g.yas ru mtshon mdung dmar rtse gsum pa dgra bo'i snying khar bsnun pa/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba zhal du gsol ba/ ya sos ma mchu mnan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber mun pa'i g.yung drung ris dang*/ sag ti'i lham yu rings gsol ba/ gser gyi ska rags bcings pa/ bdud rta nag po rting dkar la chibs pa/ 'khor lha dang bdud dmag gi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ bzhi ka'ang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dgra bgegs la sdang mig tu blta ba/ mi bzad pa'i mche ba rnam pa bzhi gtsigs pa/ gtum zhing khros la cher 'khrugs pa sbom thung mi sdug pa'i rnam pa can/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ thod skam gyi dbu brgyan dang*/ mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa'i do shal can/ me rlung drag tu 'tshub pa'i klong dkyil du bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol tu shar du brgya byin ser po glang po che la zhon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa dbyug tho 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po smug nag ro langs la zhon pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rlung lha ljang khu sha ba la zhon pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa nor bus mtshan pa'i be con 'dzin pa/ byang shar du 'byung po dkar po glang la zhon pa rtse gsum 'dzin pa lha mo gau ri la 'khyud pa/ steng du tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la zhon pa bum pa 'dzin pa/ 'og tu sa bdag nag po phag pa la zhon pa rin po che 'bar ba 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi rigs mtshungs 'bum 'bum gyis yongs su bskor ba phyag g.yon pas gtso bo la 'dud pa'o/ /gzhan yang mahā de ba la sogs pa lha chen po brgyad/ nor rgyas la sogs pa klu chen po brgyad/ nyi ma la sogs pa gza' chen po brgyad/

drag po la sogs pa 'jigs byed chen po dgu smin drug la sogs pa rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ yul 'khor bsrung la sogs pa rgyal po chen po bzhi ste/ gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga po thams cad kyang 'khor bye ba bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du 'khor dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs lha ma srin sde brgyad rnams sha la dga' ba khrag la rol ba/ snying rje med pa/ kha gdangs pa/ mig rtsa dmar ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ bzhin bsdus pa/ gtum zhing 'jigs la mi sdug pa'i rnam pa can/ lag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa/ skad cig la skye 'gro thams cad kyi srog dbugs bsdud pa/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ sha za dang*/ gshin rje dang*/ bdud dang*/ ma mo'i cha lugs can/ sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad yongs su gang ba/ thams cad kyang sgrub pa po'i re 'dod tshul bzhin du skong bar mdzad pa'o/ /de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal/ tsan dan gyi shing rkang gcig pa'i drung nas/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa steng na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ g.yas na dpa' bo ngar dang bcas shing*/ g.yon na dpa' mo 'dzum dang bcas pa bka' sdod zhing skyong pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad skad cig de nyid la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra sil li li/ khrol lo lo/ /'ur 'ur/ chem chem du byon par gyur/ hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs mahā ka la che/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas// dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /k+ṣe tra pā la la sogs pa/ / 'khor gyi bka' nyan gnod sbyin tshogs/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol/ /dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang*/

/rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes pa/ /rtag dang mtshan ma ston pa dang*/ /bcol pa'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra k+ṣiṃ/ k+ṣiṃ ring po nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod/ de nas k+ṣiṃ gi gnas su/ e h+ye hi bcug pa dang*/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bcug pa lan gsum gsum brjod pas/ myur mdzad 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ hūṃ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren gshegs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i mchod yon 'di/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil/ pād+yaṃ/ me tog puṣ+pe/ bdug spos/ dhū pe/ snang gsal/ ā lo ke dri chab/ ghan+dhe/ zhal zas/ nai we te/ rol mo/ shap+ta/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod 'bul/ chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i sku/ /bstan pa'i ru ṭa 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /nag po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de nas rgyun gyi nyams len gtor chog tsam bya bar 'dod na/ 'og gi gtor ma 'bul ba man chadatsam byas pas kyad rung la/ yang bla ma mgon po dbyer med dang*/ gril sel dang*/ gnad dbab kyi bka' legs par thob cing*/ de dag gi don nyams su len par 'dod na/ dmigs pa dang gnad rgyas pa rnams man ngag ltar shes par byas la/ dang po bla ma mgon po'i gsol 'debs ni/ mgon po'i dbu gtsug tu drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog ser po nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu thugs kar gtod cing*/ g.yon gser gyi dril bu dkur brten pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/

rdo rje 'chang nas brtsams te brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma'i sku las 'od 'phros/ mgon po 'od dang bde ba'i rang bzhin du 'ur 'ur/ sil sil gar mdzad/ mgon po las 'od 'phros/ bla ma'i sku la thim pas/ bla ma 'od dang bde ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ dril bu g.yer ba'i sgra sil sil/ khrol khrol gar mdzad bla ma nyid mgon po/ mgon po nyid bla ma/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med par gyur/ bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma mgon po dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so/ /mgon po bla ma dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs so/ /dpal ldan shā bā ri dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs so/ /mnga' bdag mai tri ba chen po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /grub cheb rā hu la chen po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la gsol ba 'debs so/ /mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rtogs ldan zhang sgom chos seng la gsol ba 'debs so/ /dbon ston skyer sgang ba chen po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /snyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor la gsol ba 'debs

so/ /'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /mkhas grub shangs ston chos rje la gsol ba 'debs so/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bya bral ri khrod ras chen la gsol ba 'debs so/ / mkhyen ldan shangs pa dkar po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal bzang la gsol ba 'debs so/ /grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rgya sgom legs pa rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rje btsun lha dbang grags pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /'jam dbyangs kun dga' snying po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo gu ru he/ badz+ra bī ra bī ri ṇe/ shrī ḍā ka ḍā ki nī/ dzo ga dzo gi nī/ sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa ya sha rā ṇīṃ/ gats+tsha mi/ kyai/ phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi byin gyis rlobs shig /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/ mthu dang nus pa la thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba khyed rnams kyi sku'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig /gsung gi sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig / thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig /sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig /da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig / myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ bdag ni dad pas gsol 'debs kyis/

bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ nyon mongs ma lus bsal ba dang*/ dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ / gnyis pa grib sel ni/ mgon po'i dbu gtsug tu rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/ phyag g.yas shel gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod pa/ g.yon pas mnyam bzhag gi steng du thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ steng gi nam mkha' la 'khod par gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pa'i mthar/ rdo rje 'chang dang dpal ldan shā bā ri/ /rgyal ba mi tri grub chen rā hu la/ /a mi de ba lo ke shwa ra dang*/ ha ya gri ba pad+ma 'byung gnas dpal/ khyung po dzo gi rat+na bīr+ya dang*/ /dharma sing ha dharma pradz+nyā dang*/ /bīr+ya sing ha shangs ston chos rje sogs/ /rin chen brgyud pa'i bla ma dgongs su gsol/ /'gro ba'i re skong yon tan rab rdzogs pa'i/ /brgyud ldan bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la/ /dag pa gnyis ldan chos skur ma rtogs pa/ /'jig rten rtog bcas dbang gyur mthol lo bshags/ sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las dang*/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i lha rnams dgongs su gsol// bdag cag theg mchog sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas/ /rtsa ba yan lag 'gal nyams mthol lo bshags/ /mthu stobs nus pa 'phrin las phun tshogs shing*/ / skad cig dran pas bar chad thams cad sel/ /'du 'bral med par dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i/ /ye shes mgon po phyag drug dgongs su gsol/ /dur khrod nags mtha' chu gling bas mtha' ru/ /phyi nang rten dang dam rdzas tshogs gyur nas/ /bsnyen sgrub bskang bshags tshul bzhin ma grub par/ /le lo g.yeng ba'i dbang gyur mthol lo bshags/ khyad par gsang ba'i rten mchog bla na med/

/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med bde chen sku/ khyod la yid ches mos gus 'bral med kyis/ /rnam rtog chos skur ma rtogs mthol lo bshags/ /bdag ni ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur te/ /bla ma mgon po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa/ /gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems dang bcas nas kyang*/ /lha mchog khyod kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ /ye shes bka' sgrub las kyi pho nya mdzad/ k+ṣe tra pā la dzi na mi tra dang*/ ṭak+ki rā dza trak+shad re ma ti/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang gtsang rigs dgongs su gsol/ /ji ltar khyed kyis khas blang dam bcas bzhin/ /bdag gis 'phrin las yengs med sgrub pa la/ /yid chad bgyis shing sha khrag gtor tshogs kyis/ /gtang rag dus su ma thengs mthol lo bshags/ /mngon shes med pa'i nyes skyon ma rtogs par/ / bstan pa 'jig dang bla ma'i sku dgra la/ /drag po'i las kyis tshar gcod ma bgyis par/ /gsang ba bsgrags shing byams bgyis mthol lo bshags/ /dam nyams grib phog gtam 'dres zas zos dang*/ /rgyu chud phud nyams 'gal 'khrugs nor la sogs/ /nyes skyon 'khrul pa'i tshogs rnams ci mchis pa/ / gnod zhing 'gyod pa'i sgo nas mthol lo bshags/ /sku'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /yan lag dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /tshor te dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /ma tshor dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /nyams grib dag phyir bshags pa 'di byas pas/ /bla ma mgon po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /pha ma bu tsha bzhin du bzod bzhes la/ /dngos grub thams cad dus 'dir stsal du gsol/ /bshags dang bshags par bya ba ma dmigs kyang*/ /rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags dag bya'i phyir/ /rje btsun dam pa yul gyi mchog rnams la/ /rab tu bshags pas bde chen thob gyur

cig / gsum pa gnad dbab ni/ mgon po'i dbu gtsug gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma denyid/ sku mdog dmar po g.yas thod pa'i ḍa ma ru 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can/ sgeg cing lang mtsho la bab pa/ chags pa'i nyams can/ spyan gzigs pa tsam gyis mkha' 'gro dang srid gsum dbang du bsdud pa/ skyil krung gis bzhugs pa mgon po'i dpral ba'i sin+dhu ra'i thig le gru gsum gyi steng na yi ge hrīḥdamar po 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi ngo bo bcu gsum yongs su gyur pa las/ gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo lang mtsho ma/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas cang te'u/ g.yon thaud pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pa'i gar stabs can/ spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig hrig gzigs shing gar mdzad pa bcu gsum sgrol ma'i ngo bo/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad bdag gi dbang du bsdus/ dgos 'dod thams cad char bzhin babs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra na ra kriṃ kriṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzla/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las sngags kyi phreng ba rnams kha dog nag po 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba/ 'phreng rdog ltar gnas pa la/ 'od zer sna lnga 'phreng thag gi tshul du brgyus pa/ rang gi zhal nas thon/ mgon po zhal du zhugs pa mgon po'i thugs ka'i hūṃ la thim/ yang hūṃ las byung*/ mgon po'i lte ba nas thon/ bdag gi lte bar zhugs snying kha'i hūṃ la thim par gyur/ de ltar rtag tu 'khor lo ltar 'khor bar bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la k+ṣīṃ k+ṣe tra bigh+nān bi nā ya ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ phaṭa gnyis dang*/ swāhā bsnan pa yi ge nyer gnyis pa yang rung ste/ snying po ci 'grub bzlas/ drag po'i bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab ste/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la/ shā sa na/ u pa ha ri ṇe/ e ṣo3/ paṣ+tsi mahā kā lo3/

a yaṃ i daṃ/ rat+na trā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇi/ ya ti pra ti dz+nyā/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+taṃ/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+d+ta ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ dī na mi ke na/ mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa ni drag sngags te/ 'bod rbad bsad gsum yang 'di la tshang bar bzhed do/ / oṃ shrī de bi hūṃ phaṭa/ lha mo'i mtshan sngags so// bh+yoḥ ma mo nag mo bai tā lī sin+dha ku lu ku lu hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lha mo'i sny-ing po'o/ / oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la bigh+nān hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzi na mi tra bā shaṃ ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ṭak+ki rā dza sa ma ya bh+yoḥdu dza hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ du yo ga dza mahā ka la trak+shad hūṃ phaṭa/ las mkhan bzhi'i snying po//de ltar bzlas pa ci 'grub byas nas/ mthar mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje dmar po'i 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma drangs nas gsol bas thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas tshim nas dges par gyur/ snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ bā ling ta/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi btags pa'am/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra bigh+nān bi nā ya ka traka rag mo/ /bā liṃ ta maṃ sa/ rak+ta ru ti/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ de bzhin du 'khor rnams la snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa btags la lan gsum gsum gyis phul/ mahā kā la sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod/ gong ltar nang mchod phul la/ hūṃ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhabs gdub dang bcas bi nā ya ka mnan/ /nag po chen po stag gi sham thabs can/ phyag drug sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas pa gri gug bar pa 'phreng ba 'dzin/ /tha ma ḍā ma ru ni drag tu 'khrol/ /g.yon pa thod pa dang ni mdung rtse gsum/ /de bzhin zhags pa bzung nas 'ching bar byed/ /drag po'i zhal gdangs mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ /spyan gsum drag po'i dbu skra gyen du 'bar/

/dpral bar sin+dhu ra yi thig le byugs/ /spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab brtan/ khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /rin chen thod skam lnga yi dbu la brgyan/ /shing las byon nas gtor ma len mdzad pa'i/ / dpal ldan phyag drug pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba dang*/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang gnyan po bstod pa dang*/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ /rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ /ci 'dod dngos grub myur du stsal du gsol/ /lang ka pu ri gsum bsregs shing*/ /sangs rgyas bstan skyong bdud dpung 'joms/ /zhal gcig phyag drug nag po che/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can khyod la bstod/ /bh+yoḥ khrag mtsho chil chil khol ba'i klong dkyil na/ /mtsho chen dre'u'i steng na gzi brjid 'bar/ /mthig nag sku la zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /bdud kyi khram shing nad kyi rkyal pa rnams/ /sku'i sprul pas sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrungs/ / gsung gi sprul pas khams gsum g.yo bar byed/ thugs ni mi 'gyur 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma/ ma cig re ma tī la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po'i phyogs bzhi'i bka' mnyan pa/ /ye shes bka' bsgrub las kyi pho nya mdzad/ /ma rungs kun 'dul sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed/ /las byed pho nya bzhi la bdag cag bstod/ /dbang po gshin rje chu lha gnod sbyin dang*/ /me lha srin po rlung lha 'byung po dang*/ steng gi tshangs pa sa'i lha mo ste/ /sprul pa'i phyogs skyong bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal mgon bdun bcu rtsa lnga dang*/ /dam can rgya mtsho dmag tshogs rnams/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chod sol/ /mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol ba dang*/ bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ / thun gtor yod na sgron me btsugs te khang steng la sogs par 'bul zhing*/

dpal ldan mgon po mahā kā la dang*/ /ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma tī/ /lcam dral khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /k+ṣe tra pā la dzi na mi tra dang*/ /ṭak+ki rā dza bdud mgon trak+shad sogs/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes sha ི ga/ 'dzam bu ti ba'i zhal zas 'di bzhes cig /dza gad dpa' pau'i sman phung 'di bzhes cig /sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyan por 'bul/ da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs gnyan por bzhes/ /'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang*/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po/ /thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las ni myur du sgrubs/ rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ thun gtor med na rgyun gyi bsnyen pa'i skabs spyi btab 'di bya mi dgos so/ /yig brgya mang du bzlas/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ zhes sogs dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*/ /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs ma lus sel par shog /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron kyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ smon lam btab/ yon tan rab rdzogs gangs kyi ri bo bzhin/ /byin rlabs chu bos skal bzang tshim mdzad cing*/ /rang sems lhan cig skyes par ston mdzad pa'i/ /chos rje bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog

/ sgrub pa po la bu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing*/ /mi 'bral lus dang grib ma ji bzhin du/ /dam tshig can la dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dam can sgrub pa po yi rjes 'brangs shing*/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod sogs/ /sna tshogs 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /snang srid rang grol sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ /bde ba chen mo rgyun chad med pa'i nyams/ /yid la byar med stong gsal nam mkha' dang*/ /bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog /sgrub pa po la brten zhing mchod pa dang*/ /skur ba 'debs pa'i skye 'gro gang yin pa/ / thams cad byang chub lam la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /mnyam med byang chub sems kyi bkra shis shog /'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa thams cad kyis/ /bkra shis go 'phang ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /phun sum tshogs pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du/ /skye 'gro yongs la rtag tu bkra shis shog /bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin/ /snyan grags chen pos nam mkha' bzhin du khyab/ /tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun gyis grub/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkra shis shog / ces bkra shis bka' rgya ma brjod do/ /yang dpal ldan lha mo phyag bzhi ma la mos na/ phyag g.yas na ral gri sdig pa'i yu ba can dang gri gug

/ g.yon na nal bu'i rgyal mtshan dang thod rlon 'dzin pa/ yang na phyag gnyis ma g.yas ral gri 'bar ba dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka la yang srin po'i ma mgal sga'i snga rur byas pa khram bam dang*/ ma mgal phyi rur byas pa la nad rkyal btags pa/ sngags kyang phyag bzhi ma la/ oṃ ma ma sarba tsa dur bhak+ṣa dzaḥ re ma ti 'ur ba 'ur ba/ sa ma tri ra dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ phyag gnyis ma 'di la yang gong dkyus ltar gyi sngags dang*/ oṃ trag rag mo rak+ta ru ti ra hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ bstod pa'i skabs su yang phyag gnyis ma la/ ral gri 'bar ba dang ni thod khrag 'dzin/ zhes pa dang*/ phyag bzhi ma la ni/ mthing nag sku la zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ /ral gri gri gug rgyal mtshan thod rlon 'dzin/ / zhes 'don pa spo/ las mkhan rnams kyang*/ k+ṣe tra pā la smug nag dang*/ dzi na mi tra cang te dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ ṭak+ki rā dza cang te dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa dang*/ bdud mgon phyag bzhi pa/ mdung dmar bing chen tho ba thod khrag rnams 'dzin pa ltar byas kyang rung*/ yang dzi na mi tra g.yas rdzas kyis rdo rje pha lam dang*/ g.yon gcod pa'i 'khor lo 'phen pa'am ḍā ma ru dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ ṭak+ki rā dza spu gri dang thod snying 'dzin pa ltar ram/ gshin rje gri thod 'dzin pa ltar yang rung*/ yang phyag mtshan dkyus ltar las/ dzi na mi tra ljang khu dang*/ ṭak+ki rā dza dmar po byas pa yang yod de/ de dag thams cad gang ltar byas kyang rung ba'o/ /las sbyor gyi tshe bzhon pa can du byas te/ nges par lha mo dang bdud mgon phyag bzhi par bya/ dzi na mi tra seng ge dang*/ ṭak+ki rā dza stag la zhon pa/ phyag mtshan snga ma ltar ram/ spyang gi la chibs pa/ lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin par bsgom la gtor ma la 'bul ba yin no/ /'khor rnams rgyas par bskyed mi nus na/ gtso bo'i mngon rtogs kyi rjes su 'khor rnams kyi mtshan tsam brjod pa'am/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor bar gyur/

dpral bar oṃ zhes pa man chad bya/ gtor chog 'bring po ni/ 'khor mi bskyed par gtso rkyang bskyed nas spyan 'dren pa man chad bya/ mchod pa'i tshigs bcad rnams kyang dor bas 'grub cing*/ bsdus pa ni/ dam tshig pa mi bskyed par ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa yin te/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal zhes sogs man chad bya ste/ 'bring bsdus gnyis la gnad gsum gyi dmigs pa bor te gtor ma 'bul ba sogs bya'o/ /bsnyen pa'i dus ma yin pa rgyun gyi bzlas pa'i skabs kyang phal cher phyi ma 'di nyid gtso bor bzung ngo*/ /bdag bskyed ni/ spyir yi dam gang la brten kyang rung mos kyi/ gtso bor ni bde kyai 'jigs byed rta mgrin rnams gang rung gcig la brten nas mdzad par snang ngo*/ /bdag mdun dbyer med du byed pa dang tha dad du byed kyang mgon po gtso rkyang gi mngon rtogs 'di nyid dam/ gsang bsgrub rgyan can la brten pa sogs kyang man ngag khungs ma las kyang 'byung zhing*/ lung rigs dang 'gal ba med pa'i phyir shin tu rung mod kyi/ 'on kyang las dang po pa rnams kyis dkyus ltar nyams su blangs na mchog go /'dir smras pa/ de ltar bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi/ /sgrub thabs mdor bsdus tsam zhig brjod pa 'di/ /dam pa snga ma rnams kyis yang nas yang*/ /gsal bar mdzad mod gzhan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ /shin tu gsal zhing rgyas bsdus skyon bral bar/ /go bde'i tshigs gis brjod na blo dman la/ /phan par 'gyur snyam mos pa sna tshogs dang*/ /mtshungs pa'i rim pa so sor bye ba yin/ /dge des bdag cag byang chub sgrub pa la/ /bar chad kun zhi mthun rkyen kun grub nas/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus par/ /da lta nyid du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /skad cig tsam gyis tshar bcad de/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po yis/

/ 'phrin las phyogs bcur spel bar shog /ces pa'ang mchog tu gyur pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer bdun pa nag pa'i zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la legs par sbyar ba'o/ / zhus dag/ bkra shis 'phel// dge legs 'phel// dar rgyas 'phel lo// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor chog dang bcas pa bzhugs/ swā sti/ dpal chen he ru ka dpal khros pa'i sku/ /'jig rten dbang phyug thugs las 'khrungs pa yi/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med la btud nas/ /de nyid mchod pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus bris/ /yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su nyer 'kho thams cad tshogs par byas la/ bdag bskyed gang yang rung ba sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pā la rnams kyi nang du hūṃ zhu ba las/ mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā nas shap+ta āḥhūṃ gi bar brjod/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gaṃ las tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dkar po spyan gsum pa glang po'i gdong can/ g.yas la phug lo ma dang bcas pa gsol zhing*/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa nyal stabs su 'gyel ba'i steng du/ hūṃ mthing nag las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po skye 'gro'i re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba/ zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ zhal gdangs shing mi bzad pa'i mche ba gtsigs pas drag tu bzhad pa/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ dmar shing 'khrug pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ dpral bar sin nghu ra'i thig les byugs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/

g.yas gnyis pas thod skam gyi phreng ba/ gsum pas cang te'u drag tu 'khrol ba/ g.yon gnyis pas mdung rtse gsum pa/ gsum pas rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ 'jigs su rung ba'i thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ dar ljang khu'i ska rags bcings pa/ phyag zhabs la dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ sbrul sngon po'i thod bcings/ dmar po'i snyan rgyan/ khra bo'i dpung rgyan/ dkar po'i mgul rgyan/ ser po'i lag gdub/ ljang khu'i do shal/ dkar pos ska rags dang rkang gdub byas pa/ sku lus sbom thung rags shing*/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i gyad ky-i bgegs kyi rgyal po mnan pa/ spyi bor mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa/ de'i g.yon na khrag zhag 'khrug pa'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ g.yas gnyis na/ ral gri dang gri gug /g.yon gnyis na rgyal mtshan dang thod rlon khrag gis gang ba/ khro gnyer bsdus shing*/ glang chen gyi ko rlon gyi stod g.yogs dang*/ re lde'i sham thabs/ sbrul nag du ma'i ska rags can/ khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi sor ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu can/ lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char ba/ dre'u rta rkang gsum la chibs pa/ ma mo dang sha za'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bo'i mdun du k+ṣaṃ las gnod sbyin k+ṣe tra pā la sku mdog mthing nagashangs nas dus mtha'i rlung 'tshub pa/ kha gdangs nas dgra la 'o dod 'bod pa/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa snying bcas gtso bo la stobs pa/ shin tu khros shing mi gdug pa/ dom nag smyon pa la zhon pa/ gtso bo g.yas su pad nyi dang ro'i gdan la/ hūṃ las dbang phyug dzi na mi tra sku mdog dmar nag g.yas ḍā ma ru drag tu 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag dron gyis gang ba bsnams pa/ rgyab tu pad nyi dang ro'i gdan la/

ṭaṃ las gshin rje ṭak+ki rā dza sku mdog nag po g.yas zhags pa dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub/ gshin rje rab tu khros pa'i cha lugs can/ lha mo'i g.yon du hūṃ las bdud mgon trak+shad sku mdog dud sprin ltar gnag pa/ g.yas ru mtshon dmar po 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber dang*/ sag ti'i lham gyon nas rta nag rting dkar la chibs pa/ 'khor bzhi char khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ rang rang gi 'khor 'bum 'bum dang bcas pa/ gtso 'khor drug ka'ang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i phyi rol tu shar du rgya byin/ shar lhor me lha/ lhor gshin rje/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub tu chu lha/ nub byang du rlung lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ byang shar du dbang ldan/ steng du tshangs pa/ 'og tu sa'i lha mo/ de thams cad rang rang gi 'khor bye ba bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' chen brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'jigs byed dgu /rgyal chen bzhi ste/ gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdud bcu rtsa lnga/ de'i phyi rol du dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs/ sha la dga' ba/ khrag la rol ba/ snying rje med pa/ gtum zhing mi sdug pa/ mig rtsa dmar ba/ kha gdangs pa/ mchai ba gtsigs pa/ lag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa/ skad cig la skye 'gro thams cad kyi srog dbugs bsdud pa/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ gshin rje dang bdud kyi cha lugs can/ sa gzhi bar snang phyogs bcu thams cad du sprin gtibs pa ltar 'khod par gyur/ mdor bsdu na/ mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa/ 'khor dpal ldan lha mo re ma tī/ las byed bzhi/ gtsang rigs bdun cu rtsa lnga/ dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa/ zhes pa tsam gyi chog thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/

rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis shar lhor dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal tsan dan gyi shing rkang gcig pa'i drung nas/ nag po chen po steng na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ g.yas na dpa' bo ngar dang bcas shing*/ g.yon na dpa' mo 'dzum dang bcas pa/ 'khor bka' sdod kyi tshogs dang bcas pa/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bu g.yer ka'i sil khrol gyi sgra dang*/ gad rgyangs 'ur 'ur chem chem dang bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bskang ba sogs kyi tshe spro na bzhengs shig sogs nas/ dam tshig ldan pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ / zhes pa'i bar bya/ mi spro na rgyun gtor sogs la/ hūṃ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs mahā kā la ya/ /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la// dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /k+ṣe tra pā la la sogs pa/ / 'khor gyi bka' gnyan gnod sbyin tshogs/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ k+ṣiṃ nyer gcig brjod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /ma rung 'dul phyir khros pa'i sku/ /bstan pa'i dgra bo 'jom mdzad pa'i/ /nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ sngags rnams kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags la 'bul/ bsdu na mchod bstod 'di med kyang chog mgon po'i spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog ser po nor bu dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rdo rje skyil krung*/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ bla ma'i sku las 'od 'phros/ mgon po la phog 'od dang bde ba'i rang bzhin du ltem ltem gyur/ 'ur 'ur sil sil gar mdzad/ mgon po las 'od 'phros bla ma la phog /'od dang sogs gong bzhin/ mgon po nyid bla ma/ bla ma nyid mgon po/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so/ / spro na bar 'dir brgyud pa'i bla ma gsol 'debs bya/

de nas/ na mo bud+dha ya nas/ dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol gyi bar ci mang gis gsol ba btab/ yang spyi bo'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po g.yas shel gyi rdo rje/ g.yon ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad bla ma'i gnas gsum du thim/ bla ma'i gnas gsum nas yi ge brgya pa dkar dmar mthing gsum byung*/ mgon po'i gnas gsum du thim/ sku gsung thugs kyi nyams chags thams cad dag par gyur/ yig brgya nyer gcig sogs bzlas la/ longs skabs yod na/ rdo rje 'chang chen dpal ldan shā bā ri sogs dang*/ rin chen brgyud pa'i bla ma sogs rgyas par bya/ bsdu na/ sku'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags nas/ dus 'dir stsal du gsol gyi bar dang*/ khyed thugs gsang ba sogs sho lo ka gcig bya/ yang mgon po'i spyi bo'i bla ma dmar po ḍā ma ru dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lta bas mi ngoms shing*/ bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can/ gzigs pa tsam gyi ci 'dod dbang du bsdud pa/ dpral ba'i sin dhu ra'i thig le'i nang du/ hrīḥdamar po bcu gsum yongs su gyur pa las/ gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo ḍā ma ru dang thod khrag 'dzin pa bcu gsum du gyur/ bla ma'i sku las byung ba'i 'od zer dmar po mkha' 'gro ma la phog pas de rnams ḍā ma ru dang g.yer kha'i sgra khrol khrol/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs ling ling pa/ spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig hrig gzigs pa/ mgon po dang mkha' 'gro ma'i 'od zer gyis sems can thams cad bdag gi dbang du bsdus/ dgos 'dod char ltar babs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra na ra kriṃ kriṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab ste/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra bigh+nān bi nā ya ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ ci mang bzlas pa'i mthar shā sa na bzla/ oṃ trag rag mo rak+ta ru dhi ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la bigh+nān hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ dzi na mi tra wa shaṃ ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ṭak+ki rā dza sa ma ya bh+yo du dza hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ du yog dza mahā kā la traka shad hūṃ phaṭa/ rnams kyang ci rigs bzla/ gtor ma/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum/ de'i steng du a las thod pa mtshan ldan yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ rnams las sha lnga/ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ baṃ rnams las bdud rtsi lnga/ steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po a las zla ba/ hūṃ las rdo rje rnams brtsegs pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga 'od du zhu/ yi ge 'bru gsum las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje gsum ye shes kyi bdud rtsir spyan drangs te thim/ oṃ dang zla ba rdo rje rnams kyang 'od du zhu zhing thim pas/ kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa zad mi shes pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum/ sngar gyi sngags re re'i mthar/ i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swāhā/ btags pa lan gsum mam bdun bdun gyi 'bul/

oṃ shrī mahā kā la sa pā ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai be t+ya/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ sngags so so'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ btags la nang mchod 'bul/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po legs ldan nag po/ bdud gcod kyi skyes bu/ srog gcod kyi bshan pa/ bdud 'dul gyi dmag dpon/ srin po lang ka pu ri grong khyer gsum brtsegs brlag par mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor pa'i dgra lha/ rigs 'dzin gyi srung ma/ dam nyams kyi srog bdud chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dam rdzas brgyan dang ldan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs bstod/ dge 'dun gyi chos 'khor skyongs/ bla ma'i sku tshe srings/ khyad par du dkon mchog gsum la gnod par byed pa dang*/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la bsam sbyor ngan pa byed pa thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig /gal te zhi bas 'dul du ma 'tshal na/ bsad pa dang*/ bskrad pa dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ rengs pa dang*/ gzir ba dang*/ sdigs shing*/ dpa' skong ba la sogs pa drag po'i phrin las kyi tshar bcad du gsol/ bla ma mgon po 'khor bcas la/ / bdag gis mchod gtor phul ba yis/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phangs smod pa dang*/ /theg pa chen po sun 'byin dang*/ /bstan pa 'jigs dang dbyen byed dang*/ /bla ma'i sku la brdo ba dang*/ /rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba rnams/ /de kun nag po chen pos bsgrol/ /mā ra ya phaṭa/ sa ma ya/ rgyas pa la spro na/ rngam pa sgra sgrog sogs bstod pa dang*/ 'khor dang lha mo'i bstod bskul khyung pos mdzad pa byin can rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i ci rigs bya/ 'bring du bya bar mos na/ kho bos zur du bkod pa bzhin bya/ rgyun gtor sogs bsdus pa'i skabs/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs sogs kyi gtso bo la bstod/ khrag mtsho chil chil khol ba'i klongs dkyil na/ /mtsho chen dre'u'i steng na gzi brjid 'bar/

/mthing nag sku la zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ /ral gri gri gug rgyal mtshan thod rlon bsnams/ /sku'i sprul pas sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung*/ / gsung gi sprul pas khams gsum g.yo bar mdzad/ /thugs ni mi 'gyur 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma/ /ma cig re ma tī la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i phyogs bzhi'i bka' mnyam pa/ /ye shes bka' bsgrub las kyi pho nya mdzad/ /ma rungs kun 'dul sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed/ /las byed pho nya bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dbang po gshin rje chu lha gnod sbyin dang*/ /me lha srin po rlung lha 'byung po dang*/ /steng gi tshangs pa sa'i lha mo ste/ /sprul pa'i phyogs skyong bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang*/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs rnams/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol/ /'dod don thams cad sgrub pa dang*/ /mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol ba dang*/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ / ces bstod/ de nas thun gtor 'bul na/ dpal ldan mgon po mahā kā la dang sogs spyi btab bya/ rgyun gtor la 'di ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon med do/ /de nas yi ge brgya pa mang du bzlas la/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyi bzod par gsol/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ / sogs kyi gshegs su gsol ba'am/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ de nas smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs pa byas nas/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /ma lus gzhan 'phrul sder bcas 'joms pa'i lha/ /sa steng dgra bo'i tshogs rnams rab nyams byed/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol mdzad nag po che/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med sgrub pa dang*/ / mchod pa'i bya ba rgyas bsdus skyon bral zhing*/ /tshang la ma nor man ngag ldan pa 'di/ /kun dga' snying po'i zang zing bral ba yis/ /zol med 'gro la phan pa'i bsam pas bris/

zhes pa'ang smras so// 'dir shin tu bsdus pa dang bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs thun phyi ma gsum la gsar du bskyed chog mi dgos par/ snying ga'i 'od kyis skad cig la spyan 'dren pa man chad tshang bar byas pas rung bar khyung po'i yig chung du bshad pas de ltar bya'o/ /zhes pa myur mdzad byin rlabs kyi mgon po'i sgrub thabs 'di yang*/ mi dbang gzhon nu rnam dpyod kyi spyan ras lhag par bsal ba gang gis nye bar bskul te/ rgyal khams pa kun dga' snying pos rang lo nyer gsum pa chu stod can gyi mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes la bris pa ste tshong 'dus 'gur mo'i pho brang du'o// // maṅga laṃ// shu bha mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// zhus so// // ༄༅/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med nyid la bstod pa bzhugs/ ye shes bskal pa'i me yi klong dkyil na/ /thabs la mkhas pas rab khros skur ston pa/ /mi bsrun bdud sde 'joms pa'i dpa' bo che/ /myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag tu 'gro la khyab pa'i thugs rje yis/ /rab tu zhi yang mchog tu gtum pa'i sku/ /dus mtha'i sprin dang mig sman ltar gnag pa/ /'jigs byed khrag 'thung gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab bzhad rdo rje'i gad mo chen po yis/ /bdud dang gshin rje'i snying 'gas klad pa 'gem// lha dang lha min ma rungs sder bcas ltung*/ /drag shul bzod dka'i gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs rgyal rnams kyi/ /brtse chen gcig tu bsdus pa spyan ras gzigs/ /dngos grub kun stsol byin rlabs mgon po mchog /'phrin las myur sgrub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gsum me ltar 'bar/ /sma ra smin ma dbu skra gyen du brdzes// klu chen brgyad dang g.yer kha'i phreng bas brgyan/ /phyag drug mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen cod pan khrag 'dzag mgo phreng can/ /phyag g.yas gri gug thod phreng cang te 'khrol/

/phyag g.yon thod pa rtse gsum zhags pa bsnams// stag lpags na bzas mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam dang g.yon brkyang gyad kyi dor stabs sogs/ /sna tshogs gar kyi log 'dren steng na rol/ /pad nyi'i gdan bzhugs tsan+dan ljon pa'i drung*/ /brten mdzad mahā kā lar phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhabs sen cung zad brdabs pas sa gzhi g.yo/ hūṃ sgras ri bo ral zhing chu gter 'khrug /spyan tsam bskyod pas bar chad thams cad sel/ /thogs med mthu stobs mnga' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma rin po che/ / bar chad srung phyir chos skyong bka' sdod sku/ /sgrub pa po la bu bzhin gzigs mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med la phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo sgrib kun sbyong*/ /nyid kyi dpral bar brten pa'i chos 'byung dbyibs/ /sin+dhur thig le yum gcig rnal 'byor ma/ /chos kun bskyed ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// de dbus hrīḥyig dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon/ khams gsum dbang bsgyur mkha' 'gro ma rnams spro/ /'gugs byed bcu gsum yig 'bru'i gsang sngags mchog /'phags ma sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /mi bskyod dbang phyug rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs/ /bcom ldan gshin rje gshed kyi mthu stobs sbyin/ khyod la phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi/ /rtag tu gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /sgrub la bar chad med par byin gyis rlobs/ /chos kun rgyu mar rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rmi lam rang grol 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ / gtum mo'i bde chen 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'od gsal phyag chen rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /bar do'i 'jigs pa sel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bar dor longs sku thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /'gal rkyen thams cad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mthun rkyen thams cad 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/

/thugs yid gnyis su med par byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes bla ma mgon po dbyer med nyid la bstod pa 'di'ang tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gsum pa la'o/ / gcig zhus// bkra shis// dge'o// dge'o// dge'o// ༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor bzlog bsdus pa'i lag len bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon pa'i gtor zor bsdus pa'i lag len ni/ gtor shom sogs gtor chog dang bskang gso gzhung srang*/ lcags snod sogs su dmar gtor zur gsum dbal can khrag gis sbags pa/ yungs kar gyi gang bu dang*/ tsher ma zan ling sogs btsugs/ chos 'byung gru gsum me ri dang bcas pa'am/ stag lpags dang mi lpags sogs kyi steng du stegs bu'i kha la bzhag /sgaus kyi mchod pa bshams/ khrag gam khrag tu rdzus pa'i mchod yon zhabs bsil/ dbang po lnga'i me tog /'khris pa'i dri chab/ zhal zas dmar rgyan can gru gsum sogs drag po'i mchod rdzas bshams/ gtor chog bskang bshags bstod pa tshar gcig song ba'i mtshams su slar yang mchod pa byin rlabs bya ste/ dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tu mos/ gtor ma dkyus bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ denyid gtor chog ltar mgon po 'khor bcas su bskyed cing spyan 'dren mchod bstod bya/ bskang gtor yang gsos/ rgyag gtor la mtheb skyu gru gsum sha khrag gis brgyan pa bdun las mi nyung ba btab/ chab dang nang mchod kyis bran/ gtor ma gsos pa rnams byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs thams cad bkug cing tshar bcad gtor ma la thim pas sha khrag gi rgya mtshor gyur/ dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag nam mkha' gang ba zhal du bstab par mos te/ gtor chog ltar gtor ma 'bul/ shā sa na mang du bzlas/ slar yang bskang gso mchod bstod tshar gcig sogs ji ltar 'os pa bya/ de'i mtshams nas mgon po'i bstod pa ji ltar 'os pa zhig dang*/

'khor gyi bskul rnams bya ste/ hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po yi/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi bka' mnyan pa// gnod sbyin k+ṣe tra pā la ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog smug /phyag g.yas gri gug dgra srog gcod/ /g.yon pa thod snying gtso la stobs/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /dom nag rgyug cing dgra la rngam/ khyod kyis mi thub gang yang med/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa khyod kyis bsrungs/ / dkon mchog dbu 'phang khyod kyis bstod/ /bla ma'i sku dgra khyod kyis sgrol/ / rnal 'byor 'phrin las khyod kyis bsgrubs/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ / drag las dmigs gsal yod na 'di zhes 'jug cing*/ de min/ gnod byed thal ba rdul du rlog / ces brjod/ des rigs bsgres te/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po yis/ /lho'i phyogs kyi= dbang phyug dzi na mi tra ni/ / zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngo/ /phyag g.yas cang te'u mkha' la 'khrol/ / g.yon pa gcod pa'i 'khor lo 'phen/ /spyan rtsa dmar po glog ltar 'khyug / seng ge rgyug cing = khyod kyis= sangs rgyas bstan pa = sogs sngar dang 'dra/ dpal ldan= nub kyi= gshin rje ṭak+ki rā dza ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar/ /phyag g.yas rgyu zhags dgra la 'phen/ g.yon pa sdigs mdzub bgegs la sdigs/ /me 'od 'bar ba'i spyan gsum bgrad/ /stag mo rgyug cing = khyod kyis = dpal ldan= byang gi= srog bsdud trak+shad nag po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog nag /phyag g.yas ru mtshon rtse gsum 'dzin/ /g.yon pa tsan+dan bing chen bsnams/ /rngam brjid khros la 'jigs pa'i sku/ /rta nag rgyug cing = khyod kyis = zhes pas bskul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ snying po'i mthar/ su tiṣ+ṭha dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gtor ma'i lha bris sku'i thugs kar thim/ gtor ma la dgra bgegs bkug pa'i dmigs pa yang bya/ sha khrag gi rgya mtshor gyur pa gong bzhin du bstab/

lhag ma dug dang me dang mtshon cha'i phung po chen por gyur/ de nas sgo dbye bya ste/ hūṃ bka' ni dkon mchog gsum gyis bka'/ /las ni dam can yongs kyi las/ /do nub dgra la zor 'phen gyi// 'byung po thams cad sku zur cig /sgo ba rnams kyis sgo phye zhing*/ /'phrang ba rnams kyis 'phrang sol cig /do nub zor kha gnyan po 'di/ /steng gi lha la mi 'phen no/ /'og gi klu la mi 'phen no/ /bar gyi btsan la mi 'phen no/ /sde brgyad rnams la mi 'phen no/ /yul lha rnams la mi 'phen no/ /sa bdag rnams la mi 'phen no/ /mtho ba rnams ni zhabs bskum shig /dma' ba rnams ni dbu chums shig /bar pa rnams ni sku zur cig/zor 'di sdang ba'i dgra la 'phen/ / zor 'di gnod pa'i bgegs la ya/ zhes sgo phye nas/ sgos mchod rnams 'phen gtor la btab/ chos 'byung yod na de yang phyags te blug /gser skyems dang gtor ma phyi rol du khyer nas/ phyogs skyong bcu'i bskul 'di sgo'i phyi rol tu byas kyang rung ste/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi dur khrod nas/ /dri za 'bum gyi 'khor dang bcas/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ / de khas rigs 'gre ste/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni/ /shar lho= me lha= lho yi= gshin rje= lho nub= srin po= nub kyi= chu lha= nub byang = rlung lha= byang gi= gnod sbyin= byang shar= 'byung po= steng gi= tshangs pa= dpal ldan= 'og gi= sa bdag= khyod kyi= dpal ldan= gnas bdag ma mo'i pho brang nas/ /'jigs byed ma mo chen mo ni/ /mthing nag dre rta rkang gsum chibs/ /phyag na khram shing nad rkyal bsnams/ /'khor du ma mo 'bum gyis bskor/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ re re'i mthar/ dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog / ces pa re sbyar kyang chog / de nas gtor ma rgyag sar khyer nas/ gser skyems dang po nam mkha' mdzod kyis sngags rgyas/ bla ma dkon mchog la 'bul/

gnyis pa sde brgyad spyi la 'bul/ gsum pa yul lha gzhi bdag la 'bul/ bzhi pa lam na gnas pa la 'bul/ lnga pa dgra bgegs kyi lha la byin la/ gdug pa can la bsrung skyob ma byed cig ces bya/ gong gi sgo dbye de las sgo ba rnams kyi sogs tshig gnyis bzha ga / hūṃ dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba'i shar phyogs nas/ khyod kyis bka' gnyan las byed pho nya po/ /mi'i gzugs la srin po'i gdong pa can/ /gnod sbyin k+ṣe tra pā la las mdzod cig / hūṃ dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba'i lho phyogs nas/ khyod kyi bka' gnyan las byed pho nya po/ kha nas dug dang khrag gi zor 'phen pa/ /dbang phyug dzi na mi tra las mdzod cig /des rigs 'gre ste/ nub phyogs nas= mi sha khrag gi dri tshor bzod rlags med/ /gshin rje ṭak+ki rā dza las mdzod cig /hūṃ/ dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba'i byang phyogs nas/ khyod kyi bka'= bdud mgon mi nag rta nag rdzu 'phrul can/ /srog bdud trak+shad nag po las mdzod cig /hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni/ /gri gug 'bar bas dgra sogs gcod/ /thod rlon 'bar bas dgra khrag gsol/ /spu gri rnon pos dgra snying thon/ /cang te'u sgra yis dbang du bsdus/ /tsan+dan bing chen klad la rgyob/ /bdag gi bsam pa'i don sgrubs las/ /gnod byed rdul phran bzhin du mdzod/ /

ces pa'i mthar rol mo'i sgra chen po dang bcas te gtor ma zor du 'phang*/ dmigs pa bla ma'i zhal las blangs/ slar yang log ste/ yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ/ zhes 'byung bzhi'i ra bas lam bcad/ slob dpon gyis rting mnan nas 'ongs/ nang du mchod bstod sogs rjes chog rnams bya'o/ /gtor bzlog bsdus pa'i yi ge 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ / zhus da ga/ dge legs 'phel// ༄༅/ /gtor chog snying po gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ na maḥshrī kā la tsakra ya/ kun mkhyen dol po sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dpal jo nang ba'i lugs kyi gtor chog nyer mkho rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ni/ gtsang zhing bzang ba'i rgyu dam rdzas dang bcas pa la/ spyi bungs skos med du byed na gtor ma gcig gis kyang chog la/ bskos can du byed na/ rgyas pa mgron tshan gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'am/ 'bring po/ bla ma yi dam mgon po dang*/ /rnam sras zhal bzhi mkha' 'gro ma/ /sa bdag gnyis gcig bsrung ma dang*/ /spyi gtor gzhi bdag zhes bya bcu/ zhes pa ltar yang rung mod/ rgyun gtor la lnga tshar du byed pa shas che ba/ lag len ltar bshams/ de yang dus gtor la dam rdzas gal che yang*/ rgyun gtor la ni dkar gtor 'ba' zhig gis kyang chog go /de la nyin zhag de nyid kho na'i thun mtshams gzhan la bdag bskyed sngon du song na/ skabs 'dir snying po ngag tu brjod pa'i sgo nas thun mtshams kyi lhar skad cig gis gsal btab pas chog la/ de ltar ma song na/ bdag bskyed rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang yang rung ba zhig skabs 'dir rnal 'byor du bya'o/ /de nas dngos gzhi la/ thog ma kho nar/ mchod pa dngos su bshams na byin gyis brlabs/ de nas gtor ma rnams byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/ ces pa'am/ oṃ phreṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ badz+ra dhā twī shwa rī/ ga ga na swa bhā wa sarba drā bya bi sho dha ni/

sarba dra bya ṇi bi sho dha ya hūṃ phreṃ phaṭa/ ces pas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las mi mgo'i sgyed pu la gnas pa'i oṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ thod pa dum bu gcig pa/ de'i nang gi dbus su a las byang sems/ shar du i las rkang dmar/ lhor ṛ las rak+ta/ byang du u las dri chu/ nub tu l̥ las dri chen/ rlung mtshams su l̥̄ las glang po che'i sha /dbang ldan du ū las ba glang gi sha /bden bral du ṝ las rta'i sha /me mtshams su ī las khyi'i sha /dbus kyi steng du ā las mi'i sha /lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ sku rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od zer gyis ma dag pa'i rdzas rnams sbyangs par gyur/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sarba dharma bi shud+dha swa bhā ba sarba dharman bi sho dha ya swāhā/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du nyi ma la gnas pa'i āḥgasung rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od zer gyis dag pa'i rdzas rnams spel bar gyur/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra sūr+ya sarba dharma pra bo dha ka sarba dharmaṇa pra bo dha ya swāhā/ lag pa gnyis ka sbyar ba'i dbus su/ sgra can gyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūṃ thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od kyis rdzas rnams sbar bar gyur/ oṃ hūṃ badz+ra a na la sarba dharma pra dī pa ka sarba dharmaṇa pra dī pa ya swāhā/ mkha' lding gi phyag rgya'i dbus su dus me la gnas pa'i hoḥyig ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo de'i 'od zer gyis bdud rtsir byas par gyur/ oṃ hoḥsarba dharma badz+ra a mṛ ta ka ra sarba dharma ṇa badz+ra a mṛ taṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ /de nas bla ma'i gtor chog rgyas pa byed na logs su 'byung ba ltar byed dgos pa yin mod kyi/ bla ma yi dam dbyer med la 'bul ba nyid lag len zor yang zhing*/

don la'ang gsang sngags kyi lam la zhugs pa rnams kyis de ltar byed dgos pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid rtsa brgyud bla ma'i ngo bor shes par bya'o/ /de la mgron spyan drangs pa ni/ sangs rgyas yab yum sras dang bcas pa g.yog 'khor dang*/ /grogs bcas gnyen rnams dag gis bskor ba'i tshogs pa ni/ /lha dang lha mo dag gis mnyes par byed rnams dang*/ /mchog gi rdo rje sems dpa' dag ni gshegs su gsol/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ ha hā hi hī badz+ra bhai ra wa ar+ṣa ya ar+ṣa ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ ban dha ya ban dha ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī hri da yaṃ huṃ hūṃ phreṃ phraiṃ phaṭa/ ces pas mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ sngags tsam gyi sgo nas mchod pa bcu gnyis 'bul te/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ nas/ kā maṃ gyi bar brjod/ de nas gtor ma dang po dkyil 'khor la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥshrī kā la tsakra/ badz+ra bhai ra wa bhi ka rā ya sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes rdo rje'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs la/ de nas yang*/ rdo rje'i phyag rgyas 'bul ba ni/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ ak+ṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ te dza ā ga t+ya sa pa ri wā raḥ shī ghaṃ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ gṛh+ṇa tu/ khā dan+tu pi : wastu £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· wan+tu/ £© dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ saṃ trib ta/ sarba satwā nāṃ/ shān tiṃ/ puṣ+tiṃ/ rak+ṣaṃ/ a wā ra ṇa/ gup+tiṃ/ kurban+tu/ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra/ ā dz+nyā pa ya ti swāhā/ rdo rje'i phyag rgyas khro bo spyan drang ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ uṣ+ṇī ṣa/ suṃ bha ni sum+bha bigh+nān an+ta ka /nī la daṇ+ḍa pradz+nyā an+ta ka ṭak+ki rā dza/ pad+ma an+ta ka a tsa la/ ya ma an+ta ka mahā ba le bh+yaḥ gri gug gi phyag rgyas zad par spyan drang ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ

ā kā sha bā yu/ te dza/ u da ka pri thi wī/ sā dhi bh+yaḥ ral gri'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ prah+ma/ biṣ+ṇu/ ni ri t+ya/ wa yu/ ya ma/ ag+ni/ sa mu dra/ ī shwa ra/ in+d+ra/ yak+ṣe bh+yaḥ rin po che'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ ra hu/ kā la ag+ni/ tsan+d+ra/ sur+ya/ bu dha/ maṃ ga la/ shu kra/ pri has pa ti/ ke tu sha ni bh+yaḥ pad+ma'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ dza ya/ bi dza ya/ pad+ma karko ṭa/ ba su ki sha ཾ kha pā la/ ku li ka a nan+ta/ ta k+ṣa ka mahā pad+me bh+yaḥ 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ be tā ṭa/ bi kri ta mu kha/ shwa/ kā ka sū ka ra/ gri dha/ byā gh+ra/ ū lu ka dzaṃ bu ka ga ru ḍa/ mu khe bh+yaḥ zhes pa rnams kyi mthar/ sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ ak+ṣa tāṃ/ da dā ma he/ te dza ā ga t+ya/ sa pā ri wa raḥ shī gh+raṃ/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gṛh+ṇa tu/ kha dan+tu/ bi wān+tu/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ saṃ trib tā/ sarba satwā nāṃ/ shān+tiṃ/ puṣ+tiṃ/ rak+ṣaṃ a bā rar+ṇa/ gup+tiṃ/ kurban+tu huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra ādz+nyā pa ya tī swāhā/ phyi mchod ni/ badz+ra bhai ra wa bhīskā rā ya/ sa pā ri wā ra bh+yaḥ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra dhū paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra dī paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra nai bi t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra ak+ṣa taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra lā s+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra hā s+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra wa t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra nai ri t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra gī taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis 'bul/ nang mchod ni/ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra wa/ ha ya ra wa la/ nga nya ṇa ma na/ gha dzha ḍha bha dha/ ga dza ḍa ba da/ kha tsha ṭha pha tha/ ka tsa ṭa pa ta/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bstod pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par mdzad/ /dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po/ / dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can/ khams gsum rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /rje bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin/

khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyi gtso/ /dus mtha'i sprin mtshung he ru kā /rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam dag chos kyi dbyings la ma g.yos kyang*/ /thugs rje chen pos rngam pa'i skur ston zhing*/ /bdud dang nyon mongs snying khrag gsol mdzad pa'i/ khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs la 'dud/ / dpal ldan gtsug gtor gnod mdzes shin tu stobs/ /dbyug sngon rmugs byed 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang*/ khengs byed mi g.yo rengs byed stobs po che/ /rab brjid khro rgyal bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha' rlung me chu dang sa rnams kyi// zad par bsnyes pa rnam pa gnyis gnyis te/ /phyogs bcu rang rang 'byung ba'i gdan bzhugs pa'i/ /grub pa chen po bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug bden bral rlung lha dang*/ /gshen rje me lha rgya mtsho drag po dang*/ /lha yi dbang po dang ni gnod sbyin te/ /phyogs skyong chen po bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgra gcan dus me zla ba nyi ma dang*/ /gza' lhag bkra shis pa sangs phur bu dang*/ / du ba mjug rings dang ni spen pa ste/ /gza' mchog chen po bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba rnam rgyal stobs rgyu pad+ma dang*/ /nor rgyas dung skyong mtha' yas rigs ldan dang*/ /'jog po dang ni pad+ma chen po ste/ /klu rgyal chen po bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ro langs grul bum khyi dang bya rog dang*/ /phag dang bya rgod stag dang 'ug pa dang*/ /lce spyang nam mkha' lding gi gdong can te/ /'byung po chen po bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde drug srung ma drug cu 'khor bcas la/ /mchod gtor 'di dang dri dang me tog dang*/ /bdug spos snang gsal ma nyams bdag 'bul gyi/ /de rnams 'khor dang bcas pa tshur byon la/ /gtor ma 'di rnams len zhing gsol ba dang*/ /btung bar mdzad de shin tu mnyes pa yis/ /'gro la zhi rgyas srung skyobs sba ba rnams/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin mdzad du gsol/

/klu dang 'byung pos lus kyi khams bsrung zhing*/ /gza' dang phyogs skyong ngag gi khams bsrung ste/ /zad par khro bos sems kyi khams bsrung zhing*/ khams drug ldan pas khams kun rab bsrungs nas/ /'khor lo drug tu rlung sems rab 'chings te/ /rgyal ba rigs drug go 'phang myur thob shog/ gnyis pa dpal mgon po nag po chen po 'khor bcas la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyang la/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su/ dur khrod chen po'i dbus su dgra bgegs thams cad mnan pa'i steng du/ paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūṃ mthing nag las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po chen po dus kyi mun pa lta bu'i sku mdog can/ che zhing cher 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis char gyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi gan+dhe bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan dang lhab lhub kyis klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel ba'i 'dug stangs kyi ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag /g.yon na khyi nag /rgyab na lcags spyang*/ mdun na mi nag steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'khor las byed sprul pa yang sprul/ sde brgyad kyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'o//de'i g.yon du maṃ las e ka dza ti sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/

dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs shing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du/ traka las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa/ sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung*/ gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing*/ ba glang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang po'i ske rags bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul dang*/ g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le dang*/ zhag gi zo ris dang*/ thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid cing*/ lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char ba/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūṃ dang bh+yoḥ'i sgra sgrogs pa'o/ /gzhan yang lcam dral gsum gyi sku'i mtha' bskor du/ dgug gzhug bcing mnyes mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro chen mo bzhi/ sku gsung thugs kyi rnam 'phrul pho nya bye ba grangs med pa'i tshogs dang phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ lha dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ gshin rje dang*/ ma mo la sogs pa/ lha srin sde brgyad kyis yongs su bskor bar gyur/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas ya dang*/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas maṃ mdun du spros pa las/ ya las nag po gnod sbyin g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon spar ba gdengs pa'i lag mthil nas nyi ma 'char ba/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gyon zhing*/ gser gyi sna cha can/ de'i g.yon du maṃ las nag mo gnod sbyin g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang*/

g.yon spar ba gdengs pa'i lag mthil nas zla ba 'char ba/ dar nag gi na bza' dang*/ byi ru'i lan tshar can/ de gnyis kyi thugs ka nas yab las tri gnyis dang*/ yum las bh+yoḥgacig spros pa las/ pu ṭa ming sring gsum du gyur te/ de dag gi mdun du 'khod pa ni/ tri las pu ṭa nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas shang lang gri ring 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa klad khrag drod mos gang bar 'dzin zhing zhal du gsol ba/ men kre'i ga sha dang*/ dar nag gi na bza' can/ tri las bha ṭa nag po/ dar gyi ga zha dang*/ stag slog gyon pa/ g.yas dam shing dang*/ g.yon mi snying 'dzin zhing gsol ba/ bh+yoḥlas sring mo ral gcig ma/ g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang*/ g.yon rgyu ma 'dzin zhing*/ mig nas khrag 'dzag pa/ kha nas me 'bar ba/ lnga char yang sku mdog mthing nag mon bu pho mo'i cha lugs can/ mi mgo'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ rab tu khros la rngam zhing 'khrugs pas gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus na 'gying ba'o/ /de'i mtha' skor du/ g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa dge slong gi gzugs can brgya/ slad kyi rjes su 'brang ba ban de nag po phur thogs brgya/ mdun gyi bshul byang 'dren pa bud med nag mo brgya/ gzhan yang dam nyams kyi rjes gcod pa'i bya nag

khyi nag / lce spyang la sogs pa pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo dang*/ rdo rje gdan gyi spo nas las mgon dang*/ gzhan yang dur khrod chen po brgyad dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gdan sa khyad par can rnams nas/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mgon po sku gshegs gdan las bzhengs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*/ /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya e h+ye hi/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ bh+yoḥ lha mo sku gshegs nas/ gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ mahā kā li de bī e h+ya nas/ s+t+waṃ/ las mgon sku gshegs nas/ gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ kā la yak+ṣa ye/ kā lī yak+ṣa si/ yak+ṣa pu ṭa ye/ ru ṭa bha ṭa ya/ ru lu rak+ṣa si/ e h+ya nas/ s+t+waṃ/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ mahā kā li de bi ye/ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba mgon po'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang*/ thal mo sor mo'i rtse mo bsnol ba lha mo'i dam rgya'o/ / oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ mahā kā li de bī ye/ sa ma ye sma ra sa ma ye/ ma ti kra ma ye/ sa ma ye rak+ṣan+tu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba dang*/

lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi bas 'dul du ma 'tshal na/ gang la gang 'tshams pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang*/ bskrad cing gzir ba dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ sdigs shing spa skong bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam sbyor chos dang mthun pa'i yid bzhin du grub cing*/ bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ kā la yak+ṣa nas/ rak+ṣa si/ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ mgon po'i dam rgya'am/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ kā la yak+ṣa sogs la/ sa ma ya sma ra sogs btags/ las kyi mgon po bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad nas/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ gyi bar gong bzhin las bcol/ bar 'dir bzlas pa byed na/ man ngag bzhin dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ mahā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ ces yi ge bdun pa dang*/ oṃ mahā kā la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes yi ge bcu gcig pa dang*/ rtsa ba'i sngags shā sa na yang bzla/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba dhod si ka ma la rak+sha sī hūṃ bh+yoḥ zhes lha mo dang*/ a li a li ma dza dza shaṃ shaṃ li shi ded a shwa ded mo rmugs pu ṭi a li ma dza dzaḥ nag mo sha la rubs dza dzaḥ zhes dregs pa pho rgyud kyi 'bod sngags dang*/ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la a shug me ma hūṃ ma bh+yoḥdza dzaḥ zhes dregs pa mo rgyud kyi 'bod sngags rnams kyang ci rigs par bzla'o/ /de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ mahā kā la ya/ mahā kā li de bī ye/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ gṛh+ṇe daṃ bā liṃ da ye swāhā/ gong ltar mchod/

yang na/ na maḥsarba 'i tshab tu/ a kā ro btags pas phul kyang rung ngo*/ /de bzhin du/ oṃ kā la yak+ṣa sogs kyi mthar nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags sam/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis las mgon rnams la phul/ de nas rak+ta dang phud gtor zhing*/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ shā sa na u pa ha ri ṇi e ṣo a piṣ+tsa ma ka lo/ a yaṃ i daṃ/ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa ka ri ṇi/ ya ti pra ti dz+nyā sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+tan kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban dha ban dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na mi ke na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba dhod si ka ma la rak+ṣa si hūṃ bh+yoḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ a li a li ma sogs dang*/ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la sogs brjod/ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūṃ/ srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer gsum brtsegs 'jigs byed pa/ /gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che/ /gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas// g.yon pa gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod/ /thod 'phreng can la bdag bstod do/ /khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yos/ /'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bsgyel/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa'i/ /dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /dpal ldan mgon po mahā kā la ya/ /lha chen dpal 'bar nag po mthu bo che/ /mahā de ba'i sras po drag shul can/ /tshogs bdag chen po mahā kā lā ya/ / legs ldan nag po grong khyer sum brtsegs dgra/ /bstan pa yongs kyi bsrung ma nag po che/ /chos 'khor yongs kyi srog shing nag po che/ /dam tshig can gyi dgra lha nag po che/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /'dzam bu ti ba'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig /sman rag phud kyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyan por 'bul/ /da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs gnyan por bzhes//

'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang*/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams mang po/ /thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las rnams myur du sgrubs/ zhes dang*/ bh+yoḥ gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi mthus/ /'dod pa'i khams ku na zilamanan nas/ /'dod pa'i khams la dbang bsgyur ma/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ /dpal ldan lha mo khyed kyi sku/ /ri rab lhun po lta bur brjid/ /dbang po sngon po lta bur 'bar/ /nyi ma'i zer ltar sprul pa 'gyed/ / dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /spyan rtsa dmar po klog ltar 'khyug /mi ro khar bcug mche ba gtsigs/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ /'jigs pa'i mtshon chas phyag rnams brel/ /mi mgo rin chen rus pas spras/ /klu dbang seng ge lcags sgrog dang*/ khrag dang zhag gi thig les brgyan/ /ko rlon re lde gos su gyon/ /bong bu gwa zhon mtshan mo rgyu/ /shin tu rid cing mi sdug ma/ /'jigs gzugs ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod kyi gsung gi nga ro'i dbyangs/ /'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra sgrogs pas/ khams gsum ma lus zil mnan nas/ /sa gsum g.yo bar mdzad la 'dud/ khyod thugs zhi la rab gzhol yang*/ /snying rje'i dbang gis srid la bzhugs/ khro dang 'khrugs dang rngam pa yis/ /bdud dpung nges par 'joms la 'dud/ /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag / 'dir gshegs sogs kyis bstod cing 'phrin las bcol/ gnod sbyin yab yum 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /rngam shing 'khrugs pa'i cha lugs kyis/ /bdud dang dgra bgegs 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /bstan srungs yab yum che la bstod/ / mon bu pu ṭa nag po skyod/ /men kri'i ga sha sku la gsol/ /sher shing seg shing phyag na bsnams/ /pu ṭa nag po khyod la bstod/ /mon bu bha ṭa stag slog bkra/ / dar gyi ga sha sku la gsol/ /phyag na dam shing rnon po bsnams/

/mon bu bha ṭa khyod la bstod/ /mon mo gser gyi spu gri ma/ /nag mo chen mo kha 'bar ma/ / phyag na gser gyi spu gri bsnams/ /nag mo khyod la bdag bstod do/ /bud med nag mo chen mo brgya/ /gshegs kyi de ni bshul yang 'dren/ /g.yas kyi phyogs nas ru 'dren pa/ /skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ /g.yon gyi phyogs nas ru 'dren pa/ /dge slong nyan thos dgra bcom brgya/ /slad kyi rjes 'brang 'jigs rung ba/ /ban de nag po phur thog brgya/ /'khor bcas rnams la bstod pa 'bul/ /skabs gsum bdag kyang bstod pa 'bul/ /las kyi mgon po pho nya 'khor bcas rnams/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig / sogs gong bzhin 'phrin las bcol/ bsdu na 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi zhes pa so so la sbyar la/ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ /sha khrag dmar gyi sogs lan gcig gis 'phrin las bcol lo/ /gsum pa rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ slar yang*/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa dz+wa la raṃ dz+wa la raṃ phaṭa raṃ phaṭa raṃ/ zhes phyogs kun tu bsangs gtor bya/ rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ byang phyogs nas rgyal po rnam thos sras gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon ni/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ bai shrā ma ṇa sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil nas/ rol mo 'i bar/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar du spel/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs rgyun bshags bya/ bdag nyid kyi gnas gsum nas/ 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i gnas gsum du thim pas/ 'od du zhu nas stong pa nyid du gyur/

oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ rnams las/ srung 'khor 'byung bzhi brtsegs pa gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du/ bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i pho brang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ kha nang ltas khor yug tu bskor ba'i/ shar shel/ lho baiḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga /byang 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser las grub pa/ phyogs re re nas ka ba nyis stong lnga brgya lnga brgyas btegs pa'i gdung ring dang*/ gdung thung gis mdzes par phub pa/ phyi rol du dpyangs pa'i dra ba dra phyed/ pha gu/ shar bu/ mda' yab sogs rgyan thams cad dang bcas pa/ dbus su rin po che'i khang bzang sum brtsegs su yod pa/ sa 'og tu gter gyi khang pa bco lnga dang bcas pa/ phyi rol du 'khor sa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ 'khor sa dang po la phyogs mtshams brgyad du khang bzang brgyad/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du bum pa bzang po brgyad/ dpag bsam gyi shing brgyad/ rin po che'i ljon shing brgyad/ rdzing bu bzang po ljon shing dang me tog ldan pa brgyad/ 'dod 'jo'i ba mo brgyad rnams spel mar gnas pa/ phyi rol rin po che'i ra bas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /dbus kyi pho brang gi nang du hrīḥlas sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i saṃ las seng ge dkar po/ de'i steng du bai ser po las yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ rin po che'i mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan bai yig gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ 'jig rten khams kyi dpal dang 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus te bai yig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyal po chen po ngal gsos po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/

g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i char 'bebs pa bsnams pa/ ne'u le la mig mngon du phyogs pa'i seng ge dkar po lus nyams rtsal dang ldan pa/ nyal stabs su gnas pa'i steng na rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ zhal nas 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs pa/ nyi ma 'bum dus gcig tu shar ba lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ rin po che'i thor tsugs dang*/ dbu rgyan la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yas nas nyi ma dang*/ g.yon nas zla ba 'char ba/ mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa'i sku can du gyur pa la/ lha klu gnod sbyin mthu bo che du ma dang*/ gnod sbyin bye bas bskor ba'o/ /phyogs mtshams kyi khang pa brtsegs pa brgyad la/ shar du dzaṃ las dzaṃ bha la ser po rin po che bsnams pa/ lhor paṃ las gang ba bzang po ser po rin po che'i bum pa gang ba 'dzin pa/ nub tu maṃ las nor bu bzang po dkar po nor bu 'dzin pa/ byang du keṃ las ku be ra nag po ral gri 'dzin pa/ shar lhor saṃ las yang dag shes ser po ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub du gaṃ las 'brog gnas nag po rin po che'i mdung dmar 'dzin pa/ nub byang du paṃ las lnga rtsen ser skya khang brtsegs 'dzin pa/ byang shar du paṃ las 'dzam po 'khyil pa dkar po/ g.yas gri dang*/ g.yon phub 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le bsnams shing*/ rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rta la chibs shing*/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa/ dpa' zhing brjid la/ mi sdug pa'i cha byad can/ de rnams kyang rang rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa/ 'khor sa bar pa na/ klu chen brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ 'khor sa tha ma na lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs rnams sku mdog ma nges pa/ mi sdug cing brjid la rngam pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa/ 'khor sa tha ma de nyid kyi nang rim na/ ded dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad po thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar nag ral gri dang phub 'dzin pa rnams dang*/
