phyi rim la stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis po thams cad sku mdog ljang nag go cha dang bcas pa/ mdung dang ral gri 'dzin pa rnams rang rang gi 'khor tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa/ thams cad kyang g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pas/ sgrub pa po la dngos grub kyi char 'bebs pa'o/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'od zer gyi sne la khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa byung ste/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ mgon po kun gshegs thugs dam can/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /thams cad nyon mongs 'dam bying bas/ /mtshams med lnga ni kun spyod cing*/ / gzigs shing gshegs pa'i gnas ngan kyang*/ /shākya seng ge'i spyan sngar khyod/ / thugs dam gang bzhes de dgongs la/ /'dren pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ / sems can kun la sman slad du/ /byang phyogs gnas na bzhugs pa rnams/ / sems can don phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ bai shrā ma ṇa sa pā ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ bai swāhā/ oṃ bai shrā ma ṇa ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ bai

ring po brjid dang ldan pa mig 'dzum sum cu so gnyis kyi yun tshad du brjod/ a mṛ ta 'i sngags kyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ rgyal po'i thugs kar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi 'dab ma re re la bai bzhi bzhi/ bdag mdun gyi thugs 'od zer gyi lcags kyus sbrel bar gyur/ oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes cod pan gyi dbang bskur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis gong bzhin phul/ bstod pa ni/ mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri steng na/ /bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngal gsos dge ba stobs po che/ /sa brgyad dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ /btsun mo bzhi dang sras bzhi dang*/ khyad par las sgrub gnod sbyin brgyad/ /nor mchog ster ba'i klu chen brgyad/ / lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ / dgra bgegs ma lus gzhom pa dang*/ /'byor pa'i longs spyod phun tshogs shing*/ /'dod dgu yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /gzhan don lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ / de nas bzlas pa la spro na/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ cung zad bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ bai shrā ma ṇa ye swāhā/ gtso bo'i snying po'o/ / oṃ dzam bha la ye swāhā/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha dra ye swāhā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ye swāhā/ oṃ ku be ra ye swāhā/ oṃ saṃ pra dza na ye swāhā/ oṃ gu h+ya s+tha na ye swāhā/ oṃ pañtsi ga ye swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ye swāhā/ 'khor gnod sbyin brgyad po rnams kyi sngags so/ /gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha sa bgegs bskrad/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod kyi nang du/ khaṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ de nyid kyi mthar bskor du/ kaṃ las bum pa/ waṃ las khrus kyi rdzing bu/ khaṃ las dpag bsam gyi shing dang*/

'dod 'jo'i ba mo la sogs pas bskor ba dang*/ gtor ma'i steng du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las/ kha dog dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum/ a kā ro sogs dang*/ ro ru sogs dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya rnams lan gsum gsum mam/ bdun bdun gyis rgya chen spel la/ byin rlabs 'di/ 'di nyid rang gi sgos chos su snang bas byas na legs par mngon la/ bsdu na gong du byin rlabs grub pas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ zhes gsal btab pa tsam gyis kyang chog go /rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bai shrā ma ṇa i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha ya swāhā/ zhes lan bdun la sogs pas gtso bo dang*/ oṃ dzam bha la ye i daṃ sogs rang rang so so'i ming sngags spel bas rta bdag brgyad dang*/ oṃ aṣ+ta nā ga sha ta sa ha sra ko ṭi yak+ṣa rāk+ta sa i daṃ sogs kyis 'khor spyi la 'bul/ bsdu na a kā ra ོ'am/ oṃ bai shrā ma ṇa ye sa pa ri bā ra sogs kyis phul kyang chog gnod sbyin rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ /nor la dbang bsgyur 'dod yon char du 'bebs//dbul ba'i gdung sel mgon po thugs rje can/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gyi bar gyis 'phrin las bcol/ /bzhi pa pho nya mgon po zhal bzhi pa la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ swa bha wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su/ paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūṃ las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal brtsegs ma gnyis nag po/ g.yas g.yon gnyis ljang nag

/phyag bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa snying bcas thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri 'bar ba 'debs pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon 'og mas mi rus kyi 'phreng ba 'phyar stabs su bsnams pa/ skra khams pa gyen du brdzes shing*/ spyan gsum pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba rnon po gtsigs pa/ mas mchu 'phyang ba/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang*/ rus pa dang*/ sbrul dang*/ dril bu'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me drag tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ phyogs bzhir yum chen sring mo bzhi/ phyi rol khor yug tu bdud gcod kyi bshan pa nyer gcig /bdud 'dul gyi dmag nyis khri chig stong*/ dregs pa sder brgyad kyi tshogs dang bcas pas bskor bar gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ te se bsil ba'i tshal/ po ta la/ ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod rnams nas/ zhing skyong stobs 'phrog dbang po zhal bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /gtum po khyod kyis ji ltar khas blangs bzhin/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ mahā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta hūṃ phaṭa/ sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ zhes pa nas/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ gyi bar gur lcam dral gyi gtor chog bzhin las/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la mahā kā li de wi zhes pa'i tshab tu/ oṃ mahā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta zhes 'don pa spo/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya 'ching ba yin no/ /de bzhin du/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i sngags ni/

oṃ mahā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta/ ḍoṃ bhi ni/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ rak+ṣa si/ sing ga li/ de bī sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi phyi mchod bya/ nang mchod kyi skabs snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas 'bul lo/ /bstod 'phrin ni/ hūṃ/ yon tan myur rdzogs dngos grub mnga' ba'i lha/ /ma lus rmad byung phan pa'i dgongs pa can//'phrin las rnam bzhis bdud dpung tshar gcod pa'i/ /legs ldan nag po 'khor dang bcas la 'dud/ /mi rtog dbyings las thugs rjes skur bzhengs shig /'byung ba gur chen brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas nas/ /bde gshegs bka' yi srung ma dam tshig can/ /rdo rje nag po chen po dbyings nas bzhengs/ /dpal ldan dbang ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /mche ba gtsigs shing mchu 'phyang shugs che ba/ /sgra sgrog dril bu'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa yi/ /gdong bzhi ldan khyod te se'i zhing skyong mdzad/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan snga ru/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa/ /yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas/ /sha chen zan dang me tog spos/ /chang phud sha khrag dag gis mchod/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa skyong ba dang*/ /bcol pa'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ / ces 'phrin las bcol/ lnga pa mgron sna tshogs la 'bul ba las/ dang por rdo rje pho nya mo mkha' 'gro ma rnams la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa pa ri bā ra bh+yaḥ i dam/ ba liṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ pra dī paṃ/ ak+ṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ sa pa ri wā raḥ shī gh+raṃ/ a gats+tsha tu/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ i dam bā liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ kha dāṃ tu/ pi wa tu/ sa pa ri wā ra kaḥ sarba satwā nāṃ/ shwan+tiṃ/ puṣ+taṃ/ rak+ṣa a bā ra ṇa/ gup+tiṃ/ ka ro tu/ i daṃ s+thā naṃ/ t+yak+to bā h+ya maṇ+ḍal bhu myaṃ tiṣ+ṭha tu huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/

badz+ra dha ra a dz+nyā pa ya ti swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ yang mkha' 'gro sde lnga la gtor ma rgyud gzhan ltar 'bul ba ni/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā liṃ oṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā liṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā liṃ traṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā liṃ hrīḥphaṭa/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā liṃ āḥphaṭa/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā liṃ hoḥphaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis so/ / ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung*/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag gi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bdag la dge legs dang phun sum tshogs pa thams cad stsal du gsol/ nags sman ma la sogs pa chos skyong 'jig rten las ma 'das pa'i rigs kyi sgos mchod byed par spro na bar 'dir bya'o/

/de nas hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ yul gyi bdag po sa pa ri bā ra/ i dam bā ling sogs/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i gtor sngags thun mong ma yin pa dang 'dra bas yul gyi bdag po 'khor bcas la 'bul/ de bzhin du khyi'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ grong gi bdag po a gats+tsha/ a gats+tsha/ shī gh+raṃ/ i daṃ bā liṃ/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ bhuka twa bi twa trib+tiṃ kri twa sarba satwā nāṃ/ shan+tiṃ/ tsit+taṃ/ kri twa/ swa s+thā naṃ gats+tsha gats+tsha swāhā/ zhes grong bdag tu grags pa zhing skyong la 'bul lo/ /mkha' 'gro spyi gtor du grags pa 'byung po thams cad pa'i spyi gtor ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ phaiṃ/ badz+ra a ral+li ho/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dri sh+ya ho/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa/ bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsa/ un+ma da a pa smā ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i maṃ bā liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya the baṃ/ ya the ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi pa tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba karta ya/ sata su khaṃ bi shud+dha ye/ sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ a lo ke gan+dhai/ nai be t+ya/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /klu yi tshogs= gnod sbyin= srin po'i= 'byung po'i= yi dwags= sha za'i= smyo byed= brjod byed= ma mo'i= mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ / bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis 'ches pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' : bstod [ sdod ] yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i tshogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*/

/mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ / nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ / dpal dang grags dang bskal pa bzang*/ / longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyi bdag la bsrungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / gzhi bdag gtor ma phyi gtor gyi tshul du gtong na/ skabs 'dir byed dgos mod/ yul bdag grong bdag gi gtor ma phul phyin ma byas kyang chog go /de nas rdo rje'i glu ni/ kaul+la e ri ṭa ṭhi/ ā bo la/ mum+mu ṇe ri/ kak+ko la/ gha ṇai/ ṭi bi ṭa ho/ badz+dza i/ ka ru ṇi ka a i/ ṇa ro la/ ta hiṃ bā la/ khadz+dza i/ ga ḍeṃ ma/ a na bi dza/ a i/ ha le ka len dza ra/ pa ni a i/ du dhu ra bidz+dza a i/ tsa u sa ma/ kats+tshu ri/ sih+la/ ka pu ri la i/ a i/ ma la in dha na/ sa liṃ dza/ ta hiṃ bha ru/ kha i a i/ phreng kha na/ khe ṭa ka ran+te/ shud+dha a shud+dha ṇa ma ni/ a i/ ni rang su aṃ ga /tsa ḍa wi/ ta hiṃ dza/ sa ra bā pa ni/ a i/ ma la a dzi/ kun tu ru/ ba ḍa i/ ḍiṇ+ḍi ma/ ta hiṃ na/ badz+dzi a i/ shis pa brjod pa ni/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/

/'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyi mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /steng na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bdud kyi phyogs gnas lha ma yin rnams mchog tu 'jigs byed dang*/ /mi yi 'jig rten dag na phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas khro bo'i rgyal po btsun mor bcas rnams dang*/ /sa 'og dag na gdengs can dbang po gang dag gdon tshogs mi dge dus kun du ni 'ching byed pa/ /de rnams thams cad nyin zhag so so'i dus su mi shes 'jig rten kun nas skyong bar byed gyur cig / smon lam gdab pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig/ sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam nas 'gro ba yis/ /de yi sangs rgyas myur thob shog

/ma sgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog /rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya ci rigs su bzlas la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de yang mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /oṃ khyod kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang nyid la thim/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs kyang bya/ bsod nams 'di yis 'gro rnams du ba la sogs lam gyis lhan skyes bde ba mchog bsgoms te/ /'gro ba'i bla ma sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan ldan sku ni chos kyi 'khor lor yang dag gnas/ /lha rnams mgo bo'i gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od zer tshogs kyis zhabs kyi pad+mo la gtugs shing*/ /dam pa'i lam ston nyin byed bzhin du mun pa kun bcom dus kyi 'khor lo nyid gyur cig /nyi ma dang bcas thub pa'i rigs rnams kyis ni shes rab ye shes thob par gyur ni ji ltar bar/ /rnam gsum srid par gnas pa'i sems can rnams ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i drin las e waṃ nyid gyur cig /skyes bu gang dag bdud kyi grogs kyis rtag tu mi bden mun par song zhing lam nyams pa/ /de rnams thams cad lam 'di thob nas rdo rje nor bu'i khyim dang ring ba min par 'ong gyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag cag rnal 'byor ma thob rab tu g.yo ba'i yid kyis gal te shi bar gyur na yang*/ /dpal ldan mi yi 'jig rten du ni rab mchog thub pa'i rigs su rnal 'byor ldan par skye ba dang*/ /sngon gyi goms pa de yis slar yang ye shes rnal 'byor yangs pa dag ni kun du 'dzin pa dang*/ /ye shes thob nas mi zad mchog gi gnas su rab 'gro gang du slar yang skye ldan min gyur cig

/dgra dang seng ge glang chen dbang po me dang ltos 'gro'i bdag dang chom rkun zhags pas 'ching*/ /chu gter 'khrugs dang sha za 'chi ba'i 'jigs byed nad dang dbang po'i nye bar 'tshe ba dang*/ / dbul dang bud med dang bral mi bdag 'khrugs pa'i 'jigs dang rdo rje ltung dang don nyams rnams/ /bdag gis rnal 'byor ma rnams zhabs ni gsal bar dran pa'i mthu las rab tu nyams gyur cig /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dus kyi 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yis sa la 'khod par shog /rigs su skye dang dam tshig can/ /smyo med dus kyi 'khor lo ston/ /bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*/ /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam za can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /mgo bor bla ma'i cod pan 'chang*/ /lag tu rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzlas/ / yid kyis zung 'jug sgom par shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ /des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig / ces smon lam btab ste/ slar yang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs pa brjod do/ /yang gang dag chos skyong dmigs gsal can mi bsten zhing*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo kho na'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas ni/ sgrub thabs su bshad pa'i gtor chog de kho nas chog ste/ gtso bo khro bo bcu dang bcas pa la gtor ma phul bas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha mtha' dag la phul bar 'gyur zhing*/ zad par phyogs skyong gza' dang klu 'khor dang bcas pa la phul bas/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po mtha' dag la phul bar 'gyur bas/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i spyi gtor rgyas pa yin la/ 'byung po bcu ni phyogs bcu'i mgon po yin zhing*/ de rnams la phul bas/

mgon po spyi gtor du 'gyur zhing*/ dpal lha mor grags pa'i rigs rnams kyang*/ phyogs bcu'i rab gtum mor 'dus pa dang*/ de rnams 'byung po bcu'i yum yin pas/ nag po chen po lcam dral gyi rigs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad de la tshang ngo*/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma spyi la gtor chog dngos su gsal ba ltar yin la/ yul bdag grong bdag la gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs mtha' dag 'dus pa'i phyir/ de tsam gyis gtor ma'i cho ga ma tshang ba med pa mtha' dag grub pa yin no/ /de ltar bris pa'i dge bas/ 'gro ba thams cad myur du sangs rgyas kyis go 'phang thob par gyur cig/// gtor chog snying po gsal ba 'di/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas sbyar ba'o/ / bkra shis // maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /bskang gso'i chog sgrig 'phrin las rnam rol bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun mkhyen jo nang ba chen po shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir gtor chog snying po gsal ba dang rjes su 'brel bar/ yi dam dang bstan srung khyad par can rnams mchod pa'i bskangs bshags kyi go rim cung zad gcig bshad par bya la/ de la so so thad ka'i tshig rnams ni/ sngon byon gong ma skyes bu mchog rnams kyis mdzad pa nyid byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'gran zla med pa yin pas/ de dag la bcos bslad dang*/ rang blos gsar du brtags pa'i tshig sbyor lhur byed pa spangs shing*/ go rim ma 'khrugs par sgrig pa dang*/ tshig rgya chen po dag gi snying po cung zad bsdus nas brjod do/ /'di la don tshan bcu gsum las/ dang po yo byad bshams pa ni/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi skabs so so'i dkyil 'khor dang 'brel bar dgos kyang*/ bskangs bshags tsam la/ dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus rnams ma 'grub na/ bris sku'am maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa rten gang rung la brten pas chog cing*/

mchod gtor las gzhan pa'i rten med kyang*/ bskang bshags tsam la mi rung ba ma yin no/ /des na/ gzhan rnams man ngag gi yi ge rnams las shes par bya la/ 'dir dang por phud :lo £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· la £© yi dam 'khor bcas kyi gtor ma dang*/ dkon mchog spyi la 'bul rgyu'i zhal zas sogs bya/ de rjes chos skyong bsrung ma ye shes kyi gtor ma dang zhal zas sogs bzhengs/ de rjes chos skyong 'jig rten pa yod na de'i gtor ma dang*/ de nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang*/ lhag ma la sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs bya'o/ /de la yi dam gtor ma ni/ zlum gtor brjid bag can la bshos bu drug gis bskor ba'am/ gtso bo'i gtor ma'i mdun du bshos bu drug ltar byed pa'i lugs kyang yod/ rtag gtor du byed na thams cad zur gsum du byed pa yin kyang*/ dkyus la zlum gtor du bya zhing*/ mgon po'i gtor ma las cung zad tshad chung bar bya zhing*/ de'i tshe/ stegs bu lhag par mtho bar byas pas/ chos skyong gi gtor ma rnams las rtse mo mtho ba 'ong bar bya/ yi dam gyi gtor ma'i g.yon phyogs stegs dma' bar/ chos skyong gi gtor ma rnams bshams par bya ste/ dang por dpal gur gyi mgon po la/ gtor ma nor gzugs ma'am/ snying gzugs mar grags pa/ rtsa ba zlum la rgyas pa/ sum cha yan chad sked pa ngos rnams zlum shing rgyas la/ zur gsum dbal du dod pa/ rtse mo zlum po cung zad rno ba'i tshul du bya/ de'i rtsa ba pad 'dab kyi rnam pa can nam/ zan leb gru bzhi'i rnam pa can gyi 'theb skyus bskor/ dpal lha mo 'khor du sgrub pa yin pas/ gtor ma logs pa med kyang chog /ci ste byed na/ snga ma dang mtshungs par byed pa'i lugs kyang yod mod/ gru gsum du mdzad pa legs par mthong ste/ mgon po'i gtor ma'i g.yon du bshams/ de'i g.yon du/ rnam thos sras kyi gtor ma rgya nag ma ltar khang bzangs su byed na/

rten gtor la sum thog dgos kyang*/ 'bul gtor la thog gcig ma sogs ji ltar bde bas rung zhing*/ 'on kyang bskang gso tsam la de ltar ma 'grub na zlum gtor gyis chog cing*/ rgya gar ma la gtor ma 'di kho na yin zhes grags so/ /de yang dkar gtor du mdzad pa'i lag len shas che zhing*/ sha gtsang mas rgyan du rung bar yang bshad pas/ de ltar yang bya la/ dbyibs zlum po/ rtsa ba rgyas pa/ rtse mo ha cang rno ba yang ma yin pa dbus ldir zhing*/ rtse mo dang dbus kyi mtshams phyed pa/ rtsa ba'i mtha' bskor du zan leb phra mos bskor ba/ gtso 'khor thams cad de la 'dus pa'am/ 'khor gyi gtor ma logs su byed na/ bshos phran brgyad kyis bskor bar byed/ zhal bzhi pa la bskang ba byed na de'i g.yon du bshams te/ gur gyi mgon po'i gtor ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyogs bzhir bshos phran zur gsum re dang*/ mtshams bzhir zan gyi thod gzugs re byed pa yang yod cing*/ dbus kyi gtor ma yang zur gsum 'phra rings su byed pa'i lugs kyang yod pa spyir 'dam ka yin kyang*/ 'di nyid chos skyong gi gtso bor byed na snga ma dang*/ chos skyong gong ma'i las mkhan du 'dogs na phyi ma ltar legs so/ /bskang gso mi byed par gtor 'bul tsam byed pa yin na/ thun gtor bshams pa kho nas chog pas/ gtor ma chen po mi dgos/ las mkhan pu ṭa sogs la/ lcam dral gyi gtor ma'i 'phro nas bsngo ba yin pas/ sgos bskang dang sgos sgrub kyi skabs ma gtogs/ sgos gtor nges par bshams dgos pa ni ma yin/ bsham par spro na/ dkyus de la mi bsham par/ stegs bu dma' ba la/ lha mo'i gtor ma'i mdun tsam du zur gsum lnga tshar ram gcig bshams/ lnga tshar du byed na dbus ma mtho bar bya/ sngar gyi gral gyi 'phros la mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang*/ gzhi bdag gtor ma rnams/ zlum gtor 'phra ring re bya/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gzhan yod na/ pu ṭa sogs la bshams pa ltar mdun du bshams par bya'i/

dkyus la sgrig pa mi legs par mthong ngo*/ /de dag gi mdun du mchod pa rnams bshams par bya ste/ de yang yi dam gyi gtor ma'i mdun nam mtha' bskor du/ mchod pa bcu gnyis sam spyi 'gros kyang rung ste/ g.yon bskor du bshams/ chos skyong rnams la bsgos mchod re re 'grub na legs kyang*/ bsdu na gcig gis chog cing mchod pa de'i phyi rol du/ spyi mchod snod che ba gcig tu bshams/ shin tu bsdu na spyi mchod tsam la bsdus pas chog / yang cung zad spro na/ mgon po la dam rdzas dang 'brel ba'i mchod pa dang*/ rnam thos sras la gtsang ma'i mchod pa bshams na yang legs/ mtho dman gang yang rung bar/ mgon po'i gtor ma'i g.yas kyi thad kar/ man dzi sogs la ka pā lar ka phud kyis bkang ba dang*/ g.yon gyi thad kar sman phud kyis bkang ba bzhag go /gzhan yang spyan gzigs sna tshogs bgram/ dbang po lnga'i me tog la sogs pa sgom don dang mthun pa'i bris pa'am/ rang la 'dus byas pa nges par bshams/ sgrub pa po'i mdun du rdor dril dang nang mchod sogs cha tshang bar bshams/ bskang gso zhag sbrel du byed na/ nub tha ma ma gtogs thun gtor rgyas pa gal che/ nub gcig ma la yang*/ dam rdzas kyi rnam grangs yin pas thun gtor re dgos shing*/ de yang srung ma drug bcu'i thun gtor zlum po'am gru gsum dkar gtor gcig dang*/ mgon po la gru gsum dang*/ rnam thos sras la zlum gtor sho lu lta bu bya/ de dag gshoms spyir ji bde ba yin gyi nges can med na'ang*/ bskang ba las mtho sar mi bsham mo/ / bskang gso dang mchod sprin gyi tshig rigs la yod pa'i mchod rdzas bsham par 'os pa rags rim rnams dngos su yod na bshams pas legs shing*/ ci ste dngos su med na/ bris thang ngam/ gzugs 'gros kyi tshul kyis kyang bsham pa gal che'o/ /gnyis pa cho ga spyi'i sngon 'gro chos gnyis ni/ de nas sgrub pa po rnams tshogs la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/

gnas dang yo byad byin rlabs byed dgos te/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho gar blta bar bya'o/ /gsum pa bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa ni/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la rten pa byed na/ bsrung 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa la rten pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la rten pa dang*/ thugs dkyil tsam la rten pa nas/ lhan skyes kyi bar gang gis kyang rung mod/ bsrung 'khor la rten pa dang*/ gtso rkyang zhal phyag yongs rdzogs la rten pa gtso che zhing*/ phyis gzhan du shes par 'gyur la/ dang po ltar na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams sngon du btang*/ rdo rje'i zhal dag pa'i cho ga nas bzung*/ mthar bsrung 'khor yongs su rdzogs kyi bar byas kyang rgyas shing legs par 'gyur la/ 'on kyang 'di la/ gong du sngon 'gro gtor ma btang zin na/ 'dir yul bdag grong bdag gi gtor ma mi dgos la/ 'dir de byed par spro na/ gong gi de mi dgos kyang*/ lag len spyi dang mthun par sngon 'gro gtor ma btang nas/ 'dir yul bdag gi gtor ma mi mdzad do/ /'on kyang rdo rje'i zhal dag pa/ rigs drug dgod pa nas/ bdud bsreg pa'i bar/ cho ga lugs gzhan yin pas ma 'grub kyang chog la/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar/ bdag nyid dus kyi 'khor lor gsal ba'i thugs kar zhes pa nas/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa'i bar gyi tshogs bsags gnyis byas nas/ stong pa'i ngang las haṃ las byung ba'i zhes pa nas brtsams te/ ring du bros par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar gyi phur btab yan chad rdzogs par byas/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs kyis bstod/ bar 'dir bzlas pa gang yang rung ba zhig gang nus bya/ slar yang mngon rtogs bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/ 'byung po'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol gyi bar byas nas 'khor rnams rang la bsdus/

bzhi pa yi dam gyi gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ /de nas gtor ma rnams chang chu nang mchod kyis bran la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa ces pa nas/ rgyal ba rigs drug go 'phang myur thob shog/ ces pa'i bar gtor chog bzhin no/ /lnga pa mgon po'i gtor 'bul la/ don tshan dang po thun mong ma yin pa'i mchod rdzas byin brlab ni/ de nas chos skyong gi gtor ma yig 'bru bzhis byin gyis brlab pa gsos btab/ rak+ta/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i nang du/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ ra yig zhu ba las/ sha khrag rus pa'i rba klong 'khyil bar gyur/ oṃ mahā rak+ta āḥhūṃ/ lan bdun/ sman phud kyang de bzhin du bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa'i nang du/ oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.a rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes bdud rtsi lnga'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūṃ/ zhes lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar sngags drug gis thun mong du byin rlabs byas na'ang legs so/ /don tshan gnyis pa lha bskyed cing spyan 'dren pa ni/ de nas swa bhā wa

sa stong par sbyangs pa nas/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'i bar gtor chog tu bshad pa ltar ro/ / £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ hūṃ/ £© dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs mahā kā la'i tshogs/ /bsgrub cing mchod pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /'khor bcas ma lus gshegs su gsol/ /mahā kā la gnas 'dir gshegs/ /lha chen dpal 'bar gnas 'dir gshegs/ /lha mchog sras po= tshogs bdag chen po gnas= 'jigs byed chen po gnas= legs ldan nag po= yum chen e ka dza ti= srid gsum nag mo= gnod sbyin lcam dral= pu ṭa ming sring = gdong can rnam bzhi= pho nya mngag gzhugs sha za'i tshogs/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro dregs pa can/ /rang rang dam tshig bka' nyan rnams/ /mthu dpung gzi brjid cher bskyed la/ /las la ma g.yel da tshur byaun/ / don tshan gsum pa mchod nas dam la bzhag pa ni gtor chog tu shes par bya ba las/ khyad par lhag po ni/ dam bzhag gi skabs/ gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling ba bde ba'i rdo rje/ shud+dha ka ra warma/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo blo gros grags/ bla ma sa skya ba chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa paṇa/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ a gnyan dam pa/ bdag nyid chen po/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ shar pa kun dga' seng ge/ kun mkhyen chen po dol po pa/ slob dpon don grub rgyal mgon/ bla ma bkra shis rin chen pa/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi dbang phyug /kun dga' dpal 'byor/ bkra shis rnam rgyal/ lung rigs rgya mtsho/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ zhes brjod/ don tshan bzhi pa gtor ma bsngo ba ni gtor chog tu shes par bya'o/ / don tshan lnga pa mchod phreng ni/ dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rab bskyil ba/

/sbu ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa yi/ /ar+ghaṃ mchog gi mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan mahā kā la dang*/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ / dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye/ mahā kā li de bi ye/mahā rak+ta sa mun dra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /rna ba mig dang de bzhin sna/ /lce dang tsit+ta yang dag ldan/ /dbang po lnga'i me tog 'di/ /dpal ldan= 'dod khams= dam tshig= bcol ba'i= oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye/ mahā kā li de wi ye/ pañtsa in tra gu h+ya puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ dgra bgegs kun gyi tshul chen po/ / bdud rtsi lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /byin za chen pos bsregs pa yi/ /bdug pa'i sprin gyi mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan sogs/ oṃ shri mahā kā la ye/ mahā kā la de wi ye/ mahā me da gu h+ya dhu pe ūḥhūṃ/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi sbrang chen po/ /sra ba ras kyi sdong bur bcas/ /yi dwags me yis sbar ba yis*/ /snang gsal mchog gi mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan sogs/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ye/ mahā kā li de wi ye/ mahā ma du ra gu h+ya ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi sha dang khrag /bdud rtsi lnga yis yang dag sbags/ /nus pa mchog dang rab ldan pas/ /rab tu sbyar ba'i dri mchog 'di/ /dpal ldan sogs/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la yi/ mahā kā li de wi ye/ ba su ru dhi ra gu h+ya gan+dhe āḥhūṃ/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi sha rus kyi/ /bza' ba khrag gi btung bar ldan/ / ri dang rgya mtshor mnyam pa yi/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan sogs/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye/ mahā ka li de wi ye/ mahā maṃ sa rak+ta bhu dza ta pi pa tha āḥhūṃ/ dril bu dam tshig bskul ba'i sgra/ /rnga chen kun nas brjid pa'i sgra/ /dung chen gling bu snyan pa'i sgra/ /cang te'u 'phrin las bskul ba'i sgra/ / gsang ba'i rnga chung dbang bsdud sgra/

/sna tshogs rol mo mchod pa'i sgra/ / 'jigs byed chen po mnyes byed pa'i/ /rab brjid snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'di/ / dpal ldan sogs/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye/ mahā kā li de wi ye shap+ta pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ g.yang gzhi'i bla re nam mkha'i rgyan/ /rgyu rlon lda ldi bar snang rgyan/ /keng rus phreng ba sa gzhi'i rgyan/ /phyag rgya rnam drug sku yi rgyan/ / 'jigs byed chen po mnyes byed pa'i/ /bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan sogs/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye/ mahā kā li de wi ye/ gu h+ya a laṃ kri ta pu tsi te āḥhūṃ/ myos byed stong gi bcud bsdus pa/ /lcags kyu lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang rab sbyar te/ / ye shes lnga yis byin rlabs pa'i/ kha dog ro dang nus par ldan/ /dngos grub pad+mo 'byung ba'i gnas/ /mkha' 'gro ngang pa 'du ba'i gzhi/ /gsang ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di/ /dpal ldan sogs/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye/ mahā kā li de wi ye/ gu h+ya mṛ ta sa mun tra pu tsi te āḥhūṃ/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi sha dang khrag /sgron me lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga/ /bza' dang btung ba sna tshogs bcas/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes byas pa/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /bzhed dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtshor ni/ / mngon par byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*/ /dam tshig bzhin du bdag 'bul gyis/ /thugs dam bzhin du bzhes mdzod la/ /dam bcas bzhin du rjes dgongs nas/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol ba yi/ /las rnams thams cad grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ mahā kā li de wi ye/ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta ba ling ta pu tsi te aḥhūṃ/ mchod 'bul ni/ rak+ta sgrengs la/ dgra bgegs sgral ba'i sha dang khrag /dbang po lnga dang don snying lnga/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang srog dbugs rnams/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i zhal du 'bul/ /mahā maṃ sa la khā hi/ mahā rak+ta la khā hi/ mahā tsit+ta la khā hi/ mahā ko ro tsa na la khā hi/

mahā ba su ta la khā hi/ mahā keṃ ni ri ti khā hi/ sman phud sgrengs la/ mkha' las byung ba'i dkar dmar dang*/ /dri sman bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul/ /sna tshogs 'bru yi bcud bsdus pa'i/ /myos byed ro mchog ldan pa 'di/ /rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /rtsa brgyad stong dang sbyar ba'i sman/ /dges pa chen pos rol tu gsol/ /thugs rjer dgongs la dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ de nas bstod pa bsdus pa gtor chog ltar bya'o/ /de nas drug pa rnam thos sras kyi gtor 'bul la don tshan dang po rgyal chen rnam sras kyi dam tshig pa bskyed cing ye shes pa dgug pa ni/ oṃ a mṛ ta sa bsangs gtor byed pa nas bzung*/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas la badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'i bar gtor chog bzhin/ de nas gyer dang bcas te/ bai/ gser gyi mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa rgyal mtshan 'khor gyi 'khu zlog 'joms/ / g.yon pa ne'u les sgrub la dngos grub ster/ /rin chen gyis brgyan 'khor g.yog rgyas par mdzad/ /phrag gong nyi zlas sgrub la tshe dpal stsol/ /rnam mang thos sras dbus nas sku bzhengs shig/dbang sdud dmag zlog longs spyod rgyas pa dang*/ /byag cing mngon shes zhing bcu sgrol ba dang*/ /tshe 'phel lo thog rgyas sogs 'phrin las phyir/ /rta bdag brgyad po phyogs mtshams nas bzhengs shig /'khor sa bar par gnas pa'i klu chen brgyad/ /klu phran 'bum dang bcas nas sku bzhengs shig /'khor sa tha mar gnod sbyin bye ba dang*/ /lha srin sde brgyad la sogs pho nya'i tshogs/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs nas sku bzhengs shig /sgrub mchog dbul phongs bsal ba'i don slad du/ /gzhal med pho brang gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /bdag gis mos pas bskyed pa'i gnas 'di ru/ / 'khor bcas rtag par 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /gshegs nas sgrub mchog bsam pa bskyang du gsol/ / zhes brjod do//mgon po kun gshegs nas/

phy-i 'brang gi bgegs bskrad pa'i bar gtor chog bzhin bya/don tshan gnyis pa mchod nas gtor ma 'bul ba yang gtor chog bzhin bya'o/ /de nas don tshan gsum pa mchod 'bul ni/ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ / lha rdzas dge ba'i mchod rdzas kun/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / thugs rjes brtser dgongs dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ bai shrā wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥsarba pū dza me gha nir+ya ta yā mi/ dkar gsum 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dang*/ /mngar gsum bu ram bdud rtsi dang*/ /gtsang ba'i gser skyems mchod par 'bul/ / thugs rjes brtser dgongs dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ bai shrā ba ṇa sa pa ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa mā ye hūṃ/ man+dha ra dang ut+pa la/ /pu ru sha ga tsam+pa ka/mañdzu sha ka li shi sogs/ /me tog sna tshogs dbu la 'bul/ /thugs= puṣ+pe = tsan+dan dkar dmar a ka ru/ /ga bur 'bras dkar phye ma dang*/ /ra dkar 'o mas bran pa sogs/ /sna tshogs bdug spos shangs la 'bul/ / thugs= dhu pe = gser sogs rin chen snod nang du/ /til dmar mchog gis yongs bkang ste/ /mar me nyi zla'i bsgrag la sogs/ /snang gsal sna tshogs spyan la 'bul/ /thugs= ā lo ke = rin chen sna tshogs snod nang du/ /ga bur gur gum bzang la sogs/ /gtsang ma'i chab kyis bran pa dang*/ /dri mchog sna tshogs sku la 'bul/ /thugs= gan+dhe = nas gro 'bras dang sran ma dang*/ khre rgod 'bru sna sna tshogs dang*/ /shing thog rnam pa du ma dang*/ /zas sna sna tshogs zhal du 'bul/ /thugs= nai be t+ya = rnga chen dril bu cang te'u dang*/ /dung dang gling bu snyan pa'i sgra/ /rnal 'byor gdung bas 'bod pa'i dbyangs/ /rol mo sna tshogs snyan la 'bul/ /thugs= shap+ta = gtor chog ltar bstod pa bsdus pas bstod do/ /bdun pa rjes 'brang gi gtor ma bsngo ba ni bar 'dir zhal bzhi pa'i gtor bsngo nas gzhi bdag gtor ma'i bar rnams dang rdo rje'i glu bkra shis smon lam rnams bya'o/

/brgyad pa thugs dam bskang ba la gnyis kyi/ dpal nag po chen po'i bskang ba ni/ skang rdzas rnams sngags drug phyag rgya drug /ting nge 'dzin drug gis byin gyis brlab ste/ de yang oṃ sarba bi shud+dha dharma te badz+ra sid+dh+ya hūṃ/ zhes pas sbyangs/ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ zhes pas spel/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas bdud rtsir bsgyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ a d+yā nut+pan+na twad/ oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pas 'dod don bsgrubs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ zhes pas thob par byas/ oṃ ru ru spu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sā dha ne swāhā/ zhes pas mnyam por thob par byas/ zhes te/ de dag gi dmigs pa dang phyag rgya spyi dang 'dra'o/ / bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /thogs pa med par 'grub gyur cig / ces bden stobs brjod la/ de nas 'di skad ces gyer ro/ / hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs dpal ldan nag po che/ /rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa'i phyir/ khas blangs dam bcas ma g.yel bar/ /mahā kā la gshegs su gsol/ /hūṃ chos nyid ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /bstan srung chos skyong skur bstan pa/ /nag po chen po stobs po che/ /dus la bab kyi las la byon/ /hūṃ/ nag po chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /'bar ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren na/ /bzhugs nas dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol/ /hūṃ/ dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol mdzad pa'i/ /mahā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*/

/lha chen dpal 'bar thugs dam bskang*/ /'jigs byed chen po'i= lha mchog nag po'i thugs= gdug pa tshar gcod= bstan srung chen po'i= khyed kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas/ /lug nag rgyal mtshan dag gis bskang*/ /g.yab dar nag pos thugs= bdud rtsi sman gyis= gri rgod snying gis= lug nag snying gis= dmar nag gshos bus= dmar chen ar+ghas= tshil chen dud pas= rten gtor chen pos= rgyun gyi gtor mas= 'dod yon tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di dag gis/ /nag po chen po 'khor bcas kyi/ /thugs dam gnyan po skong gyur nas/ /bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon gdug pa zhi bar mdzod/ /dpal 'byor snyan grags rgyas pa dang*/ /tshe dang longs spyod 'phel bar mdzod/ /mi dang mi min skye 'gro rnams/ /thams cad ma lus dbang du bsdus/ /bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /mngon spyod drag po'i bsgral du gsol/ /hūṃ/ rnam dag tshogs kyi gtor ma 'di/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas spel/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /thugs dam skong la g.yar dam mdzod/ / hūṃ/ mdzes pa'i spu sdug mkha' lding la/ /bya nag lcags kyi mchu sder can/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /thugs dam skong la 'phrin las mdzod/ /hūṃ/ rta mchog nag po sprin gyi shugs/ /myur mgyogs mdzes pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ mgon po= thugs dam= hūṃ/ g.yag rgod lcags rmig khro chu'i mig /mdzes pa'i rwa dang rnga yab can/ /mgon po= thugs dam= hūṃ/ khyi nag dung gi mche ba can/ /seng ge'i stobs ldan rngam zhing rgyug /mgon po= thugs dam= hūṃ/ lug nag lcags ru dar gyis brgyan/ /bdud kyi spu nor mdzes pa 'di/ mgon po = thugs dam = hūṃ/ mi nag 'gying po rdzu 'phrul can/ /las la 'khol ba'i stobs ldan 'di/ /mgon po= thugs dam= hūṃ/ dpal gyi zhal zas 'brang rgyas mchog / rak+ta'i thig les brgyan pa 'di/ /mgon po=

thugs dam= rak+ta'i yon chab rab bskyil ba/ / srog rtsa'i lam nas 'don pa 'di/ /mgon pa= thugs dam= hūṃ/ gri snying rtsa lag ma nyams pa/ /rin chen lnga dang sman gyis bskang*/ /mgon po= thugs dam= hūṃ/ 'bru bcud stong gi bcud bsdus pa/ /gzi brjid cher 'bar lnga bskyed chang*/ / mgon po= thugs dam= hūṃ/ mnyen drang sba snyug rtse rgyal la/ spu sdug bya yi phod dang bcas/ /mgon po= thugs dam= hūṃ/ nam mkha' sku rten rgyang bu la/ /'phan gdugs mdzes pas bskor dang bcas/ /mgon po= thugs dam= rnal 'byor bdag gi nyams chags kun/ /skong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas tshang ba 'dis/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i thugs dam bskang*/ legs ldan nag po'o= khrag 'thung chen po'i= ma gcig lha mo'i= las mkhan nag po'i= bka' sdod pho nya'i= khyed kyi thugs dam skong gyur nas/ /bdag la dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /dgra dang 'byung po chom la phob/ /hūṃ/ rang bzhin rnam dag dbyings nyid las/ /thugs rje chen po'i sku sprul pa/ /skye med ngang las 'jigs byed sku/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas mchog ni/ /bdud lug nag po spyi dkar dang*/ /mkha' lding nag po gser mig dang*/ bdud rtsi rnam lnga sbyar ba dang*/ /dmar chen khrag gi rgya mtsho dang*/ /dpa' bo chang gis ra ro dang*/

/sman rnams sbyar ba'i ril bu dang*//rin chen sna lnga'i phye ma dang*/ /zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa dang*/ /drag po'i bshos bu zur gsum dang*/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang*/ /dar mtshon sna lnga'i mchod pa dang*/ /sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra dbyangs 'dis/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas mchod/ /dges pa'i dam rdzas mchod pa 'dis/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /nyams chags ci bgyis bzod par bgyi/ /sngar byas legs pa'i btang rag gtong*/ /da bcol legs pa'i gser skyems 'dren/ /dam rdzas gser skyems mchod pa 'dis/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas kyi/ /thugs dam gnyon po bskang bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /chos skyong mgon po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /rgyal ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /legs ldan nag po'i= lha min dmag tshogs g.yul bzlog phyir/ lha chen dpal 'bar= dam tshig gnyen por srung ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor dgra lha'i= bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub pa'i phyir/ /rig 'dzin bsrung ma'i= myur mgyogs cho 'phrul ston pa'i phyir/ /pho nya las mkhan= 'dod yon mchod pa rnam lnga dang*/ /dza gad bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dang*/ /la du la phug dzam bu ti/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor chen dang*/ /dgra bgegs rnam gnyis bsgral ba yi/ /don snying nang khrol dbang po lnga/ /rus pa rkang klad tshil bu dang*/ /bya rgod mda' dang dar nag 'phan/ gri rgod snying dang lug nag sogs/ /tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen 'dis/ /mchod do mgon po 'khor bcas mchod/ /bskang ngo thugs dam gnyan po bskang*/ bh+yoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi yum/ /e ka dza ṭi'i thugs dam bskang*/ / dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas la/ /thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni/ /gtor chen sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan/ /mi dbang 'bras bu smin pa'i sha /shing lo sa la ma lhung dang*/ /bya mo nag mo la sogs te/ /'dod pa'i dam rdzas dpag med kyis/

/mchod do 'dod khams dbang mo mchod/ /bskang ngo lha mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dgra bgegs gnas nas 'gugs pa'i phyir/ /pho nya rnams kyi= dgra bgegs zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir/ /gnam lcags khyung gi= dgra bgegs sha la rol ba'i phyir/ /bya nag tshogs kyi= dgra khrag skom du 'thung ba'i phyir= khyi nag tshogs kyis= dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod pa'i phyir/ /mi nag tshogs kyis= dgra bo'i bla phyir 'gyed pa'i phyir/ lcags spyang sngon mos= khyod kyi mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni/ /bza' ba sha yi ri bo la/ /btung ba khrag gi rgya mtshor bskyil/ /dri bsur dud pa sprin du 'khrigs/ / nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa 'dis/ /pho nya las mkhan thugs dam bskang*/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las bzhis/ /ji ltar bcol bzhin grub par mdzod/ /hūṃ/ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas kyi/ /gzhan yang dgyes pa'i mchod pa ni/ /ri rab gling bzhi gling phran bcas/ /ri bdun rol ba'i mtsho bdun dang*/ /rin chen bdun dang rin chen gter/ /skye 'gro sems can sna tshogs bkod/ khyung chen glang po ma he rta/ /gser g.yu mu tig byi ru shel/ /dar zab gos dang 'bras bu'i tshogs/ /mi zad longs spyod gter dang ldan/ /bzhes shig thugs dam skong bar mdzod/ /bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba dang*/ /bsgrub pa'i bar chad sel ba dang*/ /rkyen ngan rbod gtong med par mdzod/ / hūṃ/ lha chen dpal 'bar mthu ma chung*/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro bang ma bul/ /pho nya las mkhan rtsal ma zhan/ /dpal 'bar mahā kā la ni/ khram kha sgyur ba'i mthu bo che/ /bdud kha bsgyur ba'i nga ro can/ /do nub bzlog bsgyur dus la bab/ /srid pa'i khram kha da bsgyur cig/lha 'dre'i dmag sna dgra la drongs/ /gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa dang*/ /byad kha phur kha gtong ba bzlog /tshe zor yungs zor 'phen pa bzlog /'byung po'i thod zor= gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskor pa= bdud kyi khram kha ston pa=

ma mo'i khrag zor 'phen pa= klu yi byad du bcug pa= the brang bsris la rku ba= mu stegs bar chad byed pa= rgyal po'i smyo 'bog gtong ba= ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi= ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu= rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ltas sdig /nad rims gzhi brgya rtsa bzhi= lo skeg zla skeg zhag skeg= drang srong gza'i ki kaṃ= zhang zhung rtso mar 'phen pa= sum pa'i glang zor 'phen pa= ban dhe'i sngags zor 'phen pa = bon po'i rta zor 'phen pa = skyes pa'i mda' zor 'phen pa= bud med dmod zor= rlung gi gshed bzhi mchis pa dang*/ /mo rtsis ngan pa thams cad= mkha' 'gro ma dang ro langs dang*/ /rgyal srin bar chad byed pa= de la sogs pa'i gdug sems rnams/ /thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yoḥ /thams cad rbod gtong steng du bh+yoḥ /srin po'i gzugs kyi nag po che/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi srung ma khyod/ /sngon gyi dam bcas bzhin du gyis/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir gnod byed pa/ /'di dag bstan pa'i dgra bo ste/ kha kha khā hi dgra la rol/ /gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa dgra bo bzung*/ /ban+dha ban+dha dgra bo chings/ /ha na ha na dgra la rgyob/ /da ha da ha dgra bo bsregs/ /pa tsa pa tsa dgra bo tshos/ /di na me ke dgra bo sgrol/ /ma ra ma ra dgra bo bsod/ khrag gi rgyun yang 'thung bar gyis/ /dam nyams dgra ni myur du sgrol/ /rus pa klad pa nang khrol zo/ /til 'bru tsam yang med par gyis/ /nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas/ /dus la bab po 'phrin las mdzod/ /bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams ni/ /da lta nyid du grub par mdzod// rgyal chen rnam sras kyi bskang ba ni/ bskang rdzas byin rlabs gong bzhin byas la/ 'di skad ces gyer ro/ / hūṃ bai/ rin chen mang sprul rgyal po chen po ste/ /bde mdzad srid gsum 'phongs dang rgud pa las/ /myur skyob dpal 'bar bkra shis bde ster ba/ /mgon po dngos grub gter mdzod thugs dam bskang*/ /gos sngon lung thang 'phreng ba cang shes rta/

/'dod 'jo'i ba dang gter bum dpag bsam shing*/ / gsang chen bris sku bltams pas thugs dam bskang*/ /don dam spros bral skye 'gag gnas gsum bral/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang rgyal po chen po yang*/ /ting 'dzin 'ja' tshon lta bur dus kun spyod/ /lta spyod sgom pa bzang pos thugs dam bskang*/ /gsang sngags bsnyen sgrub thun mong khyad par dang*/ /sku dang gsung thugs spyi dang bye brag gi /dam tshig gtsang ma dag pa ci mchis pas/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /rtag gtor rgyun gtor dus gtor gnyan po dang*/ /mchod pa lnga dang 'dod yon rnam lnga dang*/ /rin chen bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyis/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /nas 'bras gro sran til dang 'bras bu'i tshogs/ /dza ti gur gum ga pur tsan+dan dang*/ /gla rtsi dri lnga 'bras bu lnga dang ni/ /bya gri seng gri ha sa de ba dang*/ /kar+ṇi ka dang sman mchog rnam lnga dang*/ /chu yi snying po lan tshwa rtsi thog dang*// shing thog sbrang rtsi til mar bu ram bcas/ /sman lnga snying po lnga yis thugs dam bskang*/ /lus 'phags po dang 'dzam gling ba glang spyod/ /sgra mi snyan dang gling phran brgyad po yang*/ /ri rab nyi zla kun bzang mchod pas spras/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su bskong gyur cig /bdag cag sgrub pa po la dngos sgrub stsol/ /bai/ mgon po gnas bsrungs 'khor bcas la/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul/ /sngags dang ting 'dzin las byung ba'i/ /kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ / mchod yon zhabs gsil me tog spos/ /mar me dri bzang zhal zas mchog / zag med bde bskyed nyer spyod rnams/ /'jig rten mtha' dag bkang nas 'bul/ /pi waṃ gling bu zangs dung dang*/ /dung dang rdza rnga rnga bo che/ /rol mo'i khyad par stong phrag bcu/ /snyan pa sgra yis rab tu mchod/ /dge ba'i stobs las 'khrungs pa yi/

/dpag bsam shing las byung gyur pa/ /lha rdzas yo byad ma lus rnams/ /blo yis blangs nas 'bul bar bgyi/ /'khor lo la sogs rin chen bdun/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /gdugs sogs bkra shis brgyad po yang*/ /gnas bsrungs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /gzugs sogs 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /ral gri la sogs grub pa'i rdzas/ /grub pa nyi shu rtsa bdun yang*/ /rgyal chen thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir 'bul/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ /gsang sngags rig sngags mthu stobs dang*/ / chos dbyings rnam dag byin rlabs kyis/ /gtor ma 'di ni lha rdzas kyi/ /bdud rtsi la sogs longs spyod kyis/ /zag med bde ba bskyed nus pa'i/ /ngal bsos 'khor bcas spyan lam du/ /nam mkha' gang bar 'byung gyur cig khyed la bkres pa mi mnga' yang*/ /zag med bde ba rgyas pa'i rgyu/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi don slad du/ /dmigs med tshul gyis bzhes su gsol/ /lha min g.yul las rgyal byed pa'i/ /nor bu'i tog 'bar ba dan g.yo/ /rgyal mtshan 'di 'bul bdud dpung gi /dgra las rgyal bar mdzad du gsol/ /rin chen bdun las grub pa'i gzhal med khang*/ /sna tshogs na bza'i khyad par mtha' yas pa/ kha dog mdzes pa'i rgyan 'phreng du ma dang*/ /rta mchog rin chen lta bu 'di dang ni/ / dkar ser dmar dang 'tshal lu zhur yod dang*/ /ngang pa 'ol pa la sogs sna tshogs 'di/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang nor bu dpag bsam shing*/ /bum bzang ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo thog dang*/ khrus rdzing sman ljongs skyes mos tshal la sogs/ /mchod rdzas yid 'ong thams cad 'bul bar bgyi/ /zhol chen g.yag 'di khyed la 'bul bar bgyi/ /lug gi khyu 'di'ang khyed kyi 'brog tu 'bul/ /sra brtan mdzes pa'i go cha sna tshogs 'di// mi shigs rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul/ /'khrul 'khor mda' dang stobs chen me mda' dang*/

/'bigs byed mdung dang gcod byed 'khor lo dang*/ /'phang mdung la sogs sna tshogs mtshon cha rnams/ /ye shes mchog tu byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul/ /rin chen rgyu las mkhas pas legs sbyangs shing*/ /rno ngar rtsal dang ldan pa'i ral gri 'di/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi/ /bstan pa'i dgra rnams gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol/ / gser dngul gos dar ja ras stag gzig dang*/ /snam bu sha mar ka ra bu ram dang*/ /spyan gzigs yo byad rnam pa sna tshogs kyang*/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi/ /mgon po khyed la 'phongs pa mi mnga' yang*/ / bdag sogs sems can rnams kyi don slad du/ /bzhes nas 'gro ba'i 'dod don sgrub pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ / dgu pa bshags pa la/ dpal mgon po 'khor bcas kyi bshags pa ni/ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas la/ /zhu zhing gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /bdag ni las dang nyon mongs dang*/ /mi shes pa las bag med dang*/ /ma gus snyoms las dbang gyur pas/ /rang bzhin dang ni bcas pa yi/ kha na ma tho bgyis pa dang*/ /dam tshig mi ldan tshogs 'dres dang*/ /spyod lam gcig tu gyur pa dang*/ /bsnyen pa sgrub la ma brtson dang*/ /srung ma khyad par can rnams khyed/ /dus su ma mchod ma gsol ba'i/ /dbang gi sku gsung thugs rnams kyi/ /dam tshig nyams chags gyur pa yi/ khyed rnams thugs dang 'gal gyur pa/ /thams cad spros med mi rtog pa'i/ /dbyings nas mthu stobs thugs rje yis/ /dbang phyug dam pa khyed rnams la/ /mthol zhing bshags so bzod par gsol/ /mkha' la sprin ni dengs pa dang*/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs ni zhi ba ltar/ /nongs dang chags nyams med gyur cig /zhi zhing rab tu zhi gyur cig /sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis// byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod gtor dang*/ /rta mchog rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang*// tshogs kyi 'khor lo bcas pa 'di/ /dpal mgon khyad par can rnams kyi/

khyed kyi thugs dam bskongs gyur cig /bzhed 'grub re ba rdzogs gyur cig /de ltar gyur nas bdag cag gi /sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ /'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa yi/ /nad dang bar du gcod pa kun/ /thams cad bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ /tshe dang dpal dang 'byor pa dang*/ /dbang phyug dam pa thams cad kun/ /phun sum tshogs par mdzad du gsol/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ khyed thugs gsang ba dam pa'i mdzod/ /dgyes pa chen po'i sgo phye nas/ /dngos grub byin rlabs bdud rtsi yi/ / char gyis bdag rgyud gtams par mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ 'gro ba'i don du sku mchog 'jigs pa las/ /nga rgyal dregs pa mtha' dag 'dul mdzad cing*/ /ma lus gsal bar khyab par mdzad pa yi/ /yon tan rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// 'da' dka' dam tshig gtan nas gnyer mdzad pa/ /spyi dang dam tshig lhag pa'i dam tshig dang*/ /bsrung bar dam bcas sku'i dam tshig rnams/ /dam bcas bka' las 'da' rgyu ma lags na/ /sku'i dam tshig tshul bzhin ma brtags te/ khams gsum khyab pa'i sku la bzod par gsol/ /hūṃ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'dir 'dus gdung sob rnams/ /spyi dang khyad par dam tshig mi gtong yang*// klong du ma gyur rtsal shugs chung ba dang*/ /'du shes chung ba'i skyon rnams ci mchis pa/ /ma gcig lha mo'i sku la bzod par gsol/ /hūṃ thugs rjes nges par gzigs pa'i lha mo la/ /dam rdzas tshang ba'i mchod pa ma bshams te/ / phangs sems dbang gis mchod pa'i rgyu chung ba/ /rdzong mo dka' bzlog sku la bzod par gsol/ /hūṃ bu yi tshul gyis rgyun gyi dam tshig las/ /le lo gnyid dang bre mo gtam la sogs/ /thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa ci mchis pa// thugs rje chen pos tshangs par stsal du gsol/ /hūṃ rnal 'byor gang zhig dam tshig 'dzin pa rnams/ /ma yi tshul du thams cad bsrung ba dang*/ /zhe sdang gdug pa'i dgra bgegs gang byung bar/

/ma gcig thugs rje ldan pa der 'byung zhing*// drag shul dbang dang mngon spyod 'phrin las kyis/ /ji ltar mtshams pa bzhin du 'phrin las mdzod/ / de nas rgyal chen rnam sras la bshags pa 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ rdo rje 'chang dang phyag na rdo rje dang*/ /chos kyi rdo rje 'gro bzang snying po dang*/ /rin chen rdo rje kha che dgon pa ba/ /zangs dkar lo tsā g.yor po jo ston dang*/ /bu cer bsod rin 'jid pu pad+ma pa/ /stag pa jo bzang khro phu lo tsā ba/ /byang chub dpal dang gtsang pa dbang phyug grags/ /mkhas pa byang grags mkhan chen dwangs ma ba/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun mkhyen jo nang ba/ /ra ston rin rgyam ngab ston rin chen dpal// bsod nams grags dpal bsod nams rin chen dang*/ /rgyal ba phyag na kun dga' blo gros dang*/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan byang chub dpal ldan dang*/ /shes rab don grub rab 'byams chos rin dang*/ /chos kyi seng ge sangs rgyas ye shes dang*/ /byams pa lhun grub rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ /brgyud ldan bla ma thams cad dgongs su gsol/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad dang*/ /gzi brjid mtha' yas rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /'khor bcas brtse bas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /rgyal po khyod kyi sku gsung thugs dang ni/

/spang dang blang ba'i dam tshig bsrung mtshams las/ /rnal 'byor mi brtson dbang gis 'das srid na/ /bzod par bzhes shing bu bzhin skyang du gsol/ /dang po spang bar bya ba'i dam tshig las/ /ro la 'jus shing ro gos gyon pa dang*/ /rta nag zhon zhing re nag bting pa dang*/ /zhwa nag gos nag gyon pa mthol lo bshags/ /rta bong sha khrag zos shing 'thungs pa dang*/ /yug mos sbyar ba'i kha zas zos pa dang*/ / gas shing chag pa'i nang du lto zos pa/ /rgyal chen khyed kyi sku la bzod par gsol/ /dang du blang ba'i dam tshig las 'das te/ /bsnyen pa ma thengs gnad la bor ba dang*/ /sbyin pa ma btang 'dod chen nor blangs dang*/ /dus su mchod gtor ma byas mthol lo bshags/ khyed kyi rten mchog 'chang bar dam bcas nas/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rten gsum ma rnyed dang*// : bced £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· rnyed £© kyang lus la ma bcangs bral ba dang*/ /lung thang 'phreng ba ma bgrang mthol lo bshags/ /mdor na chos skyong khyed kyi dam tshig dang*/ /'gal zhing nyams par gyur pa ci mchis pa/ /gnod sbyin khyed la bzod par gsol lags kyis/ / tshangs par stsal nas sgrub mchog bskyang du gsol/ /rgyal chen rnam mang thos dang nor mang ldan/ /gser ri lhun po lta bur brjid chags pa'i/ /sprin bral nyi ma stong gi gzi ldan pa/ /'dod dgu'i char 'bebs de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mkha' khyab yid 'ong lha rdzas dngos kun dang*/ /bka' 'bangs bran slad rang lus nyer sdogs bcas/ /ma chags ma zhum zab dang rgya che'i phyir/ /dgongs chen sgrub phyir dge tshogs rgya mtshos mchod/ /rang gi rgyu sngon ma bsags 'bras 'dod dang*/ /don med don log cung zad don gyi phyir/ /ha cang 'dod chen bskyed dang chog mi shes/ /bsam sbyor nongs pa gang bgyis mthol lo bshags/ /lha klu mi rnams 'jigs dang 'phongs pa las/ /myur skyob 'jig rten skyong rgyal 'jig rten las/ /kun bsgral kun la phan phyir bde ster ba/

/ 'phrin las rgyun chad med la rjes yi rang/ /sna tshogs ya nga 'jigs dang mgon med dang*/ /sdig sdug brel 'phongs rgyal gzir skal ngan rnams/ /dbugs dbyung slad du thugs gsung sku mchog dang*/ /nyi zla ne'u le rgyal mtshan rnam rol sku/ khyod sku khro dang 'dzum dang brjid mdzes 'gyid/ /sgeg dul brtan 'jigs dpa' bo'i gar dgu yis/ /mi bsrun tshar gcod skal ldan rjes 'dzin phyir/ / bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'da' bdag gsol 'debs/ /de ltar 'gro skyob khyod la 'gro brten slad/ /lha mchog lhag pa'i lhar bzung dbang bskur bas/ / bdag sogs mgon med mgon mdzad rtag tu yang*/ /shes rab thugs rjes mi bsnyel mi gtong shog/ bcu pa bstod pa las/ dang po yi dam 'khor dang bcas pa la bstod pa ni/ hūṃ gang thugs mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos kyang*/ /thugs rje chen pos gdug pa'i tshogs 'dul phyir/ /rab khros 'jigs su rung ba'i skur ston pa/ khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs la 'dud/ /'jigs dus bskal pa'i me ltar rab 'bar zhing*// 'byung po'i dbang po zhabs kyi 'og tu brdz-is/ khro rgyal rnams la so sor bka' stsol ba/ /nyi ma bye ba'i 'od ldan khyod la 'dud/ /steng dang 'og gi bgegs kun 'joms mdzad pa/ /gtsug gtor gnod mdzes rgyal po ljang sngon mdog / 'jigs pa'i mtshon chas bdud rnams phye mar rlog /ha ha'i gad rgyang can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar dang shar lhor bdud kyi tshogs 'joms pa/ /bgegs dgra dbyug pa sngon po 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /char sprin mdog can ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs/ /sdang mig me ltar 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho dang bden bral mtshams su bgegs 'joms pa/ /rmugs byed 'dod pa'i rgyal po mer ltar 'bar/ /skad cig tsam gyis bgegs kun thal bar brlog /mi zad nyi ma'i gzi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang dang dbang ldan mtshams su gnas pa'i bgegs/ /ma lus rtsad nas gcod mdzad khro bo'i rgyal/

/pad+ma mthar byed rab brjed mi g.yo mgon/ /gangs ri lta bur brjid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub dang rlung du bgegs kun tshar gcod pa/ /gshin rje mthar byed khro rgyal stobs po che/ /gser gyi ri ltar rab brjid 'jigs pa'i sku/ /'od stong 'bar ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zad par stong pa rlung me chu sa yi/ /rnal 'byor grub pa gzugs dang gzugs med gzhan/ /sems la dbang bsgyur snang ba rgyas mdzad pa/ khams lnga grub pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug bden bral rlung gi lha/ /gshin rje me lha rgya mtsho dbang ldan dang*/ /dbang po gnod sbyin mtshon cha bzhon par ldan/ /phyogs bcu skyong mdzad gzhan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgra gcan dus me zla ba nyi ma dang*/ /zla skyes bkra shis dkar po lha yi bla/ /ke tu nyi ma'i bu can gzi brjid che/ /mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu rgyal rgyal ba rnam rgyal stobs kyi rgyu/ /pad+ma nor rgyas dung skyong mtha' yas dang*/ /rigs ldan 'jog po dang ni pad+ma che/ /mthu ldan klu chen gzhan la= 'byung po'i tshogs gzhan ro langs grul bum che/ /mi'am ci dang de bzhin skyes bu'am ci/ /dri za 'byung po srin po yi dwags che/ /brjed byed mkha' lding mchog la= klu dang 'byung po sogs dang*/ sde drug bsrung ma drug cu 'khor bcas rnams/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sbyangs spel sbar ba'i gtor ma= bdud rtsir bsgrub pa'i mchod pa= phyi nang gsang gsum= bdag cag mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje bzhi yi rnal 'byor mthar phyin zhing*/ /bcu drug bzhi yi rab dbye bskyed rim dang*/ /rigs sngags bzlas pa'i mthu yang grub par mdzod/ /ral gri la sogs dngos grub phra mo dang*/ /'dod dang gzugs khams rig 'dzin dngos grub dang*/ /'gyur med phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub rnams/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/

/zhi rgyas la sogs dge ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /dbang dgug la sogs gang 'dul sbyor ba dang*/ /bsad bskrad rengs sogs drag po'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*/ /'gro kun 'dod dang thar pa'i sa la 'god/ /bdag cag dus 'dir gegs med bde skyid 'phel/ /chos spyod yar ngo bzhin du 'phel bar mdzod/ / de nas bka' bsrungs rnams las thog mar mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la bstod de/ hūṃ sngon tshe bde gshegs pho brang spyan snga ru/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir nag po chen po la/ /rjes mthun 'phrin las khyad par gang bsgo ba/ /dam bcas 'phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po'i bka' nyan 'khor gyi tshul 'dzin zhing*// gdug pa 'dul phyir mi bzad gzugs 'chang ba/ /byams dang snying rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /nag po chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed tshar gcod cing*/ /rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍī phyag gi dbus na bsnams/ /nag po chen po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyu ma mi mgo 'phreng ba'i do shal 'dzin/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis zangs gri rnon po bsnams/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na thod pa khrag bkang 'dzin// nag po chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon tshe bde gshegs spyan sngar khas blangs te/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro la phan gdags phyir/ /dam bcas mi 'da' dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /gsol gdab las mdzad bdag don yongs rdzogs mdzod/ /hūṃ gang gi thugs ni dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /dpal chen gtum po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod sku lhun po lta bur rab brjid cing*/ /mi 'gyur nam mkha'i mdangs ltar shin tu mdzes/ /chos sku de bzhin nyid du gcig pa'i dbu/

/bden gnyis zab mo'i don ston phyag dang zhabs/ /skyon drug gcod phyir bdud sde'i dpung 'joms phyir/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gi gri gug thugs kar 'dzin/ /'dod khro rmongs spangs g.yon pa'i phyag gis ni/ /gdug pa'i khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa 'dzin/ /chos sgra chen pos bdud kyi klad 'gems phyir/ /rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍī phyag gi dbus na bsnams/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga ni rnam dag pas/ /mi mgo skam po lnga yi dbu rgyan can// ā li kā li lnga bcu dag pas na/ /gdug pa'i mgo rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'dzin/ /gzung 'dzin rab spangs stag gi sham thabs can/ /klu chen dbang du bsdus pas sprul gyis brgyan/ /rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis rab tu sgeg / bdud sde dpung bcas ma lus 'joms pas dpa'/ khro gnyer mche ba rab gtsigs mi sdug pa/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi gsung ni nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa/ /ha ha hi hi la sogs rab tu bzhad/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa la sogs drag shul sgras/ /log 'dren tshogs rnams ma lus skrag mdzod pa/ /dpa' bo'i gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong sgra/ /shin tu 'jigs rung sgrog mdzad de la 'dud/ khyod kyi thugs ni spros las rnam grol yang*/ /snying rje'i dbang gis 'gro ba kun la gzigs/ /skad cig gis ni khams gsum ma lus pa/ /za bar nus pa'i rngam pa mchog dang ldan/ /de lta'i sprul pa sna tshogs rab ston yang*/ /rang bzhin chos sku nyer zhi thugs la 'dud/ /dpa' bo khyod kyis thub pa'i bstan pa mchog /rab tu bskyang phyir log 'dren 'dul ba dang*/ / gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i/ /lam la gnas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa skyongs/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi/ /rmi lam ltas sdig skal ba ngan pa dang*/ /rang dang gdon dang dus min 'chi la sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bdag dang bdag la phan par gang sems pa/

/de dag kun gyi tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ /'khor dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs rnams kun/ /rtag tu mi nyams rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /lha dang mi dang klu dang gnod sbyin sogs/ /'gro ba kun gyi gdug pa'i sems zhi nas/ /thams cad bdag gi dbang du gyur nas kyang*/ /theg chen bstan pa'i snod du 'gyur bar mdzod/ /gang zhig zhi bas 'dul bar mi nus pa/ /gdug cing sdang ba'i sems dang rab ldan pas/ /bla ma dam pa'i sku la bsdo ba dang*/ / sems can rnams 'tshe sangs rgyas bstan la gnod/ /rnal 'byor rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag cag gi /dge la bar du gcod par byed pa yi/ /gdon dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /gtum po khyod kyi mngon spyod las kyis ni/ / bskrad gzir bcings shing rengs par byed pa dang*/ /rmugs shing dran pa nyams par byed pa dang*/ /de yi lus ngag yid kyi rdzu 'phrul dang*/ /mthu dang longs spyod bsod nams dbang phyug dang*/ /skad cig gcig gis thams cad rab nyams te/ /'du ba rnams bzhi'i nad kyis gzir nas kyang*/ kha nas khong khrag dron mo rab skyugs nas/ /da lta nyid du bskrad cing bsgral bar gyis/ /bdag gis bskul ba'i las 'di ma bsgrubs na/ /sngon tshe bde bar gshegs pa'i spyan snga ru/ /thub pa'i bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa/ /dam bcas tsam de dus las ma 'da' zhig /hūṃ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa'i/ /hūṃ las byung ba'i nag po che/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs gad mo sgrogs/ /'jigs byed khyod la mngon par bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun la bsnyen bkur brtags/ / mgul la thod pa'i 'phreng bas brgyan/ /dgra bgegs ma lus tshar gcod pa'i// mgon po khyod la mngon par bstod/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba ni/ / mkhyen gsal dbyings su gcig pa dang*/ /thung zhing sbom la brjid pa'i sku/ / thugs rjes sdang mig gzigs la 'dud/ /dbu skra khams nag gyen du 'bar/ / thugs rjes zhi khro phyogs bcur 'phro/

/zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug g.yas/ / g.yon pas ban+dha khrag bkang 'dzin/ /sha chen lnga dang sman lngas bkang*/ /dug gsum ma lus zhal du gsol/ /dgra bgegs thams cad sgrol byed pa'i/ /sku gsum srin po'i gzugs 'dzin bstod/ /'od zer dug lnga bsreg pa'i me/ khro gnyer smin ma rab bskyod cing*/ /ljags 'dril khros pas 'phrin las mdzad/ / hūṃ sgrog phaṭa spro khyod la bstod/ /mche gtsigs lce las me stag 'phro/ /brkyang bskum 'ur sgra thug chom gyis/ /srid gsum zhing khams ma lus g.yo/ /thugs rjes 'gro don mdzad la 'dud/ /gtum chen khro bo mang 'phro ba/ /'gran zla med pa'i mche ba las/ /'phrin las sprul pa lhun gyis grub/ khams gsum kun 'dul khyod la bstod/ /phra min tshogs rnams skrag byed pa'i/ /ha ha cher sgrog gtum la bzhad/ /zhal nas khrag rgyun 'dzag pa ste/ /dkon mchog gsum skyong khyod la bstod/ /bla ma dang ni theg chen dang*/ /sems can rnams la 'tsho byed pa/ /de dag khyod kyi mngon spyod kyis/ /skad cig nyid la brlag par mdzod/ / yum e ka dza ti la bstod pa ni/ bh+yoḥ kun tu bzang mo'i rig pa las/ /ma g.yos u ma de wa'i sku/ /ma mo thams cad bskyed mdzad ma/ /yum chen khyod la mngon par bstod/ /thugs rje mi 'gyur sku mdog nag /ye shes sku gcig 'gying zhing khro/ /g.yu yi ral pas srid gsum sgrol/ /snyan gnyis 'gro drug gsol 'debs gsan/ /shangs nas rlung sgrom bag chags 'joms/ /skye shi rtsad gcod mche ba gtsigs/ /spyan gsum 'gro la gzigs shing bzhad/ /thar pa'i lam ston gsung dbyangs snyan/ /thabs dang shes rab phyag gnyis kyis// g.yu'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin/ /tshe 'dzin bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gtams/ / skye 'gro gso ba'i yum gcig ma/ /e ka dza ṭi dpal ldan ma/ yum chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces pas yum la bstod/ /lha mo 'dod khams ma la bstod pa ni/

hūṃ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /rang don sgrub phyir rnam thar gsum gzhol yang*/ /snying rje'i dbang gis rjes la thob pa yis/ /shes rab sna tshogs bdag gis 'gro don mdzad/ /dpal ldan lha mo'i sku mdog char sprin mdog /mtshan mo nag mo shin tu gtum pa'i gzugs/ /shin tu rid cing keng rus gzugs can ma/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis brjid pa'i sku/ /ral ba gyen 'greng lan bu thur du 'khyil/ /skra gseb sprul dang thod pa'i 'phreng thod can/ /rna ltag me tog dar nag cod pan can/ khrag gi chang gis ra ro spyan rtsa dmar/ /mi ro rid pa khar bcug mche ba bzhi/ /rnam par gtsigs shing khrag la shin tu dges/ /snyan g.yas sbrul gyi mgul nas dril bu gsil/ /gdug pa btul nas tshangs pa'i sgra sgrog ma/ £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡·+ / snyan cha g.yon na seng ge'i ral ba dmar/ /dpa' mo khams gsum seng ge'i sgra sgrog ma/ £© /phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang po ral gri 'dzin/ /'og ma dung chen rak+ta dmar 'khyil 'dzin/ /g.yon gyi dang po shak+ti mtshon cha 'dzin// 'og ma tri shu mgul nas dar dpyangs 'dzin/ /shak+ti ral gri mtshon gyis bcad pa yi/ /lha ma yin gyi mgo sogs do shal byas/ /glang po che yi ko rlon stod g.yogs byas/ /smad ni ba glang ko rlon dras pa la/ /phyed ni re lde ser po'i sham bus dkris/ /klu'i dbang po gzhibs pa'i sked chings can/ /zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog mdzes pa dag gis brgyan/ khrag dang zhag gi thig le tshom bur

bris/ /bong bu gwa zhon mtshan mo dur khrod rgyu/ /bong bu'i rmig pa glog gi : shun [ gshog ] pa can/ khams gsum skad cig tsam gyis bskor bar byed/ /skad ni dung dang 'brug gi sgra ltar sgrog /mkha' 'gro ma mo sha za dbang du bsdus/ /dam pa'i sa nas gzugs sku gnyis 'dzin zhing*/ /ting 'dzin dbang thob gzugs kyi khams su byon/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po la sogs phyag byas ma/ /gzhan la dbang bsgyur 'dod khams mthar phyin ma/ /dbang phyug chen po'i sku la dges par 'khril/ /sum cu rtsa gsum tshal du byon pa'i tshe/ /lha rnams dbugs 'byin brgya byin phyag byas ma/ /lha ma yin rnams phung bar byed pa'i tshe/ /lha min dbang po rnams kyis phyag byas ma/ /sku mchog ri rab rtse dang 'gran pa'i tshe/ /lte ba'i thad ka'i phyogs nas nyi zla 'char/ /rgyal chen bzhi sogs lha rnams phyag byas ma/ / rgya mtsho'i gting nas me 'bar mtsho skem ma/ /sa 'og dbang po rnams kyis phyag byas ma/ /lha mo khyod kyi cho 'phrul 'di bstan pa/ /bdud dang gshin rje'i tshogs rnams 'dar zhing 'dud/ /ma mo srin po'i tshogs rnams rngam zhing rgod/ /dam sri'i tshogs rnams 'dar zhing dam la 'dud/ /tsit+ta rin chen gur phub gzhal yas nas/ /nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor brtsegs pa'i ga'u 'bar/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten bdud rtsi'i bcud bsdus nas/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag la thim mdzad ma/ /bdud rtsi'i rlangs pas dkar po'i phyogs rnams kyis/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams gcod mdzad ma/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi rgyal mo dam la 'dud/ gang zhig khyod la dad rnams ma bas byams/ /de phyir ma zhig nad bdag sman gyi gtso/ /bdud rtsi'i lha mo khyod la rtag tu bstod/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i spyan snga ru//bdag gis deng nas 'khor ba ji srid bar/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi nad dang sdug bsngal sogs/ /zhi bar bya zhing tshe dag bsod nams spel/ /nag po'i phyogs rnams dgug cing dam la 'dud/

smyo 'bog bsad bskrad la sogs 'phrin las kyis/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las rnams myur sgrub bgyi/ /'di las 'das na rgyal ba'i bka' bslus pas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rdo rjes mgo 'gems so/ /de skad rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs pas/ khas blangs bzhin du dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /dam bcas bzhin du 'phrin las myur sgrub mdzod/ /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /rnal 'byor bdag dang bdag gi 'khor bcas la/ khyod kyi zhal nas bdud rtsi'i char phob la/ /nad dang sdug bsngal tshogs rnams zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang 'phel bar mdzod/ /zang zing longs spyod 'bru yi phung po dang*/ /rin chen rkang 'gros rnams kyang 'phel bar mdzod/ /sdang dgra gnod bgegs thams cad tshar chod la/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las 'di myur du bsgrubs/ / las mgon 'khor bcas la bstod pa/ pu ṭa'i sgos bstod rgyas pa ni/ hūṃ/ dpal ldan 'phrin las kun rdzogs pu ṭa khyod/ /sku mdog mthing nag me yi 'phro 'du can// rngams pa'i stabs kyi 'gying zhing shang lang bsnams/ /ging chen 'dug pa 'dul khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab brjid dpa' la rngams pa'i zhal gdangs shing*/ / glog ltar 'khyug pa'i ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs/ /klad khrag dron mo gsol zhing spyan rtsa dmar/ /ging chen gdug pa 'dul khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po'i do shal dar nag na bza' gsol/ /yon tan kun rdzogs khams gsum dgra las rgyal/ /'jigs byed chen po dpa' bo'i gar stabs kyi/ /sprul pas 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lam la gnas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams/ / bden pa'i stobs dang dad pa'i nus mthu yis/ /gsang sngags mchog 'dzin dgra lha khyod mchod kyi/ /rje btsun bdud las rgyal ba dges par mdzod/ / bsad pa'i sha dang sbyar ba'i dza gad dang*/ /bsgral ba'i khrag dang dam rdzas sna tshogs kyis/ /dam tshig can khyod mchod kyi chos 'khor skyongs/

/bstan pa bsrung ba'i 'phrin las myur du sgrubs/ / so so'i bstod pa bsdus pa ni/ hūṃ sngon tshe shākya seng ge'i spyan snga ru/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes dam tshig can/ /'phrul dang mngon shes ldan pa'i stobs po che/ /las mkhan 'khor dang bcas la bstod par bgyi/ /stobs ldan gang zhig srid pa'i byed po ste/ /mi bzad sngags dang mtshon cha 'khrul 'khor gyis// bdud dang mu stegs thal bar brlag mdzad pa/ /rab 'jigs nag po gnod sbyin khyod la bstod/ /sha khrag rgya mtshor rol ba'i gnod sbyin yum/ /dgra snying spar gyis 'debs pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /stong khams bdag mo srid pa'i nyul le ma/ /nag mo 'jigs su rung ma khyod la bstod/ sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon drag shul che/ /chos 'khor yongs kyi bsrung ma bgegs kyi dgra/ /skye 'gro kun gyi srog la mnga' mdzad pa/ /las mdzad chen po pu ṭa khyod la bstod/ /dam nyams kun gyi gshed ma dam tshig can/ /'jig rten kun khyab sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed/ /dpa' bo yid sgyur mkhas shing glog phreng 'khrug /thog ser bdag po bha ṭa khyod la bstod/ /sngags kyi bsrung ma 'jig dus me ltar rno/ /srin po stong gi grogs dang lhan cig rgyu/ /ma mo yongs la brda sbyor ral gcig ma/ /srin mo 'bar ma dam can khyod la bstod/ / ces pa'am/ rgyas pa la dga' na 'od ldan dpal dang*/ lung bu pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa rgyas pas bstod do/ /de nas sgo ma'i bstod pa ni/ seng ge'i gdong can so gcig srid gsum za/ / lcags kyu 'dzin zhing thod rlon 'phreng ba can/ /seng ge stag dang bya nag mang po'i tshogs/ /byams pas log 'dren 'gugs pa khyod la bstod/ /gzig gi gdong can dur khrod khrag ldag ma/ / zhags pa thod pa 'dzin zhing las la brtson/ / gzig dang spyang mo dang ni mkha' lding tshogs/ /thugs rjes legs par 'dren mdzad khyod la bstod/ /dom gyi gdong can khams gsum sal le gzigs/

/ lcags sgrog sgron me bsnams pa'i mthu mo che/ /glang chen dom dang mkha' lding sprul pa'i tshogs/ /dga' bas log pa 'dul ba khyod la bstod/ /dred kyi gdong can sde brgyad kha lo bsgyur/ /tho ba dang ni lcags kyu 'khor lo bskor/ /dred mo g.yag dang mkha' lding pho nya'i tshogs/ /btang snyoms chen pos don mdzad khyod la bstod/ /kun kyang ma mo mkha' 'gro nyi zla'i spyan/ /'jigs tshul che la thabs mkhas snying rje che/ khams khams tshig tshig sha dang khrag la dga'/ / 'jigs pa'i nga ro can khyod mchod cing bstod/ / rgyal chen rnam thos sras 'khor bcas la bstod pa ni/ rin chen pho brang dam pa na/ / mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri steng na/ /bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngal bsos dge ba stobs po che/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung dag gis bzhugs/ /g.yas na rin chen rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le bsnams/ /sku ni gser gyi 'od pas mdzes/ /zhal nas rin chen char pa 'bebs/ /thugs rjes 'phongs pa las sgrol mdzad/ /rin chen rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan/ /byang phyogs rgyal por sku yang sprul/ /rnam thos sras su mtshan yang grags/ /gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbu la rin chen cod pan gsol/ /yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs kyi bskor/ /sde bo che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan gyi dpung rnams 'joms par byed/ /stobs po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bum pa bzang pos rnam par brgyan/ /dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing*/ /rdzing bu bzang po 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dzam+bha la ni gser gyi mdog /rdzu 'phrul rta'i steng na bzhugs/ / g.yon pa ne'u le g.yas pa na/ /rin chen bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang ba bzang po sku mdog ser/ /rdzu 'phrul rta'i steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon= bum pa bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ nor bu bzang po sku mdog dkar/ /rdzu 'phrul rta'i steng na bzhugs/

/g.yon pa= nor bu bsnams la phyag= ku we ra ni sku mdog nag /rdzu 'phrul rta'i steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon pa= ral gri bsnams la= yang dag shes ni sku mdog ser/ /rdzu 'phrul rta'i steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon pa= / gser gri bsnams la phyag= /'brog gnas sku mdog nag po la/ rdzu 'phrul rta'i steng na bzhugs/ g.yon pa= /mdung dmar bsnams la phyag= lnga rtsen sku mdog ser skya la/ /rdzu 'phrul rta'i steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon pa= khang brtsegs bsnams la phyag= pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa lo ni dkar/ /rdzu 'phrul rta'i steng na bzhugs/ / g.yon pa ne'u le g.yas pa na/ /gri phub 'dzin la= klu chen brgyad ni sku mdog ser/ /rin chen sprul dang gdengs kas brjid/ /phyag gnyis 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs pa'i/ /nor bu 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar du ring po mig bzang dang*/ /gang po ser skya sa pa gnas/ /seng ge nye seng dung can dang*/ /dga' ba shin tu sa pa lho/ /seng ge seng ge'i ral pa dang*/ /bla ma ser skya nag po nub/ / 'dzin pa 'dzin dga' brtson skyong dang*/ khyab 'jug nye nag byang du'o/ /lnga spyod nyi ma byang shar na/ me ru tshig lnga ser po zla/ /ri mnyam me ni lho nub tu'o/ /ser can rlung ni nub byang na/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon nyi shu brgyad/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /smug nag rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /gri phub 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang po zla ba chu zla dang*/ /skye bdag gdos pa'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ /dbang ldan tsan dan 'dod pa'i gtso/ /mgrin ldan mgul nges pa ṭi dang*/ /nor bu nor spyod dgra rab dang*/ /nyer lnga dang ni ri mnyam dang*/ /ser can gang po ser can dang*/ /g.yon phyogs lha dang ba glang skyong*/ / 'brog gnas mi yi rgyal po dang*/ /rgyal ba khyu mchog tshig lnga ser/ /bzhin bzang dang ni ring po dang*/ /dri za sna tshogs 'bras bu gsum/ /mgul gsum lcags mdung ring po dang*/ /lha las byung ba'i ma ldan te/

/sa ga'i rigs las byung ba yis/ /stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis yin/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams bsrung zhing skyong*/ /ljang nag gri mdung 'dzin la bstod/ /lha rgyal dkar po rdo rje 'dzin/ /klu rgyal dmar po sbrul zhags bsnams/ /gnod sbyin ser po ne'u le bsnams/ /dri za dmar po rgyud mangs can/ /lha min sngo nag go mtshon 'dzin/ / mkha' lding gser mdog gshog pa rgyas/ /mi ci'i rgyal po rta mgo can/ /lto 'phye sngon po sbrul mgo can/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor bcas rnams/ /kun kyang rang mdog rgyan gyis brgyan/ /phyag g.yas mtshon cha sna tshogs dang*/ /g.yon pa ne'u le 'dzin la bstod/ /de ltar bstod cing rab bsngags pas/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas bsrung ba dang*/ /'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub pa dang*/ /bgegs rnams ma lus med par mdzod/ /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba dang*/ /'khor dang longs spyod rgyas pa dang*/ khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba dang*/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ / bcu gcig pa de nas las la bskul ba la/ rgyun bskul dang*/ drag bskul gnyis las/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi thugs dam rgyun bskul ni/ hūṃ/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi// bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /nag po khyod ni yin pa ste/ /gdug pa tshar gcod 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /ral pa nag po gyen du 'khyil/ /steng gi lha tshogs 'jigs par byed/ /spyan bgrad ljags 'dril bar gyi lha gdon sdigs// g.yas kyi gri gug gnod sems can la sdigs/ /g.yon pa gdug pa'i khrag bkang zhal du gsol/ /zhabs bsdabs gnod sems can gyi lus la snyed// gang zhig dkon mchog gsum smod dang*/ /bla ma brnyas byed sems can 'tshe/ / bdag gis bsgo ba kun khug la/ /ling ga 'di la myur du chug /'di yi sha zo khrag la 'thung*/ /rus pa klad pa nang khrol zo/ /rigs brgyud rtsad nas chod : las £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· la £© shog /'dza' ba kun dang phrol

: las £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· la £© thong*/ /bdag gis bsgo ba ma nyan na/ /nag po khyod ni nyams par 'gyur/ / hūṃ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan sngar rang rang gi /srog gi snying po phul nas dam bcas pa/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das srung ma'i tshogs/ /kun gyi gtso bo dpal ldan nag po che/ /lcam bral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas/ / rnam 'phrul du ma hūṃ phaṭa sgra sgrog cing*/ /ha ha'i gang rgyang srid gsum g.yo bar byed/ /ru ru ro zhes gdug pa'i khrag rgyun gsol/ /ma ri'i sgra 'byin bsod la brtson rnams kyi/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /bstan la gnod byed gdug pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /dam bcas ji bzhin myur du mngon par khug /gh+rih+ṇa bhan+dhas bzung zhing bcings nas ni/ /ha na ha nas bsnun zhing rdeg par gyis/ /pa tsa pa tsas bsregs bcad gtubs nas ni/ /ma ra ma ras myur du bsgral pa yi/ /sha khrag las grub mchod gtor rgya chen 'di/ kha kha khā his legs par btab pa yis/ /rang gi sha gcod lta bur bzlog nas ni/ /dam nyams snying khrag 'thung la myur du rol/ kha 'jam sems rtsub rang gi phyogs 'dzin zhing*/ /gzhan la khu byed gtor ma'i las tsam gyis/ /bu ltar bcos pa'i gsang ba'i dgra bo 'di/ /myur du tshar gcod bdag don yongs rdzogs mdzod/ / hūṃ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan mahā kā la dang*/ /lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral gyi/ /bka' nyan gnod sbyin pho mo'i gzugs/ /drag la rngams pa'i cha byad can/ /glog 'gyu ma ra'i sgra sgrog cing*/ /dgra bgegs bam ril khrag la gzer/ /snying khrag 'thung zhing 'phyong zhing rgyag kha rlangs 'bar bas me stag 'phro/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spar shad kyis/ /don snying drangs nas zhal du gsol/ /thog gi ser 'bebs khyod la bstod/ /lcam dral bka' bstod mon po'i gzugs/ /las kyi mgon po ming sring las/ /mon bu pu ṭa nag po skyod/ / men tri'i ga zha sku la gsol/
