/sher shing bsreg shing phyag na bsnams/ /pu ṭa nag po khyod la bstod/ /mon bu bha ṭa stag slog bkra/ /dar gyi ga zha sku la gsol/ /gser gyi dam shing phyag na bsnams/ /bha ṭa nag po khyod la bstod/ / sring mo gser gyi spu gri ma/ /nag mo chen mo kha 'bar ma/ /phyag na gser gyi spu gri bsnams/ /bdud mo nag mo khyod la bstod/ /bka' yi dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol ba'i las/ /ma g.yel bcol pa'i 'phrin las kyis/ /da lta sgrubs shig sa mā ya/ /dam tshig bcol pa'i las la dgongs/ /'khor bcas bsrung zhing skyong ba dang*/ /bgegs dang log 'dren gzhom pa dang*/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ / mgon po'i pho nya drag bskul ni/ hūṃ mahā kā la stobs po che/ /lha chen dpal 'bar mthu stobs kyis/ /steng nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni/ khyung chen sngon po lding zhing 'bebs/ /bh+yo bh+yoḥ de ni dgra la bh+yoḥ chos chos de ni dmag la chos/ / dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po yi/ /g.yas nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni/ / bya nag mang po 'phur zhing 'bab/ /bh+yo bh+yoḥ de ni dgra la bh+yoḥ chos chos de ni dmag la chos/

/dmag dpung bskyed pa ru mtshon phyor/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po yi/ /g.yon nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni/ lcags spyang mang po 'dur zhing rgyug /bh+yo bh+yoḥ de ni dgra la bh+yoḥ chos chos de ni dmag la chos/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po yi/ /mdun nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni/ /mi nag 'o dod gnam du 'bod/ /bh+yo bh+yoḥde ni dgra la bh+yoḥ chos chos de ni dmag la chos/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ / bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po yi/ / rgyab nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni/ khyi nag mang po 'khang zhing za/ bh+yo bh+yoḥde ni dgra la bh+yoḥ chos chos de ni dmag la chos/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ / bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ / huṃ/ gan+ṭe las sprul pho nya ni/ khro chen 'bar bas 'jig rten gang*/ /bh+yo bh+yoḥde ni dgra la bh+yoḥ chos chos de ni dmag la chos/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /hūṃ mngag shing las la bskul ba'i tshe/ /stong gsum 'jig rten ma lus kun/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs shing*/ /la las ba dan g.yab mo g.yob/ / la las rgyu ma'i zhags pa 'phen/ / la las mi rkang gling bu 'bud/ /la las dmar chen rak+ta sgreng*/ la las tshil chen dud pa gtong*/ /la la gnam lcags thogs zer 'bebs/ /la las spu gri so 'dar zhing*/ /'ur 'ur chem chem stong gsum 'gengs/ /bh+yo bh+yaḥ sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yoḥ gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yoḥ chos shig bskul lo dmag la chos/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /bh+yo lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /dung skyong rgyal mo'i pho nya ni/ /rjes nas 'brang zhing drag shul che/

/bud med gri thod thogs pa brgya/ /g.yas nas ru 'dren dpa' rtsal can/ /skyes pa'i mtshon cha thogs pa brgya/ /g.yon na ru 'dren sprul pa'i sku/ /nyan thos 'khar gsil thogs pa brgya/ /slad kyi rjes 'brang 'jigs rung ba/ /ban+dhe phur pa thogs pa brgya/ /pho nya drag gtum mi bzad 'bar/ /srin mo ral pa g.yeng pa'i tshogs/ /bstan pa bsrungs shig dpal ldan ma/ /pho nya mngags kyi rtsal ma chung*/ /bh+yo bh+yoḥsdang ba'i dgra la bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yoḥganod pa'i bgegs la bh+yoḥ chos shig bskul lo dmag la chos/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /sdang dgra gdon bgegs dam nyams rnams/ / rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod/ / ces bskul lo/ /bcu gnyis pa gtor rdzongs la/ sngon du 'gro ba bshags pa chung ba ni/ hūṃ yon tan lhun rdzogs dngos grub mnga' ba'i lha/ /ma lus rmad byung phan bde'i dgongs pa can/ /'phrin las rnam bzhis bdud dpung tshar gcod pa'i/ / legs ldan nag po 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyi/ /spyi dang khyad par gsang ba'i dam tshig rnams/ /bsrung bar dam bcas 'da' rgyu ma lags na/ /bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyi/ /bag med tshul gyis dam la 'ga' ba rnams/ /srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ / zhes pa'o/ /de nas spyi btab kyi tshig gis gtor rdzongs bya ba las/ dang por srung ma spyi khyab tu 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ hoḥ rdo rje'i 'jigs byed dus kyi 'khor lo ni/ /rnam 'phrul khro rgyal tshogs dang bcas pa yi/ /bka' nyan zad par grub pa'i 'khor dang bcas/ /tshangs pa la sogs phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas/ /sgra gcan la sogs gza' mchog 'khor dang bcas/ /rnam rgyal la sogs klu chen 'khor dang bcas/ /ro langs la sogs 'byung po 'khor dang bcas/ /mtha' yas srid gsum rgyu ba'i sde brgyad kun/ /'dir gshegs mchod gtor rgya chen bzhes su gsol/

khams drug dwangs ma rdo rje'i srog thob cing*/ /bar chad kun sol 'phrin las thams cad sgrubs/ /dngos grub mtha' dag stsol ba'i sdong grogs mdzod/ / ces phul/ de nas mgon po 'khor bcas kyi spyi btab ni/ hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po mahā kā la dang*/ /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /lcam dral khyod kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /dur khrod bdag po'i zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /dregs pa pho brgyud mo brgyud 'khor dang bcas/ /mkha' lding la sogs bya gcan 'khor dang bcas/ /pu ṭa la sogs las mkhan 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /dzam+bu ti ba'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /dza gad dpa' bo'i sman phud 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyan por 'bul/ /da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs gnyan por bzhes/ /'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang*/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ / bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po/ /thams cad rdul phran bzhin du rlag par mdzod/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di myur du sgrubs/ / zhes gyer zhing*/ cung zad drag gtor dang 'brel ba'i skabs yin na/ skabs 'dir yang*/ mahā kā la stobs po che/ / zhes sogs pho nya bskul ba de byed pa'i lag len snang ngo*/ /de nas rgyal chen rnam thos sras la 'bul ba ni/ bai/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /'khor bcas mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul ldan pa rnams/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di dag bzhes nas kyang*/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas ma lus thams cad la/ /bu gcig bzhin du rtag par skyong ba dang*/ / bstan pa bsrung zhing dge legs kun stsal nas/ /bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /bdag la gnod par sems pa dang*/

/log par zhugs pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /de'i phru ma gzhom pa dang*/ /gtan nas brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /zhi dang rgyas dang mngon spyod kyi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /bcol ba'i las la mthu bskyed cig /stobs dang rdzu 'phrul che mnga' ba'i/ /gnod sbyin dbang po 'khor bcas kyis/ /bdag gis bsam pa ma lus kun/ /myur du grub par mdzad du gsol/ / zhes gyer ro/ /de'i rjes su/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*/ /de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa kun/ /dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan shog /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /don rnams thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par shog / ces dge legs su gsol ba'i tshig su bcad pa gang 'os kyis gsol ba btab/ /bcu gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ slar yang mchod pa kha gsos/ sangs sbyangs byin rlabs gtor chog ltar ram/ spyi mthun ltar bya/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i mchod yon 'di/ /yi dam chos skyong tshogs la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la mchog stsol mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhabs bsil/ me tog rol mo 'i bar sbyar zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ bar kyang sbyar ro/ / stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i bdag / ces sogs dang*/ srin po'i gzugs kyi sogs dang*/ gang gi sku gsum sogs dang*/ gdong lnga nyi zla'i gdan steng na/ / sogs sho lo ka re res bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba btab rgya cher bya/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan bdun/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs bzod gsol man chad bkra shis kyi bar du gtor chog nas byung ba ltar bya'o/ /spyir bdag bskyed yi dam rang gang mos la byas pa chog cing*/ mdun bskyed yi dam dang*/

gtor ma gnas yo byin rlabs sogs/ bdag bskyed kyi rim pa dang mthun par sbyar na chog la/ bdag bskyed yi dam gzhan la rten nas/ mdun bskyed yi dam gzhan la'ang gtor ma 'bul du rung bas/ spyir go ba 'phrul chags pa gcig byung na/ ji ltar byas kyang ma nor bar 'gyur bar sla ba yin mod/ 'on kyang tshig don sna tshogs su 'chol bar 'gyur ba'i nyen yod pas/ lugs 'di 'dzin pa rnams kyis gong du bshad pa 'di kho na gzhung bsrang bar bya'o/ /ci ste mgon po'i bskang ba brgya tshar stong tshar sogs byed dgos pa'i tshe/ sngar gyi rgyas pa de ma lcogs na/ phyis gang zag phal pas sbyar ba la snying po med pas/ yig rnying gtum chen mar grags pa nyid bya ste/ de yang gtor ma rnams kha gsos mchod pa gsar pa re bsham thub na rab/ min na yang kha gso ba dang*/ gtor ma la sman dang rak+tas bran/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug ting nge 'dzin drug gis byin gyis brlabs te/ 'di skad ces gyer ro/ / hūṃ/ gtum chen nag po lcam dral dang*/ /e ka dza ṭi la sogs pa/ /bka' bsdod pho nya 'khor bcas la/ khyad par dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho dpag med dang*/ maṃ sa'i rgyan can gtor ma dang*/ /phyag mtshan rgyan can dam pa dang*/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rnams kyis/ /lcam dral mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*/ pu ṭa pho mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /bran g.yog 'khor gyi thugs dam bskang*/ /bar chad kun sol mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /hūṃ/ dmar chen rak+ta rgya mtshor skyil/ /sha rus bza' ba ri ltar spungs/ /bdud rtsi'i sman gyi chu rgyun 'bab/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis sprin ltar gtibs/ /dam tshig can 'dus gnas mchog 'dir/ /lcam dral sogs= £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡·+ /hūṃ/ £© rus pa'i rgyan drug sbrul rgyan dang*/ /stag sham dar gyi lhab lhub dang*/ khrag zhag thig le zo ris dang*/ /dpal gyi chas brgyad la sogs pas/ /lcam dral= dmigs med thugs rjes 'gro don du/

/gdug pa'i gzugs su rnam sprul zhing*/ /stong dang snying rje dbyer med par/ /nges par rtogs pa'i shes rab 'dis/ /lcam dral sogs/ zhes bskang ba dang*/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi mchod pa dang*/ srin gzugs ma'i sho lo ka dang pos bstod/ 'dod don gsol btab shugs la yod pas/ logs su ma byas kyang chog par bzhed do/ /zhal bzhi pa'i bskang bshags bya bar 'dod na/ logs su 'bri ba ltar shes par bya'o/ / bka' srol 'di'i lugs ma nyams pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len mdzad pa/ jo nang ba yab sras kyi bka' srol la/ kun spangs chen po dpon slob gsum gyi dus/ bka' bsrung gi mthil gur lcam dral nyid yin/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos de steng du rnam thos sras kyang rtsal mngon du mdzad cing*/ yab sras de dag gis zhing skyong gdong bzhi pa la rtsal mngon pa ma byung ba ltar/ bskang bshags kyi rim pa rnams 'dir ma bkod do/ /gzhan yang chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa gzhan 'ga' zhig gi mchod gtor bskang bshags dkyus 'di la bya bar 'dod na/ ye shes dbyings kyi mgon po'i rigs rnams lcam dral gyi rjes la bya zhing*/ las kyi mgon po'i rigs rnams de'i rjes la bya ste/ rgyal chen rnam sras kyi sngon nam/ rjes gang rigs la bya'o/ /de yang lugs 'di'i khrigs chags kyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ sgrub pa po rang nyid gcig pus byed pa'i tshe/ rang gang la gtso bor byed pa de nyid thog mar byas pas chog ste/ ye shes kyi lha la don dam par bzang ngan med pa'i phyir ro/ /'jig rten pa'i srung ma'i rigs ni/ rang de la gtso bor byed pa yin kyang*/ chog sgrigs gcig po de'i skabs la ye shes kyi lha'i sngon la byed mi rung bas/ 'byung po spyi gtor gyi gong 'og gang rung du bya'o/ /zhes pa dpal jo nang ba'i bka' srol las brtsams te/ dam can chos skyong srung ma'i mchod :phrin

[ sprin ] rgyas pa 'phrin las rnam rol zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo sum cu rtsa dgu lon pa la sgrigs pa ste/ ra sa 'phrul snang chos 'khor chen po'i gnas su sbyar ba'o/ /dge legs 'phel/ bkra shis// ༄༅/ /dpal gur gyi mgon po'i dmar chen gtor bzlog gi cho ga bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dpal nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i gtor ma'i las tshogs las/ bzlog pa gtso bor gyur pa'i dmar chen gtor ma'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bris sku sogs rten dgram/ gtor ma lnga tshar mchod pa bskang gtor sogs bshams/ de dag gi mdun sogs ji ltar 'os par rdul tshon nam chu tshon gyis dkyil 'khor 'bri ste/ dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag mtha' me ris bskor ba/ de'i dbus su mtshon cha 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs drug pa/ mu khyud nag po la rdo rje sngon po'i phreng ba'am/ thod skam gyi phreng bas bskor/ rtsibs kyi bar rnams dmar por bya/ rtsibs las lte ba sum 'gyur gyi che bar byed cing lte ba la re kha nyis rim 'then/ de'i nang du chos 'byung gru gsum dmar nag gcig bya/ de'i gru chad ljang khu yin/ chos 'byung nang ma la yang me ris 'bri thub na legs/ de'i dbus su nyi gdan la gri gug dang*/ rtsibs rnams la nyi gdan gyi steng du phyag mtshan nam tshom bu nag po re 'god/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus mañdzi'i steng du/ lcags snod yangs par nas nag rjen btags bre lnga las mi nyung ba/ tsha ba gsum dang*/ lcags phye zangs phye sogs brdar ba la khrag dang chang bsres pa'i chus sbrus te/ dbus su gtor ma snying gzugs ma la khyad par rtse mo rno zhing zur dod pa/ 'khor bshos bu gru gsum phra sang nge ba drug gis bskor ba/ de rnams gtso bo'i gtor ma'i sum cha tsam du sleb pa/

de dag gi bar mtheb skyus bkang nas gtor snod kyi kha mtshams dang mnyam par zan gyi mu khyud lcags ri bzhin du bskor ba/ gtor ma de la gri khrag dang dug sbyar ba'i khrag gtsang mas byugs/ /yungs gar dang*/ mtshe dang skyer pa sogs dug shing dang tsher ma'i rtsang khrag gis byugs pas brgyan/ zan gyi mu khyud la rtsang nyi shu rtsa gcig srin mo 'gros su gzugs/ gzhan yang ling chung mgo bo thur du lta ba dang*/ mi mgo skam rlon sogs 'jigs su rung ba'i rgyan ji ltar 'os pas brgyan/ gtor ma dang chos 'byung gnyis ka'i zur rang la mi ston par bzhed/ de'i mdun nas slar yang chos 'byung ngam mi lpags sogs kyi gdan la lcags sder la sogs pa'i snod du zor gtor gru gsum mar nag dug khrag gis byugs pa/ ngos gsum la zan gyis 'bur dod byas te/ ngos gcig la hūṃ/ g.yas su bh+yoḥ g.yon du bzlog ces pa yong ba bya/ 'di la'ang 'bul gtor :logs £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· la sogs £© pa thun gtor 'dra ba gcig kyang bshams/ zor gtor de'i g.yas nas phar rim pa bzhin du skam thun rnams bsham ste/ rdo nag gru gsum la dug khrag gis khram ris dang bh+yoḥ bris pa bdun la sogs pa dang*/ de 'phen pa'i 'ur rdo skor thag ni yug skra ro skra bsres pa dang*/ 'ur mthil mi lpags las byas pa sogs bzhag /lcags snod du yungs dkar nag

/lcags phye zangs phye rdo phye ske tshe shing tshe sogs snod so sor blug pa'am gcig tu bsres la bzhag /mtshe shing khrag gis bskus pa dang*/ 'byor na thal chen yang bsham/ mda' 'ug sgro ma skyer ma de gru gsum mde'u la hūṃ bzlog bh+yoḥ bris/ ltong la las mkhan gyi bsad sngags bris/ gzhu'i mchog ma g.yas g.yon la rbod rbad kyi sngags bris pa'ang bsham/ zor gtor gyi g.yon du gri khrag la sogs pa'i khrag sna sna tshogs la dug sna sna tshogs sbyar ba khrag thun dngos dang*/ khyu mchog gi rwa g.yas pa'i nang du yang dug khrag blug pa rebs kha phur ba dang*/ dug dang chang gis sdus pa'i kong zor bdun du yang dug khrag cung zad re blug pa dang*/ /gyo tshal dang thod tshal du yang dug khrag blug pa/ ci rigs bshams/ de dag gi mdun du rak+ta'i mchod yon dbang lnga'i me tog sha rus kyis brgyan pa'i zhal zas gru gsum rkang gling sogs drag po'i mchod pa sna tshogs bsham/ /sgrub pa po'i mdun nam/ dmar chen gtor ma'i mdun du 'brub khung gru gsum mthing nag me ris 'bar ba'i nang du tsha ba gsum dang ske tshe gri khrag sogs sbyar ba'i bag zan la ling ga bcos/ bris pa'i ling ga sngags can de'i snying gar bcug na bzang*/ de min dar dmar po'i ras ma gcig tshon skud sna lnga'am sngo dmar gyis bsdams te snying gar bcug de'i sne mo snying ga'i thad nas phyir bton te ske la se chings btab/ sno mo zangs kyi phur pa la btags te zor gtor la 'dzugs/ gzhan yang yo byad thams cad tshang bar bya ste/ sha dum sna tshogs dang*/ phud ma nyams pa dang*/ khrag gtsang ma sogs 'og tu dgos pa thams cad 'dzom par bya'o/ /de dag ni de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i shoms yin la/ de'i sngon du bskang gso'i shoms thams cad tshang bar bya dgos so/ / de nas sgrub pa po rnams 'dus te/ sngon 'gro gtor ma yi dam gang byed rang rang gi cho ga'i lugs bzhin btang*/

de ma thag bgegs gtor yang spyi dang mthun par gtong ste cha gsum bzhin no/ /de nas gnas yo byin rlabs yi dam gyi cho ga gang yin de'i lugs bzhin du bya/ de rjes bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i bar du bya'o/ /de nas mdun bskyed kyi bya ba la gnyis las/ mdun bskyed spyi'i bya ba ni/ yi dam chos skyong gi gtor bsngo nas gzhi bdag gtor ma'i bar du gtor chog dkyus tsam gtong ba'am/ bskang gso dang 'brel na'ang de'i bya ba tshar gcig skabs 'dir rdzogs par byas na legs so/ /gnyis pa khyad par gyi mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dhohaṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du yi ge khaṃ las dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i gzhal med khang mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba/ sgo med lcags kyi mun khang rgya dang tshad yongs su chad pa med pa/ phyi rol me rlung 'tshubs shing*/ nang khrag zhag 'khrugs pa/ phyi nang thams cad dur khrod 'jigs su rung bas khyab pa/ de'i dbus su bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo nag po rtsibs drug pa/ gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rang bzhin rtse mo rno ba/ dgra bgegs thams cad mnan pa'i steng 'khor lo'i lte bar paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ/ zhes pa nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa'o//oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'am/ spel tshig can lan gsum gyis gtso bo bskyed/ 'khor lo'i mdun gyi rtsibs la maṃ las e ka dza ṭ-i/ zhes pa nas/ sgra sgrogs pa'o/ /oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba to si ka ma la rak+ṣa si hūṃ bh+yoḥhūṃ/ zhes pa'am de nyid spel tshig dang bcas pas yum chen dang lha mo bskyed/ gzhan yang lcam dral nas/ bskor bar gyur/ lho stod kyi rtsibs la ya las nag po gnod sbyin sogs/ rna cha can/ oṃ kā la yak+ṣa ye hūṃ phaṭa/

lho smad kyi rtsibs la maṃ las nag mo gnod sbyin sogs/ lan tshar can/ oṃ kā li yak+ṣa ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ nub kyi rtsibs la tri las bu ṭa sogs/ na bza' can/ oṃ yak+ṣa pu ṭa ye hūṃ phaṭa/ byang stod kyi rtsibs la : t+yi £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· dri £© las bha ḍa sogs/ 'dzin zhing gsol ba/ oṃ ru ṭa bha ṭa ye hūṃ phaṭa/ byang smad kyi rtsibs la bh+yoḥlas sring mo sogs/ me 'bar ba/ oṃ ru lu rak+ṣa si hūṃ phaṭa/ lnga char yang zhes pa nas/ bskor bar gyur/ a li a li ma dza dza shaṃ shaṃ li shi nged a shwa nged mu smugs pu ṭi a li ma dza dzaḥ nag mo sha la rubs rubs dza dzaḥ zhes pa lan gsum dang*/ oṃ ro ru ro du tri tsa pa la a shug me ma hūṃ ma bh+yoḥdzaḥdzaḥ lan gsum gyis lha rnams bskyed zin pa byin gyis brlabs/ zor gtor sogs la dmigs nas/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i mdun phyogs su dur khrod chen po'i dbus me rlung 'khrugs pa'i nang khrag mtsho khol ma'i steng du mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor pad nyi la dgra bgegs pho mo bsgyel ba'i steng du hūṃ mthing nag 'bar ba las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gsod byed las kyi mgon po sku mdog mun pa ltar gnag pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing sdigs pas dgra bgegs kyi srog rtsa gcod pa/ phyag g.yon thod khrag snying bcas thugs kar 'dzin zhing zhal du gsol ba/ spyan gsum gnod byed la sdang mig tu gzigs shing zhal gdangs pa/ mche ba zangs yag tu gtsigs pa/ skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ gad rgyangs drag pos bdud sde 'joms pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber dang*/ gser gyi ske rags dang sag ti'i lham gyon pa/ thod pa skam rlon gyi phreng ba dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yon brkyang bas gyad kyi dor stabs kyi bzhugs shing*/ 'khor gshin rje pho mo dang*/ srin po pho mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/

/oṃ mahā kā la ru tra sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ g.yas kyi skam zor rnams yi ge tri nag po las dregs pa pho sngo skya g.yas mtshon cha sna tshogs dang*/ g.yon zhags pa 'phen pa dpag tu med pa rlung dmar 'tshub ma'i dbus na gnas pa dang*/ g.yon phyogs kyi rlon zor rnams maṃ las dregs pa mo tshogs bud med dmar nag /g.yas khram shing dang g.yon nad rkyal thogs pa dpag tu med pa rnams dug mtsho dang khrag mtshor rgyu ba'o/ /de dag gi mtha' skor du bdud dang ma mo dang lha srin sde brgyad la sogs pa dregs pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa sa dang bar snang thams cad khyab par gyur/ thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ zhes pa nas/ 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo/ rdo rje gdan gyi spo nas las mgon ming sring rnams dang*/ dur khrod chen po ro thang nag po nas las kyi mgon po mahā kā la zangs gri can dang*/ dur khrod chen po brgyad la sogs pa phyogs mtshams thams cad nas dregs pa pho mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūṃ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin dran mdzod la/ / bdag gi don phyir gzhal yas 'dir/ /nag po chen po spyan 'dren na/ /rang gi dam tshig sems shing byon/ /bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /g.yabs pa'i tshe na spyan ma brtul/ /rbad pa'i che na mthu ma chung*/ /bsten pa'i tshe na rgyang ma ring*/ kyai/ bos so nag po snyan ma sra/ /g.yabs so nag po spyan ma brtul/ /rbad do nag po mthu ma chung*/ /bsten no nag po rgyang ma ring*/ /sgrub po nag po thugs ma g.yel/ / bkur ro nag po 'phrad ma dog /dur khrod mi ro'i thang chen nas/ / ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskul/ /gdug can ma lus tshar gcod cing*/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung mdzad phyir/ /spyan 'dren myur du gshegs su gsol/

/bka' yi las mkhan stobs po che/ / bdud dang srin po 'dul byed cing*/ /mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid can// bstan pa yongs kyi dgra lha ste/ /dam can yongs kyi tshe 'dzin pa/ /dam nyams rnams kyi srog gcod mdzad/ khyod kyi thugs dam bdag bskul na/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /mgon po gnas 'dir byon nas kyang*// 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub tu gsol/ /oṃ e h+ye hi mahā ka ru ṇi ka mahā kā la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ sa ma ya aṃ gu sha dzaḥ rol chen rgyun bsrings/ hūṃ tshogs chen tshogs gnyis 'jigs pa'i sku/ /mthing nag chen po drag shul can/ /dur khrod gnas shul dpa' bo che/ /lha yi dpa' bo bdud 'dul rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i ti ra dang*/ /'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs nas kyang*/ /bdag gis bcol ba'i las kun sgrubs/ /sngon gyi dam tshig ma g.yel bar/ /dgyes shing mchod pa bzhes nas kyang*/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ khyad par sde 'di'i mgon mdzod cig /bstan la gnod byed dgra dang bgegs/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dul ba'i phyir/ /mchod pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir/ /dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ mahā kā la ye sa ma ya ka ma la ye sur+ya ye she ba ye tiṣ+tha lhan/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ de nas/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye mahā kā li de bī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ nas/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol gyi bar mchod pa dang dam bzhag gtor chog ltar bya/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma dang bcas pa thams cad bkug ste gtor ma la thim par gyur/ bar 'dir gtor chog ltar gtor ma sngags tsam gyis phul/ mchod bstod bsdus pa gtor bsngo bzhin byas la/ hūṃ dur khraud chen po 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /mgon po nag po chen po 'jigs pa'i sku/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa shin tu rgyas mdzad mgon/ /chos skyong chen po khyod la bdag bstod do/

/phyi nang las byed gdug pa srin po'i tshul/ /dam tshig bsrung la rtag tu : phyogs £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· grogs £© mdzad cing*/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i 'chi bdag gtso bo mdzad/ /mgon po dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /las kyi mgon po mahā kā la ni/ /sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa bsrung ba po/ /bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra 'dul ba po/ /las kyis mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon tshe bde gshegs spyan sngar bka' bsgos te/ /bstan pa srung dang 'gro la phan gdags phyir/ /dam bcas ma 'da' dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /gsol gdab las mdzod bdag don yongs rdzogs mdzod/ /las kyi mgon po mahā kā la ni/ /sha za gnod sbyin ma mo mkha' 'gror bcas/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig / ces pa la sogs pas bstab po/ /skabs 'dir yang bskang ba ji ltar 'os pa bya/ hūṃ nag po chen po 'khor bcas la/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni// dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ rgya mtsho dang*/ /dbang po lnga yi me tog dang*/ /sman sbyar tshul chen bdug spos dang*/ /sha rus dmar gyi gtor ma dang*/ /til dang zhun chen mar me dang*/ /sman dang a mṛ ta dang dri/ /'bru nag mar gyis byugs pa'i bshos/ /rkang gling rnga dang cha lang sgra/ /phyi nang gsang ba de nyid kyi/ /mchod rdzas nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /lha chen dpal 'bar khyod la 'bul/ /bstan pa rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ khyod kyi thugs dam gnyan skong nas/ /bzhes shig rol shig dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya i daṃ ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai we te/ shap+ta mahā pū dza sa ma ya hūṃ/ hūṃ khro bo gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po dang*/ /lha mo nag mo la sogs pa'i/ /las kyi mgon po pho nyar bcas/ /gsod dang gcod la dga' ba rnams/ /sha khrag dmar la dga' ba yi/ /bshan pa 'khor bcas ma mo dang*/ /mkha' 'gro gtum mo'i tshogs bcas la/ /sha chen dmar gyi gtor ma dang*/

/rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rang bskyil nas/ / keng rus ri ltar spungs pa dang*/ /tshogs dang mchod pa gtor ma 'dis/ /chos skyong khyod kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /gdug pa can rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ / gsol zhig 'thung zhig dges par mdzod/ /rol zhig dgongs shig kha raṃ khā hi/ hūṃ 'bru sna sha sna khrag sna sogs/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad 'dis/ /mgon po nag po 'khor bcas kyi/ /thugs dam gnyan po skong gyur cig /g.yar dam gnyan po gso bar gsol/ /de ltar thugs dam gnyan skong bas/ /rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po dang*/ /bdag gi bar chad bzlog tu gsol/ /bstan pa la sdang log lta can/ /sems can yongs la gnod byed cing*/ /bdag la log par sems pa rnams/ /zo zhig 'thungs shig kha raṃ khā hi/ hūṃ dur khrod chen po'i gzhal yas khang*/ /ro thang 'bar ba nag po nas/ /smug nag 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /shin tu mi bzad 'bar ba'i sku/ /gtum chen mahā kā la khyod/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba la/ /thal chen zhag gis kun tu byugs/ /dpal ldan mgon po nag po yi/ /yon tan 'phrin las bsam mi khyab/ /sing gha la yi dur khrod du/ /bdud dang srin po 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rjes sku sprul pa/ /gsod byed mahā kā la khyod/ phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad nas/ /sprul pa pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di dag gis/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /zlog cig bdag gi rkyen rnams bzlog /bskang bzlog mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /yum chen lha mo nag mo dang*/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /drag shul stobs ldan gsus po che/ /mthing nag 'bar ba 'jigs pa'i sku/ /dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan// lto 'gro rnams kyis yan lag dkris/ /dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa yis/ /steng gi lha rnams 'dar zhing dngangs/ /ljags ni drag po'i glog ltar 'gyu/ /stong gsum dgra la nad 'bebs shing*/

/mche ba zangs yag gtsigs pa yis/ /dgra bgegs kun gyi don snying 'byin/ /dpa' bo stag gi sham thabs can/ /log lta tshar gcod thod phreng gsol/ /rnam rtog gcod mdzad gri gug g.yas/ /nyon mongs zad mdzad ban+dha g.yon/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad 'khrugs pa'i sku/ /drag po me stag phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /ma rung 'joms pa'i las la dpa'/ /dgra bgegs thams cad rlag byed pa/ /'khor bcas khyed kyi thugs dam bskang*/ / pho nya rngams byed dgra la rgyug /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ / ces pa 'di gtso bor las mgon zangs gri can gyi bskang ba yin no/ /de nas ling ga bsgral ba'i las ni/ bskyed dang dgug gzhug dmod bskul bya/ /lha dbye sgrol zhing ling ro bstab/ /ces pa ltar don tshan drug go /dang po bskyed pa ni/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khaṃ las byung ba'i drag po'i las kyi 'brub khung gnam lcags 'bar ba las grub pa kha dog nag po dbyibs gru gsum rgya che ba gting zab pa/ nang khrag zhag 'khrugs pa/ dug gi na bun dang*/ nad kyi 'tshub ma dang*/ tshon cha'i ser ba 'khrugs pa bya dang gcan gzan gdug pa can dang gshed ma ma rungs pa dang*/ 'bar ba'i mes yongs su khyab pa las kyi btson khang chen po'i nang du ṇā+-i ljang khu las byung ba'i dgra bo pho mo'i tshogs dang*/ tri dkar po las pho gdon sri ser po las mo gdon rnams phung khams skye mched dbang po rnams tshang ba 'jigs shing skrag la 'dar zhing nyams thag pa mgon skyabs dang bral ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/

de ltar lan gsum sogs yang yang gsal btab na bzang ngo/ /gnyis pa dgug gzhug ni/ hūṃ bh+yoḥ shar phyogs sgo ma seng ge'i gdong*/ /phyag na lcags kyu 'bar ba thogs/ /dgra bgegs 'gugs pa'i las mdzad ma/ / grangs med 'khor gyis bskor ba ste/ /lcags kyu thogs pa sprin ltar gtibs/ / de 'dra gcig pur ma nges te/ khams gsum khyab par sprul nas kyang*/ /dgra bgegs gnod byed da khug cig /nyams pa'i khrag la mnga' mdzad ma/ /bstan pa gshigs pa'i dgra rnams kyi/ /chu khams nus pa thams cad chom/ /brlan gsher khrag gi mdangs phrol zhig /oṃ sing ha mu kha hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dzaḥ lho phyogs sgo ma gzig gi gdong*/ /phyag na zhags pa= dgra bgegs gzhug pa'i= grangs med= zhags pa thogs pa= de 'dra gcig pur= khams gsum= dgra bgegs gnod byed da chings shig /nyams pa'i rus la= bstan pa = sa khams= sra ba rus pa'i mdangs phrol zhig /oṃ tsi tā mu kha hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ nub phyogs sgo ma dom gyi gdong*/ /phyag na lcags sgrog= dgra bgegs bcing pa'i= grangs med= lcags sgrog thogs pa= de 'dra= khams gsum= dgra bgegs gnod byed da sdoms shig /nyams pa'i drod la= bstan pa= mekhams= 'ju byed drod kyi mdangs phrol zhig /oṃ raṃ k+ṣa mu kha hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra spo ṭa baṃ/ byang phyogs sgo ma dred kyi gdong*/ /phyag na dril bu= dgra bgegs ltung ba'i= grangs med= dril bu thogs pa= de 'dra= khams gsum= dgra bgegs gnod byed myos par gyis/ nyams pa'i dbugs la= bstan pa= rlung khams= 'gyu ba dbugs kyi mdangs phrol zhig /oṃ tā rak+ṣu mu kha hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra ā be sha hoḥ dgug gzhug bden ba dar brjod pa ni/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ lung dang rtogs pas bsdus pa dam pa'i chos rnams kyi=

theg pa gsum la gnas pa 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi= de bzhin gshegs pa dang rdo rje rin po che dang pad+ma dang las kyi rigs su bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi= snying po dang phyag rgya dang gsang sngags dang rigs sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa dang*/ kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das 'di zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhes skabs der yi dam gang la brten nas bsgrubs pa'i mtshan nas smos so/ /dpal nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po/ yum chen e ka dza ṭi/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ gsod byed las kyi mgon po/ bran bdud gshen rje nag po dam can gnod sbyin yab yum bka' sngod pu ṭa ming sring*/ phyag brnyan sgo srung gdong bzhi/ las byed sde bzhi ru 'dren/ rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍi'i khro tshogs/ dregs pa pho rgyud/ mo rgyud bka' nyan sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ yang skabs 'dir gtor gral la bzhugs pa'i chos skyong gzhan yod na yang de dang de'i mtshan nas smos shing bden pa bdar/ gzhan yang dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rdzu 'phrul gyi zhabs dang ldan pa/ mthu stobs kyi rtsal dang ldan pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ zhes sogs mtshams sbyar nas/ bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra/ dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra/ dge 'dun tshogs kyi sdang dgra/ skye 'gro sems can yongs la 'tshe ba rnams dang*/

khyad par du rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod cing*/ bsam sbyor phyin ci log byed pa'i mir gyur pa'i dgra mi ma yin pa'i bgegs/ rbad 'dre rbod gtong byad ma snga dgra lag tu khyer ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da lta dngos su sbyor ba'i las ngan gyi dgra bo/ bsam pa ngan pa/ sbyor ba rtsub pa/ phod 'dzugs pa/ do bdo ba'i dgra bgegs byad ma gang yin pa de dag thams cad/ mtho srid pa'i rtse mo nas/ dma' dmyal khams yan chod/ bar stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gang na gnas kyang skad cig thang cig yud tsam 'di la ming dang rus su smos pa gzugs dang rtags su byas pa'i mtshan ma rdzas kyi ling ga 'di nyid la khug shig phob cig ṇṛ yaṃ dzaḥ dri yaṃ dzaḥ zhes dang*/ a li a li ma sogs/ bod sngags kyi gsham du/ sarba bigh+nān shā trun ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes btags pa mang du bzla/ rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya'o/ /de ltar lan gsum la sogs pa yid ches rnyed kyi bar du dgug gzhug bya/ /gsum pa dmod bskul ni/ hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dkon mchog gsum po yi/ / bka' yi srung ma thams cad dgongs su gsol/ /bsten bsten bsgrubs bsgrubs pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ /gsol gsol mchod mchod pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ /chos skyong bstan pa mi srung ci zhig srung*/ /dam can dam la mi gnas ci la gnas/ /sngags bdag dgra bgegs mi sgrol ci zhig sgrol/ / phyag brnyan 'phrin las mi sgrub ci zhig sgrub/ /bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /srung ma dam can khyed rnams bsten/ /sdang byed dgra la mthu ma chung*/ / gnod byed bgegs la rtsal ma zhan/ /bcol ba'i las la bang ma bul/ /re ltos dpung gnyen khyed la zhu/ /dmag dpung ram mdar khyod sbron gyi/ /dam bcas ma yel mthu rtsal bskyed/ /lha khang gnas gzhi'i srung ma mdzod/ /yul khyim 'khor gyi mel tshe mdzod/

/mi nor phyugs kyi gnyer kha mdzod/ /gnod byed 'joms pa'i dgra lha mdzod/ /bdag gis ma nyes ma yo'o/ /gzu dang dpang du dkon mchog bzhugs/ /zhal lce sde brgyad yongs kyis chod/ /bden pa'i las kyi rgyab dpung zhu/ /gnod byed las ngan dgra bo 'di/ /spyir gyi dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad/ /skye 'gro yongs kyi bde skyid bcom/ /sgos su rnal 'byor sgrub la sdang*/ /bdag gis zhi ba'i thabs byas kyang*/ /gdug sems can de phyir zhing 'khrug /'di 'dra zhi bas mi thul gyi/ /'di yi gnas lus longs spyod kun/ /da lta nyid du rdul du rlogs/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag steng nas chod/ /sa yi lte phur 'og nas phyung*/ /dkon pa'i tshe srog gnyis dang phrol/ /las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas phul/ /dus kyi mun pas mdun nas bsus/ /lo dang zla bar ma bzhag cig /zhag dang za mar rtags phyung zhig / ces rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ rbod rbad bsad gsum gyi sngags drag tu bzla ba gal che/ /bzhi pa lha dang dbye ba ni/ gong bzhin bden bdar drag tu byas nas/ dgra bgegs byad ma de thams cad srung skyobs byed pa'i lha dang phye shig /pho lha dgra lha zhang lha srog lha yul lha la sogs pa mgon skyabs gdong grogs byed pa'i lha dang phye shig /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ba dang byin rlabs rang dang gzhan gyis byas pa'i nus mthu dang phye shig ces lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar rol mo drag tu brdung zhing*/ ling ga la gu gul gyis bdug /lcam dral gyi snying po dang*/ shā sa na dang*/ rbod rbad bsad gsum gyi mthar/ dgra bgegs 'di rnams 'go ba'i lha thams cad dang bi dwe shā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces btags pa drag tu bzla/ bsgrub bya'i gnas gsum nas 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i srung ba dang byin rlabs gang yod yi ge 'bru gsum gyi rnam pas tshur bsdus te rang la bstim pa'i dmigs pa bya'o/ /lnga pa liṅga sgrol ba ni/

phur pa/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las gsod byed las kyi mgon po sku mdog nag po sku stod khro bo gri gug 'phyar zhing thod khrag 'dzin pa/ lte ba man chad phur bu'i rnam pa dgra bgegs thams cad 'joms pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i mthu stobs thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye badz+ra kī li kī la ya gnod byed mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzlas/ shā sa na tshar gsum dang*/ ye dharma tshar gsum brjod la/ phur pa la khrag dang yungs kar gtor/ de nas phur bu lag tu thogs nas bsgril zhing*/ hūṃ khros pa'i gzugs can gdug pa gang*/ /ji ltar rgyal bas mi 'dul ba/ /dam bcas ji bzhin rjes dgongs la/ /da lta nyid du 'dir khug cig /'bar ba me yi khung bu ru/ /rab tu 'chings nas mnar ba yi/ / gzugs kyi ling gar phur bu che/ /nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa/ gnam lcags 'bar ba'i zur gsum dbal/ /rab tu bsnun no mnar ba'i sems//rnam rtog ma rig bral gyur nas/ /nag po chen pos rjes bzung shog /sarba sha trun bigh+nān kī li kī la ya mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa dang*/ sngags drag tu bzlas shing*/ phur bu ling ga'i snying gar btab/ bsgrub bya gnas spar ba'i dmigs pa bya/ de nas rol chen yun bsring ba'i ngang nas/ shā sa na dang*/ thun sngags bzla bzhin du skam thun rlon thun sogs cung zad brdeg /shā sa na dang rbod rbad bsad gsum bzla bzhin du ral gri'am gri gug gis rkang pa nas mgo bo'i bar du gtub bo/ /drug pa zhal du bstab pa ni/ skabs 'dir bdud rtsi lnga mchod mtshon byed gsar pa gcig kyang bshams la/ las kyi rdo rje zhig gis 'cham stabs dang bcas nas/ ling ro stob pa'i stangs ka byed pa'i srol 'dug pa ltar spros pa la dga' na bya zhing*/

gang ltar yang 'di skad ces/ hūṃ dkon mchog bden pa'i stobs dang sngags kyi mthus/ /zhing bcur gyur pa'i dgra bgegs kun bsgral ba'i/ /sha khrag rus par bcas pa'i phung po 'di/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin brlabs nas/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du kha raṃ khā hi/ /yi dam lha tshogs zhal du kha raṃ khā hi/ /nag po chen po'i zhal du= yum chen ral gcig zhal du= 'dod khams dbang phyug zhal du= gsod byed las mgon= gnod sbyin yab yum= pu ṭa ming sring zhal du= sgo skyong khro mo'i zhal du= pho nya yang sprul zhal du= gaṇ+ḍi'i dmag tshogs zhal du= ru 'dren sde bzhi'i zhal du= dregs pa pho mo'i zhal du= lha srin sde brgyad zhal du= dam can rgya mtsho'i zhal du khe ra khā hi/ mahā maṃ sa la khā hi/ mahā rak+ta la khā hi/ mahā tsit+ta la khā hi/ mahā ko ro tsa na la khā hi/ zhes pa'i mthar rgyun rol dang gtor sngags bya/ ling ro nas rgyun gtor dang*/ bskang gtor la cung zad re gsos/ spro na drag po'i mchod pa byin rlabs kyi tshig brjod/ bsdu na yid kyis bsam pas chog go / dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rab 'khyil ba/ / sogs/ mahā keng ni ri ti khā hi zhes pa'i bar du bdud rtsi lnga mchod kyi tshig rnams brjod/ rol mo'i tshig 'don gyi skabs/ dbyangs dang rnga tshigs byed cing*/ gzhan rnams la 'dur gdangs sngags kyi skabs phyag rgya dang bcas pa byed pa phyis kyi lag len du snang la/ 'on kyang mtha' gcig tu ma nges so/ /de nas sngar nas sdogs pa'i sha dum rnams tsho dgur bcad/ gtor chen gyi g.yas dang*/ ling ro rnams dum bu mang por bcas pa yang tsho dgur byas pa g.yon du bzhag /chang snod dang rak+ta'i snod ji ltar bde bar bzhag nas/ las kyi rdo rjes lcags snod gcig tu sha dum dang ling ro tsho re blugs/ /phud dang rak+ta bran/ mgon po lcam dran so so'i gtor sngags tshar gsum/

shā sa na lan gsum gyis phul te/ rol chen dang bcas gtor chen la btab/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal ba kun gyi bka' srung*/ lha dmag yongs kyi ded dpon/ dur khrod kun gyi zhing skyong*/ chos gzhi kun gyi srung ma/ rig 'dzin yongs kyi dgra lha/ dam nyams kun gyi srog gcod/ gdug can kun gyi gshed ma/ bdud 'dul gyi dpa' bo chen po/ lha chen dpal 'bar khyed kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ yang tsho gnyis pa sngar bzhin bsham/ lha mo'i gtor sngags dang dregs pa pho mo'i rbod rbad bsad gsum yongs rdzogs sam/ bsdu ba bod sngags tsam gyi mthar/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis 'khor rnams la bsngos/ gong bzhin rol mo dang bcas te gtor chain la btab/ dpal ldan lha mo nag mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ gshin rje'i lcam gcig bdud kyi yum chen/ nad do cog gi bdag mo 'khor ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ gnod sbyin pho mo mon bu lcam sring*/ ru 'dren sprul pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du kha raṃ khā hi/ gzhan yang dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ phyogs skyong zhing skyong 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bka' nyan mgon po grangs med pa rnams dang*/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dang bcas pa'i zhal du kha raṃ khā hi/ gsol lo mchod do mchod pa dam par 'bul lo/ / yang tsho gsum pa sngar bzhin bsham/ shā sa na lan gsum gyis phul la/ sngar bzhin btab/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' dang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che srung bar dgongs te/ rab tu dges shing mos pa'i thabs kyis bzhes la/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi 'gal rkyen nad dang gnod pa dang*/ gdon bgegs dang bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dbang thang dang nus mthu dang*/ snyan pa dang grags pa thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba pho mo thams cad dbang du bsdu bar mdzad du gsol/

gnod byed dgra bgegs log par lta ba thams cad bsad pa dang*/ bskrad ba dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ rengs pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas thal ba rdul du rlog par mdzod cig /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ yid la bsam pa'i don thams cad sgrubs/ ji ltar bka' bsgos shing bcol ba'i 'phrin las thams cad myur ba nyid du sgrubs shig ces brjod/ de ltar gsol kha stob tshul de nyid tshar gsum song ba na/ bdud rtsi lnga mchod kyi mchod pa de yang gtor chen nang du btab bo/ /de nas zor bsgrub pa ni/ hūṃ rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma yis/ /zor chen rdzas kyi mthu bskyed la/ /zor mchog 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /mi mthun phyogs kun gzhom du gsol/ / tshig lhag ma gsum 'dra ba la/ yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis/ / zhes dang*/ dpal ldan nag po chen po yis/ / zhes dang*/ ma cig 'dod khams gtso mo yis/ / zhes dang*/ pho nya las mkhan tshogs rnams kyis/ / zhes dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kun gyis/ / zhes dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden stobs kyis/ / zhes sam/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog sogs so sor phral kyang rung*/ rang bzhin spros bral bden pa'i mthus/ /

zhes dang*/ las 'bras bslu med bden pa'i mthus/ / zhes sogs sbyar ro/ /mgon po lcam dral dang zangs gri can gyi sngags rbod rbad bsad gsum ci rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ shā sa na ci mang dang*/ khyad par gyi thun sngags/ sum trig rak+sha bh+yoḥ thibs thibs tsakra bh+yoḥ snying khar gdun tri bh+yoḥ rbad rbad tri na shig shig se na stubs stubs/ kha rag rbad rbad dum bu bh+yoḥ badz+ra tsi tri rak+sha tsi tri ya ma ra ya rbad bh+yoḥbazlog ces drag tu bzla/ de nas spros pa la dga' na zor gyi bskul byed par 'dug /de ni yi ge snga ma rnams su lta la/ nges par dgos pa'ang min pas 'dir ma bris so/ /de nas bzlog pa ni/ hūṃ dpal 'bar mahā kā la ni/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi dur khrod nas/ /dri za 'bum tshogs 'khor gyis bskor/ /dmar chen gtor mas thugs dam bskang*/ /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs/ /zas su dgra bgegs sha khrag zo/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /dgra bgegs gnod pa bzlog tu gsol/ /hūṃ dpal 'bar mahā kā la ni/ /lho yi phyogs kyi dur khrod nas/ /gshin rje 'bum tshogs 'khor gyis bskor/ /dmar chen gtor ma sogs tshig rkang lnga po 'dra'o/ /de bzhin du/ nub kyi chu lha= byang gi gnod sbyin= byang shar dbang ldan= shar lho me lha= lho nub srin po= nub byang rlung lha= steng gi lha dmag= 'og gi klu gnyan= zhes 'don pa spos pa ma gtogs snga ma bzhin no/ /de ltar na 'di la dur khrod gnas pa'i phyogs skyong gi bskul zhes grags so/ /de nas/ hūṃ lha chen dpal 'bar mthu ma chung*/ / zhes pa nas/ da lta nyid du grub par mdzod/ / ces pa'i bar bskang ba ltar bya/ hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po da gshegs shig /bzlog pa'i dmag dpung da mdzod cig /sde brgyad dmag sna thams cad bzlog /byad kha lha 'dre'i chad pa rnams/ khyod kyis mi bzlog gang yang med/ khyod kyis mi 'gyur gang yang med/ /yon mchod 'khor bcas mtshan ma 'khrug

/zlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /lha dang gnod sbyin gshin rje dang*/ /klu dang rgyal po btsan dang bdud/ smu dang the rang 'gong po dang*/ /byang sman ma mo bal mo dang*/ /yul lha nad bdag 'byung po sogs/ /gza' dang sde brgyad 'khyams po dang*/ /rbod gtong byad kha gzhan gyis bskul/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /gnod pa byed pa ma lus kun/ /bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /'byung po'i sprul pa sna tshogs kun/ /bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /sde brgyad byol kha sna tshogs kun/ /bzlog go= lha srin cho 'phrul sna tshogs kun/ /bzlog go= phyi nang ltas ngan mtshan ma ngan/ /bzlog go= dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas dang*/ /dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams thams cad kun/ /bsgyur zhing bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol ba yi/ /'phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas dang*/ /rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /bdud kyi byol kha dgra la sgyur/ /gshin rje'i khram kha 'debs pa sogs/ /ngan pa bzlog la rtsub mo rnams/ /dgra dang bgegs gyi tshogs la sgyur/ / zhes brjod/ spros pa la dga' na mdos chog nas 'byung ba bzhin byol bzlog rgyas par byed pa yin pa gda' na'ang 'di tsam 'tsham mo/ / der rol mo drag po dang bcas gtor chen la yungs kar gtor te/ de yan chad dngos gzhi sgrub pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas gtor chen dang*/ gtor zor rnams la phud dang rak+tas cung zad gtor/ mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas/ lha tshogs rnams zhu ba las dug dang me dang mtshon cha'i phung por gyur bar bsam pa'am/ yang na yig brgya lan gsum sngon du 'gro bas/ gtor chen gyi lha nam mkhar bteg /gtor ma gong bzhin bsam mo/ /zor gyi lha rnams 'degs mi dgos sngar bzhin bsam pa kho nas chog go /de nas/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan sngar rang rang gi

zhes sogs lcam dral gyi bskul dang*/ gnod sbyin yab yum 'jigs pa'i gzugs sogs bstod pa bskul du bsgyur te/ bstan srung yab yum las la chos/ / zhes pa dang*/ pu ṭa nag po las la ya/ / zhes dang*/ b+ta ṭa la yang de dang 'dra/ nag mo khyod kyis las mdzod cig / ces dang*/ 'khor bcas thams cad las mdzod cig /dgra bgegs rdul bzhin brlag bar mdzod/ / ces 'don pa spo/ de nas gser skyems sogs kyis sna drangs te/ zor dang gtor ma rnams phyir khyer/ 'og gzh-i dkyil 'khor yang gtor ma la 'debs pa'i srol yod/ sgrub khang gi phyi rol ji ltar 'os par g.yang gzhi'i steng du stegs bu la thun gtor bshams nas spyi btab gyer bas 'bul/ de nas gom pa bzhi bcu rtsa dgu las mi thung pa'i sa phyogs su song ste/ gser skyems sngon du 'gro bas zor lam dbye ba spyi dang mthun par bya ste/ dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang gi bka'/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun nyon cig / rnal 'byor rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams/ /gtor zor drag po pho nyar 'gyed/ / zor 'phen phyogs dang nye ba na/ /yul lha'i rigs dang chu mig brag /shing dang sa la gnas pa yi/ /'byung po thams cad sku bzur cig /don gnyer phyogs su 'gro ba dang*/ /lam du zhugs dang mkha' la rgyu/ /dgra bgegs ma gtogs 'gro ba rnams/ /rang rang phyogs su yol bar gyis/ /bzur bar 'dod kyang bskyod ma nus/ /brtan par gnas pa'i sa bdag sogs/ /mtho ba rnams ni zhabs bskums shig /dma' ba rnams ni dbu chums shig /bar pa rnams ni sku bzur cig /bag yangs gnas pa bsgrim par mdzod/ /zor lam phye la grogs mdzod cig /bstan pa'i dgra bo sdig can 'di/ /skad cig gcig la rdul du rlogs/ ces so/ /de nas slob dpon gyis bden pa bdar zhing slar yang gser skyems gtong*/ gzhan rnams kyis rol chen bya/ de'i rjes su/ hūṃ bh+yoḥ mahā kā la stobs po che/ / sogs dang*/

hūṃ/ dpal chen legs ldan nag po che/ /steng nas 'gyed pa'i pho nya ni/ /tshangs lha'i tshogs rnams khyung du sprul/ khyung chen mthing nag bye ba 'bum/ /'phur lding gzhungs shing dgra la rgol/ /dgra bgegs sha zos khrag la 'thung*/ / de rjes gsham bu'i tshig la/ bsang gtor gyis skabs yin na/ mi nor thal ba rdul du rlogs/ / rigs brgyud rtsad nas chod la shog / ces dang*/ rim 'gro sogs la/ rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad bzlog /gnod byed thal ba rdul du rlogs/ / zhes brjod/ hūṃ dpal chen= shar nas 'gyed pa'i= dri za'i tshogs rnams rta par sprul/ /rta dmag mtshon thogs bye ba 'bum/ /drag gtum rngams zhing dgra la rgol/ /dgra bgegs sha sogs gong bzhin sbyar/ hūṃ dpal chen= lho nas= gshin rje'i tshogs rnams stag tu sprul/ gcan gzan dpa' bo= mche gtsigs rngam mchong = dgra bgegs= hūṃ dpal chen= nub nas= klu'i tshogs rnams sbrul du sprul/ dug sbrul rngams pa= phud sgra sgrog cing dgra la= dgra bgegs= hū dpal chen= byang nas= gnod sbyin tshogs rnams seng ger sprul/ /seng ge khros pa= sbar ba gdengs shing = dgra bgegs= hūṃ dpal chen= byang shar= 'byung po'i tshogs rnams glang du sprul/ /'thab glang myos pa = gnam lcags gri 'debs= dgra bgegs= hūṃ dpal chen= shar lho'i mtshams nas= drang srong tshogs rnams 'phar bar sprul/ /'phar spyang rngams pa= mchong rgyug khros pas= dgra bgegs= hūṃ dpal chen= lho nub= srin po'i tshogs rnams ru trar sprul/ /ru dra nag po= rngams shig drag pos= dgra bgegs= hū dpal chen= nub byang = rig 'dzin tshogs rnams rlung por sprul/ /rlung nag mtshon char= sa gzhi bskyed cing = dgra bgegs= hūṃ dpal chen= 'og gi= sa bdag tshogs rnams sdig par sprul/ / lcags sdig mgo dgu= rgyug mchong 'khrab cing = dgra bgegs= hūṃ las mkhan chen po 'khor bcas kyi/ /g.yas nas dmag gi ru 'dren pa/

/gying gi tshogs rnams dmag mir sprul/ /skyes pa go mtshon thogs pa brgya/ /gying dmag bye ba 'bum dang bcas/ /mda' zor mtshon cha dgra la phob/ /hūṃ las mkhan= g.yon nas dmag gi= ra tsa'i tshogs rnams btsun par sprul/ /dgra bcom seg shang thogs pa brgya/ /rgyal dmag bye ba= gyo zor skam thun dgra la rgyob/ / hūṃ las mkhan= /slad nas dmag gi= /gza' rgod tshogs rnams sngags par sprul/ /sngags nag phur bu thogs pa brgya/ /gza' dmag bye ba= rwa zor thun zor dgra la rgyob/ /hūṃ las mkhan= sngon nas dmag gi= ma mo'i tshogs rnams srin mor sprul/ /bud med gri thod thogs pa brgya/ /ma mo bye ba= khrag zor dug thun dgra la rgyob/ /nag mo ral ba g.yengs pa'i tshogs/ /bh+yo bh+yoḥde ni dgra la bh+yoḥ sogs sbyar te bskul ba'i mthar/ rol mo drag la yun ring bar bya/ de'i ngang nas thams cad kyis rbod rbad bsad gsum drag tu bzla/ gtor ma'i las kyi slob dpon gyis mda' zor ra zor khrag zor tshe zor yungs zor tha mal rdo zor 'phangs/ de nas zangs gri can gyi zor gtor 'phangs/ de nas gtor chen phrag pa g.yas su thogs te/ dmigs pa gsal btab/ dmod pa shes tshad bya zhing mi la lab pa ltar las bcol/ kha bub tu gdab pa'am/ rgyang du 'phang pa gang bde bya'o/ /de nas gtor lam bcad bsrung 'khor gsal btab/ thams cad phyi mig mi lta bar sgrub khang du 'ongs nas tshogs la rol/ bkra shis kyi bar gyi rjes chog rnams bya'o/ /cho ga 'di zhag mang por sbrel nas sgrub na'ang*/ zhag snga ma rnams la dngos gzhi bzlog pa yan chad song ba'i rjes su spyi btab kyis thun gtor phul/ tshogs dang rjes chog bya'o/ /zhag tha ma la ni gong du bstan pa nyid do/ /dmod pa dang 'dod gsol yi ge rnying pa grong pa'i tshig tu sbyar ba mang po yod pa rnams dben pa'i gnas su las sgrub pa dang*/ bla brgyud chos brgyud gcig pa rtog dpyod nyung ba'i tshogs nang du'ang brjod rgyu yin mod kyi/

skye bo bsam pa tha dad pa sna tshogs pa'i nang du dbye ba'i gnas su 'gyur ba'i dgag cha yod pas 'dir re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag go /de ltar na dpal gur gyi mgon po'i dmar chen gtor bzlog gi rim pa mdo tsam brjod pa 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o// //zhus dag/ maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i sgos bskang bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dpal mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i bskang ba cung zad spros pa la dga' na/ lha mchog mahā kā la mthu bo che/ /'phrin las drag po'i gdug pa tshar gcod phyir/ / zhes pa nas/ zhing skyong chen po gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ / zhes pa'i bar gyer la/ de rjes/ hūṃ dmar nag me dpung glog phreng rgyu ba'i klong*/ /'jigs rung phyag mtshan mtshon cha'i gur khang 'khrigs/ /mi ro rta ro bam chen brtsegs pa'i mkhar/ /rlung nag 'tshub ma'i dbus nas sku bskyod 'tshal/ /ha ha bzhad pa'i nga ro mthon po ni/ khor yug lcags kyi ri bo'i pha mthar thon/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten 'dar zhing g.yo ba yi// hūṃ phaṭa phaiṃ kyi shugs glu tshe re re/ /las bzhi'i 'phrin las myur mgyogs bskul ba'i sgras/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro las byed skar ltar 'khrugs/ /srin yul lang ka'i bdag po khros pa'i gzi/ /zur tsam thos pas bka' gnyan thal mo sbyor/ /lha min nam mkha'i bu mo glog 'phreng ma/ /g.yul du sgrol ba'i dpa' chen khros pa'i gar/ /gom stabs gcig gis sa gsum lhag par brdzis/ khrag 'dzag mgo phreng sil sil g.yer kha'i skad/ /mu cor sgrogs pas 'ur sgra 'brug stong bzhin// sdigs rngams bsnun pa'i tshul du bskyod pa'i phyag /gri gug ral gri 'bar ba rtse gsum bsnams/ /thod nang don snying gsol la dgyes pa'i zhal/ /mchu 'phyang hom ras dam nyams 'gugs pa'i sgo/ /tshangs pa'i skud thogs mgo bo'i cod pan lnga/ /zla tshes nag bun g.yogs 'dra'i ral pas sgribs/

kham nag me lce lhab lhab 'bar ba can/ /zhing skyong dbang phyug gzi ldan nag po che/ /ha ha rgod dang gru 'dzin bsil ba'i tshal/ ti se gangs ri'i byang phyogs lam me sogs/ / phyogs bcu'i zhing nas 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /dur khrod brgyad dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas/ /yul chen so gnyis nye bar spyod pa'i zhing*/ /rol pa'i zhing dang rab 'byams phyogs bcu nas/ /pho nya las byed 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ / zhes pa 'jug /de nas gtor bsngo dkyus bzhin las/ gtor bsngo grub mtshams bskang rdzas/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang drag po'i las kyi gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ 'byung bzhi las kyi gur khang dang bcas pas skor ba'i nang du hūṃ zhu ba las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dam rdzas thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dmar chen khrag gi ar+ghaṃ/ dbang po lnga'i me tog /tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi sgron me/ 'khris chen gyi dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ rkang gling dang thod lnga'i rol mo/ g.yang gzhi'i bla re/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi/ glo snying gi 'phyang 'phrul/ ro skra'i rnga yab/ thod tshal gyi zla tshes/ nal bu'i rgyal mtshan/ zhing chen gyi 'phan gdugs/ rus pa'i phreng ba sogs mgon po mnyes par byed pa'i dam rdzas dang thun rdzas sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ rol mo brdung ngo*/ /spro na sngags drug phyag rgya drug sogs bya/ de rjes bskang ba'i dngos gzhi thog mar/ lha mchog mahā kā la mthu bo che/ khyed la mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡·+ / rta mchog rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang*/ £© /g.yag rog zhol chen sprin ltar gtibs pa dang*/ /lug nag spyi dkar shel ltar 'tsher ba dang*/ khyi nag snying dkar dom ltar 'phyo ba dang*/

/mthing nag dar gyi cod pan mang pos brgyan/ /lha mchog mahā ka la'i thugs dam bskang*/ /lha chen nag po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang*/ /zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug thugs dam bskang*/ / bram ze'i gzugs can dpa' bo'i= yum chen g.yung mo nag mo'i= las mdzad gtum mo ljang khu'i= ser nag sing ga gling ma'i= dmar nag srin mo chen mo'i= 'khor gyi zhing skyong tshogs kyi= dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs kyi= 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam skong gyur cig /rak+ta dmar chen khrag gi ar+ghaṃ dang*/ /dri ldan gsar rnying me tog nag po dang*/ /tshil chen maṃ sa'i spos kyi dud sprin dang*/ / zhun chen sgron me 'bar ba'i snang gsal dang*/ khrag zhag rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dri mchog dang*/ /zhal zas bshos bu dmar nag ri rab tsam/ khrag zhag sha rus gtams pa'i tshoms bu bkod/ /rkang gling snyan pa'i rol mo sgra sgrogs shing*/ /sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin gyis brgyan pa 'dis/ /lha mchog mahā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*/ / lha chen man chad 'gre/ dam rdzas rgyan dang ldan pa'i gtor ma dang*/ / 'chi med bdud rtsi sman gyi rgya mtsho dang*/ /dza gad phud kyi btung ba sna tshogs

dang*/ /bza' dang btung ba ri rab rgya mtsho tsam/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa/ /ro brgya ldan pa mchod pa'i rgya mtsho 'di/ /lha mchog= lha chen= zhing skyong*/ bram ze= yum chen= las mdzad= ser nag= dmar nag= 'khor gyi= dregs pa= 'khor dang = rnal 'byor bdag gi nyams chags sos gyur cig /gdong bzhi dregs pa 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung zhing skyongs ba dang*/ /gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad thal bar rlog /zhi rgyas dbang dang dngos grub bdag la stsol/ / zhes pa legs par song ba'i mtshams su 'di skad ces bya ste/ hūṃ ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod sogs/ /gdug can 'dul ba'i gnas kun nas/ /dpal ldan mgon po zhal bzhi pa/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /drag shul 'jigs rung da tshur byon/ / stobs 'phrog nag po da tshur byon/ khyod la mchod cing bsten pa'i phyir/ /dam tshig can la dgongs su gsol/ /chos skyong mgon po nag po che/ /ming gi rnam grangs mang po can/ /zhing rnams skyong bar mdzad pa po/ /stobs 'phrog nag po 'khor bcas la/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i/ /rnam dag dam rdzas ma lus 'bul/ /mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ khyed kyi thugs dam skong ba'i rdzas/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas dgyes rgu'i gter/ /ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin rnams/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin rlabs nas/ /rab 'byams nam mkha'i mthas klas pa/ /gus pa'i yid kyis bdag 'bul na/ /dam tshig dbang gi bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas dngos grub rgya chen stsol/ g.yag nag lug nag phyi yi rten/ /zhwa nag gos nag nang gi rten/ /gri snying thod pa gsang ba'i rten/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i rten du 'jug /stobs chen shugs drag gri gug rno/ /gdug pa bsgral phyir bzhes su gsol/ /rgyu rtsub dug gis ngar slud pa'i/ / gri gug mgon po'i phyag na 'bar/ /log la drag po'i sngags bkod pas/ / mgon po 'khor bcas sprin bzhin 'du/

/zhabs gnyis rdo rje rno ngar bcas/ gdug can dgra bo'i snying la gzer/ /stobs 'phrog nag po'i phyag tu 'bul/ / dgra bgegs bsgral phyir bzhes su gsol/ / de ltar tshig bcu po de la 'don pa spo ste/ stobs chen shugs drag rtse gsum rno/ / zhes dang*/ rtse gsum mgon po'i phyag na 'bar/ / zhes pa dang de bzhin du ral gri dang*/ mdung thung la'ang sbyar/ rkang gling snyan pa'i sgra sgrog pa/ /dam tshigs mtshon phyir 'du ba'i sgra/ /stobs 'phrog nag po'i phyag tu 'bul/ /dam tshig skyong phyir bzhes su gsol/ /rnal 'byor skyong phyir bsnams su gsol/ / 'og ma gnyis la'ang 'di'i rigs 'gre/ dug can phreng mdzes 'gug pa'i rgyan/ /rin chen bum pa nor gyi dbyig /stobs 'phrog= dam tshig= rnal 'byor= dar nag ba dan g.yo ba'i don/ /bde chen thod khrag bdud rtsi'i rgyan/ /stobs 'phrog= dam tshig= rnal 'byor= gzhan yang gtor ma rak+ta dang*// bdud rtsi lnga dang sha chen spos/ /tshil chen mar me chang phud dang*/ /maṇ+ḍal la sogs rten du 'bul/ /rnal 'byor skyong phyir bsnams su gsol/ /gting mtha' mi mngon rak+ta'i mtsho/ /rba klong 'khyil zhing 'bar ba'i dbus/ /thod chen brtsegs pa'i sku mkhar 'dis/ /mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ / rgyu rlon lda ldi mchu 'phyang la/ /nyams pa'i dbang lnga rgyan du byas/ /zhing chen g.yang gzhi'i 'phan gdugs can /dam rdzas rgyan gyi thugs dam bskang*/ /dgra bgegs mgo bo'i cod pan dag /skam rlon spel ba'i kha pad la/ /keng rus brtsegs pa'i ka gdung 'dis/ /mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ / char sprin rlung gis bskyod pas 'dra'i/ /ro skra'i rnga yab nag po dang*/ /zla ba mkha' la shar 'dra ba'i/ /thod tshal dum bus thugs dam bskang*/ /nal bus rlung bshus rgyal mtshan dang*/ /yan lag nying lag spel ba yis/ /drag po las kyi pho brang 'dir/ /mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/

/zhing bcu'i sdang dgra ma lus pa/ /thams cad bsgral ba'i thod rlon dang*/ /mchod yon nyer spyod sna tshogs pas/ /nye bar bskang 'dis thugs dam bskang*/ /dam nyams snying rtsa'i khrag rgyun la/ /ga bur zegs mas rab brgyan te/ /chal chil lbu phreng rlabs g.yo ba'i/ /rak+ta'i ar+ghaṃ thugs dam bskang*/ /blta byed mig dang nyan byed rna/ /snom byed sna dang myong byed lce/ khrag rgyun gsar pas sbags pa yis/ / dbang lnga'i puṣ+pe thugs dam bskang*/ /drag po dri yis bgos pa'i sman/ /byin za chen po rab sbar zhing*/ /ro sol me la legs btab pa'i/ /tshil chen bdug pas thugs dam bskang*/ /rkang sbubs las skyes mar khu'i rgyun/ /ro ras sdong bus rkyen sbyar nas/ /mun pa'i snang ba 'gog byed pa'i/ /zhun chen dī pes thugs dam bskang*/ /gser mdog khu ba'i thig phran dang*/ /rang byung rak+ta rab sbyar zhing*/ /kun da'i zhag phreng tshom bu can/ /mkhris chen gan+dhes thugs dam bskang*/ /dgra bo'i nag khrol sna tshogs pa/ /gri lcags snod du rab bsregs shing*/ sgog skya dri dang rab sbyar ba'i/ /maṃ sa'i zas kyi thugs dam bskang*/ / g.yul du bregs pa'i mi thod dang*/ khrag zhag lhag pa'i gzi ldan zhing*/ /klad rgyas g.yogs pa'i thod rnga dang*/ /rkang gling shap+tas thugs dam bskang*/ /'phral bshus pags pa'i bla re las/ khrag gi thig phran rab 'bab cing*/ /rgyu rlon spel ba'i lda ldi dang*/ /dbang po'i rgyal mtshan thugs dam bskang*/ /mi rus dam bu spel ba yis/ /'khor lo rna rgyan mgul rgyan sogs/ /gdub bu ske rags se mo do/ /rus pa'i rgyan gyis thugs dam bskang*/ rkun chen bgegs nas shi ba'i skra// bshan pa'i bu mos bkal ba yis/ /cho ga bzhin du legs sgrubs pa'i/ /tshangs skud nag pos thugs dam bskang*/ /ru rak+ṣa dang ni raṃ shu/ /sna tshogs spel ba'i phreng ba dang*/ /sil sil g.yer kha'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /stobs chen nag po'i thugs dam bskang*/

shugs drag bskyod pa'i ral gri'i rtser/ /g.yul du longs pa'i mgo bo'i phreng*/ khrag 'dzag lnga bcu rtsa gcig 'dis/ /zhing skyong chen po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /lcags kyu lnga dang mi 'chi lnga/ /rab sbyar bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho che/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'dis/ /ye shes mgon po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /bza' dang bca' ba sna tshogs dang*/ /lhag par sran chen khrag chen bcas/ /dza gad dpa' bo'i ston mo 'dis/ /lha mchog nag po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /bstan dgra'i don snying rlangs par bcas/ /glo mchin la sogs drag po'i zas/ /klad khrag 'dres pa'i dam rdzas 'dis/ /gtum chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ /sgal tshigs nyer brgyad sha lpags tshogs/ /lhu dum rab bkod sha khrag dang*/ /rgyu rlon snye ma la sogs pas/ /bshan pa'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /mdor na nag po 'khor bcas la/ /'phrin las drag po'i las bcol ba'i/ /bsgral pa'i mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis/ /thugs dam gnyan po skong gyur cig /rdzu 'phrul rlung gi shugs ldan pa'i/ /rta nag rting dkar 'tsher bag can/ /g.yang gzhi'i sga g.yogs ldan pa 'dis/ /zhing skyong 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ /g.yag rgod rab khros 'gyings pa'i stabs/ /ri rab 'degs pa'i rwa rno zhing*/ /nag bun 'tshubs 'dra'i zhol chen 'dis/ /zhing skyong 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ /mthing sngon rwa bzhi mkhyil ba'i dbus/ /zla ba shar 'dra'i klad dkar can/ /bdud lug nag po'i spyi dkar 'dis/ /zhing skyong 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs/ /chab sgo 'dzin pa 'brug stong gi /gad rgyangs mthon por sgrog pa'i gdong*/ khyi nag dom ltar 'phyo ba 'dis/ /zhing skyong 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ /de ltar thugs dam skong gyur nas/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /nyam chags ma lus gsos gyur te/ /mthun pa'i dngos grub rgya chen stsol/ /'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bu gcig pa yi ma bzhin du/

/nam yang g.yel ba med pa ni/ /bsrung zhing skyob pa'i mgon mdzod cig /bar chad bdud dang 'gal rkyen spongs/ /mthun rkyen tshe dang dpal 'byor spel/ /bla ma dkon mchog dbu 'phangs bstod/ /'phrul gyi lha chen 'khor bcas rnams/ /gsol lo mchod do dgyes par mdzod/ /bstan pa srungs shig sems can rnams/ /bde skyid dpal la spyod pa dang*/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i las mdzod cig / bstod pa'i skabs su mi rtog ma chung ba ni/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor mas mdzad pa yin la/ bla ma gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs bstod pa ni/ hūṃ rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bsgos pa'i/ /bstan srung nag po chen po khyod/ /gnas ni gang du 'khod gyur kyang*/ /dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ /paṃ pad raṃ nyi ro steng du/ hūṃ skyes nag po 'jigs pa'i sku/ /zhal bzhi phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis pa/ khro gtum rngams pa khyod la bstod/ /g.yas gnyis sngon po mche ba gtsigs/ /spyan rtsa dmar zlum nyi zlar 'khyil/ /smin ma sma ra khams ser 'bar/ /ljags gril ha ha bzhad la bstod/ /g.yon gnyis ljang khu khro gnyer 'khrigs/ /dpral bsdus sdang mig log 'dren gzir/ /shangs nas rlung 'tshub rngul gyis 'gengs/ hūṃ hūṃ sgra 'byin khyod la bstod/ /g.yas g.yon gri gug thod khrag ni/ /thugs kar steng 'og bsnams pa yis/ /dgra bgegs snying 'byin dgra khrag 'thung*/ /phaṭa phaṭa dgra bgegs sgrol la bstod/ /g.yas g.yon 'og ma'i phyag gnyis kyis/ /rtse gsum bum pa bsnams nas ni/ /mdung rnon dgra bgegs lus la 'debs/ /bum pas sgrub la dngos grub stsol/ /mi mgo khrag 'dzag lnga bcu dang*/ /dril bu g.yer ba sil sil gyis/ /zhing skyong khyod kyi sku la brgyan/ /srid gsum g.yo byed khyod la bstod/ /zhabs gnyis dor stabs gar gyis rol/ /sa gzhi rab g.yo dgra bgegs 'dul/ /dpa' bo khro gnyer sha gcod gsol/

/rngams pa'i dpa' bo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /las mkhan 'khor gyi khro mo bzhi/ /g.yas phyogs rgyug byed g.yung mo khyod/ /gri gug thod 'dzin shugs pas 'gengs/ /dgra bgegs myos byed dbang byed ma/ /g.yung mo nag mo khyod la bstod/ /g.yon nas 'gying stabs bzhad cing rgyug /gri gug thod 'dzin sha rus za/ /dgra bgegs rmongs shing myos byed ma/ /gtum mo ljang khu khyod la bstod/ /mdun na srin mo 'phyongs thabs rgyug /gri gug thod khrag dgra snying 'byin/ /ban+dha khrag bkang yab la stob/ /dgyes shing 'khril mdzad yum la bstod/ /rgyab nas gar stabs g.yal zhing rgyug /gri gug thod pa khrag bkang 'dzin/ /'o dod khus 'debs dgra bo dgugs/ /sing gha li ma khyod la bstod/ / gtso bo 'khor bcas ti ser gnas/ /zhing skyong srung ma gtso 'khor lngas/ / bstan la gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /sgrol byed gtso 'khor lnga la bstod// sha chen sran bcas me tog snying*/ /rus chen sbags pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /ye shes lnga ru byin rlabs pa/ /'di bzhes dgra bgegs brlag par mdzod/ ces pa'o/ / g.yas gnyis sngon po mche ba gtsigs/ / zhes pa bsnyen pa'i skabs/ dbus gnyis nag po mche ba gtsigs/ / zhes dang*/ g.yon gnyis ljang khu zhes pa la/ g.yas g.yon ljang nag khro gnyer 'khrigs/ / zhes 'don pa spo/ sgrub dus la/ dbus dang steng zhal nag po khros/ / zhes dang*/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar khro gnyer bsdus/ / zhes 'don pa spo'o/ / hūṃ rgyal ba kun gyi drag po'i 'phrin las pa/ /rngam brjid khros pa char sprin lta bu'i mdog /srid gsum dregs ldan yongs kyi gtsor gyur pa/ /gtum po gzi ldan dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i 'phrin las kyi/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bzhir skyong mdzad pa/ / rab brjid dpa' bo dgyes byed pho nya mo/ /las mdzad sring mo bzhi la bstod par bgyid/ /bka' nyan mthu rtsal rmad byung ba/

/srog gcod bshan pa nyi shu gcig /gnod byed dgra bgegs 'joms la dpa'/ /rab tu gtum po'i tshogs la bstod/ /log 'dren kun 'joms ma rung gzugs/ /mtshon cha du ma thogs shing rgyug /bdud 'dul nyi khri chig stong gi /dpung tshogs rnams la bstod par bgyi/ /gzhan yang bstan la mngon dga' ba'i/ dregs pa sde brgyad dmag tshogs rnams/ khams gsum khyab pa'i cho 'phrul can/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams la bstod/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin dam rdzas tshogs/ / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten ma lus kun khyab pas/ /lha mchog khyod la rtag tu mchod byed na/ /dngos grub ma lus ji bzhin stsal du gsol/ khyad par dpal ldan bla mar gnod sems can/ bstan la gnod par byed pa'i ma rungs pa/ / rnal 'byor bdag la sdang byed dgra bo rnams/ /rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzad du gsol/ /gnas skabs kun tu'ang bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /mi mthun rkyen gyi bar chad ma lus kun/ /dpal mgon 'khor dang bcas pas zhi mdzad cing*/ bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / mdor bsdus pa la de tsam gyi chog la/ spros pa la dga' na/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bstod rnying mang du yod pas/ /de dag las ji ltar 'os pas bstod par bya'o/ /de nas bshags pa ni/ yig brgya mang du bzlas pa'i mthar/ hūṃ rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam tshogs/ khyad par mgon po 'khor bcas rnams/ /ma lus gsan zhing dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag mi shes bag med cing*/ /ma lus le lo'i dbang gyur pa'i/ /rang bzhin bcas pa'i nyes ltung rnams/ /gnong pa'i yid kyis bshags par bgyi/ /bla med theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ /rig 'dzin nang gi dam tshig la/ khas blangs dam bcas nongs pa gang*/ /'chabs pa med pa'i sems kyis bshags/ /bla ma rdo rje slob dpon la/ /lus ngag sems kyis smod pa gang*/ /gdung zhing 'gyod pa drag po'i blos/

/mi sbed spyan sngar da lta bshags/ /mgon khyod brtan par zhugs pa las/ /mchod dang gtor ma'i rnal 'byor la/ /nyams chags grib kyis sbags pa rnams/ /dpal mgon dam can che la bshags/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas dang*/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi a mṛ ta/ /dam rdzas ma tshang gyur pa kun/ /mthu ldan srung ma khyod la bshags/ /rgyu chung phud nyams lhag ma 'dres/ /'khor can rdzas kyis sbags pa dang*/ /snod min mthong thos gyur pa yang*/ /dam can srung ma khyod la bshags/ khyod sku skal min bstan pa dang*/ khyod gsung bzlas brjod nyams chags dang*/ khyod kyi thugs dang 'gal ba'i tshogs/ /bdag cag snying nas bshags par bgyi/ /bla ma'i sku dgrar gyur pa dang*/ /dkon mchog gsum 'tshe sems can gnod/ / bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo la/ /byams bsten 'grogs pa mthol lo bshags/ / dur khrod bas mtha' dben gnas su/ /bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod mchod gtor gyis/ /thugs dam dus su skong ba la/ /le lor spyod gang mthol lo bshags/ / 'don chen yul che'i lhag bsam gyis/ /chos skyong gnad nas bskul ba dang*/ / las sgrub dus su mchod gtor gyi/ gtang rag ma thengs mtho lo bshags/ / mdor na zhing skyong 'khor bcas kyi/ /sku gsung thugs la nongs pa'i cha/ /

bgyis dang bgyid stsal gang legs pa/ /dag tshangs chen po mdzad du gsol/ / zhes pa'i mthar 'jam rol rgyun chags dang lhan cig yig brgya tshar gsum brjod/ de nas gtor 'bul gyi spyi btab ni/ gur rnam dang sbrags te byed pa yin na logs su mi dgos kyang*/ zhal bzhi pa nyid la sgos su 'bul na/ spyan gsum sras po gzi brjid mtha' g.yas pa/ khams gsum dbang phyug drag po lha yi lha/ /dpal ldan mgon po zhal bzhi dregs pa can/ /'jigs mdzad khyod kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ ḍom+bi ni sogs sring mo 'khor dang bcas/ /tsaṇ+ḍi kā sogs ma mo 'khor dang bcas/ /ma ru tse sogs bshan pa'i 'khor dang bcas/ /mig dring la sogs gsod byed 'khor dang bcas/ /dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig / ces pa man chad spyi dang 'dra/ mjug tu dge legs kyi tshigs bcad dang*/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ / sogs ji ltar 'os pa brjod/ /dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i sgos kyi bskang gso byed tshul/ gtor chog dang bskang gso chen mo'i zur 'debs kyi tshul du sbyar ba 'di yang*/ don gnyer mang pos yang yang bskul ba la brten nas/ bla ma gong ma'i gsung las bsdus te/ tā ra nā thas sgrigs pa'o/ /zhus dag//dge legs 'phel// maṅgalaṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ mgon po rnams kyi sgrub thabs dang gtor chog sna tshogs kyi skor bzhugs/ -PAGE 144--PAGE 145--PAGE 1-
